skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i mos pa bya/ de yang tshogs zhing gtso 'khor re re la'ang ye shes pa rnams tshad ma re thim par bsgom gsung / skabs 'dir khrus gsol re byas na mos pa brtan pa dang /grib dang nad gdon nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang / lam rim gyi dmigs rnam skyong ba la blo gsal ba sogs khyad che bas/ tshogs zhing rnams kyi mdun phyogs su khrus kyi khang ba rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa dri zhim po'i ngad lda nga zhing sa gzhi shel dri ma med pa yid du 'ong ba nu tig gi 'od chags pa/ rin po che'i bla bre sogs rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'i khang bzang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ khrus khang gi phyogs bzhir rin po che'i spo sa phor 'phyang ba la a ka ru dang du ru ka sogs dri bzang gi dud pa 'thul ba/ sgo re re'i thad du khrus kyi rdzing bu gru bzhi ba me tog sna tshogs pas brgyan cing / 'og gzhi 34

gser gyi bye ma brdal ba chu dwangs zhing bsil ba yid du 'ong ba dri ma thams cad 'khrud pa'i nus pa can 'khyil ba la phyogs rer rin po che'i them skas 'bab stegs kyi rnam par yod pa/ khrus khang gi dbus su seng khri sogs rang rang gi bzhugs gnas gsal btab/ de nas khrus kyi khang ba shin tu dri zhim pa/ /mas sogs brjod pa dang mnyam du tshogs khying na bza' med par khrus khang gi nang du byon nas khri rnams la 'khod par bsam la/ rang 'u sa lha grangs dang mnyam par sprul nas lag tu bum pa thogs te rdzong bu rnams las /chu bcus nas tshogs zhing rnams la khrus phul bas gdul bya'i snang bo'i dri ma thams cad dag cing / thugs rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can 'khrungs par bsam zhing / khrus dang sku dbyi gang 'os kyi gos rgyan 'bul ba sogs bya la brel dus ma byas kyang chog go/ sbyor ba'i chos lnga ba bsag sbyang gi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa dbul ba ni/ dang 'u sa zhing gi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang ma nyam par sprul nas phyag bya bar bsams te/ sangs rgyas tham/sa cad 'dus pa'i sku/ / rdo rje 'dzin nga/'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum/ gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rna mas 'a/ phyag 'tsha la lo/ /phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa 'e sku / /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i gsung / / ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs/ / shākya'i gtso bo de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde/ /mchog sde dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i sde/ /seng bzang ku sa li gnyis gser gling ba/ /rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud 9 tsa phyag 'a tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs yod med phyogs 'jig klu sgrub dang / /zla ba grags pa rigs pa'i khu byug che/ /sangs rgyas dgongs skyong 'phags pa yab sras te/ /zab mo lta ba'i brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang / /mchog gzigs te lo ba dang nā ro ba/ /dpal mchog ṭo bhi ba dang gro ti sha/ nyams len byin rlabs brgyud la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha ba/ /blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' bsgrubs pas/ / mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dpal la dbang bsgyu ra zhing / / blo bzang chos kyi mdun sa mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /'jam dpal rgya ma tsho'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /35

dge legs rab da gar tshogs gnyis goms pa'i mthus/ / dpa' ldan sku bzhi'i go 'phang mchog brnyes kyang / / bzang bo'i ma dzad pas gdun bya mi 'dor ba'i/ /dpal lda na bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rab 'byams chos kyi dgongs don 'byed pa la/ /mkhas mang dbus na rgyal mtshan tog ltar ma/dzes/ /dpal ldan klu sgrub gnyis pa chos kyi rje/ / bzang po'i mtshan can zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs pa'i chos rnams kyi/ /bcud rnams bsdus nas nyams su blangs pa'i mthus/ /tshe gcig nyid la rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa/ /'chi med rnal 'byor mchog la phyag 'tshal lo /dpa' ldan bla ma bde chen dngos grub kun/ / kun la sbyin mdzad blo bzang rdo rje 'chang / /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rje btsun spru la ba'i sku/ /blo bzang don grub zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe thugs bskyed smon lam grub pa'i ma thus/ / da lta blo bzang bstan pa'i snying bo 'dzin/ / dgag sgrub spang blang bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dge legs yon tan ma 'u sa 'byung ba'i gnas/ / dri med blo bzang bstan pa'i khang bzang rtser/ / chos kyi rgyal ma tshan 'dzin pa'i dpa/la yon can/ / dpal lda na bla ma 'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dkon mchog gsum gyi mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus pa'i/ / rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lung rtogs dam chos kyi/ /bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / blo gros yangs pa'i skal bzang gdul bya'i tshogs/ / gtsug na bsod nams ye shes 'bras bu yis/ /legs dud rlung gi rgyal mtshan ltar bkra ba/ /dpal lda na bla ma'i 'bas la phyag 'tshal 'o / /rgyal tshab dam/ pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan dang / / rje btsun blo bzang dam chos rgyal mtshan zhabs/ / dge legs snyan grags rgya mtsho'i mthar khyab pa/ / rje btsun ya ba sras gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel dang / /brgyud pa'i ba ga' bab blo bzang 'phrin la sa zhabs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug blo bzang rnam rgyal te/ /mkhas grub dam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ngag gi dbang phyug rbhe btsun tsong kha ba'i/ / mdo sngags legs bshad chos kyi rgya mtsho che/ /byams pa'i 'gro la spel ba'i snying stobs can/ /bka' drin 36

mtshungs med zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs padma'i tshal/ /dpal ldan ye shes 'od kyis 'byed mdzad cing / /ris med 'gro ba'i 'dren pa kun gyi gtso/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal/ lo/ /snang ba mtha' yas blo bzang ye shes so gas/ / rgyal kun spyi gzugs bshes gnyen du ma yis/ / rjes bzung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rje/ /drin can bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshar lo/ /mkhas grub chen po chos kyi rdo rje zhabs/ /rje btsun blo bzang rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo/ / bshes gnyen dam pa bsam gtan da ra rgyas te/ /drin can bla ma gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / sems ngapa' chen po byams pa dge legs rje/ / rdo rje 'chang dngos bstan pa rab rgyas zhabs/ / snang ba mtha' yas phyogs 'a sa rnam rgyal dpal/ / bka' drin mtshungs med gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / blo bzang chos kyi dgongs don 'dab brgya'i tshal / / mkhyen rab lang tsho dar ba'i 'od stong gis/ / rgyas mdzad blo gsal skal bzang bung ba'i gnyen/ /bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang / / gang la gang 'dul bshes gnye na tshul bzung nas/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i/ /drin can bla ma/ rnam/sa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ / skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ / 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo ji snyed su dgas/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa so/ so'i dmigs rnam shes shing gas 'a btab ste phul/ long yod dus mchod pa'i mgor/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho zhes sogs kyis chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ rol mo da nga / 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid ṣka bdun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs dbul ba dang / bshags pa'i mgor ltung ba shags/ spyi bshags sogs bshags bsdam la nan tan bya'o/ / de nas dmigs pa gsal bar byas la maṇḍal dbu' ba ni/ chom bu so bdun ma'am nyer gsum ma dang / tshom bu bdun ma sogs 'bul ba na/ mdun du maṇḍal bshams pa de nyid gling bzhi ri rab la sogs pa sto nga gsum 'bum phrag grangs med pa rgya khyon nam mkha' ji srid par khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mos nas 'bul ba yin gyi / rgyang ring bo na gnas pa'i tshul gyis 'bul ba min gsung / dper na/ rdul 37

gcig gi steng du rdul bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas la sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis bskor nas bzhugs par sgom pa so gas dang 'dra bas 'di lta bu la 'gal ba yod pa min no/ /maṇḍal phul nas don chen ngo gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs di ni/ bshes gnyen la ma gus pa nas bzung ste bdag gnyis su mtsha na mar 'dzin pa'i bar gyi phyin ci lo ga gi blo sna mtha' dag 'gag pa dang / bshes gnyen la gus pa sogs phyin ci ma 'o ga pa'i blo sna mtha' dag bde blag tu skye ba dang / rkyen phyi nang gi bar gcod tham sa cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs pa la na gsum la sogs pa mang du bya/ sbyor ba'i chos drug pa gsol ba 'de bas pa man ngag bzhin rgyud dang 'dres nge sa par bya ba ni/ ra nga dang mtha' skor gye ma sems can tham sa cad kyis tshogs zhing rnams yid yul du gas la bar bsgoms te/ dad gus chen pos ma grin gcig tu gsol ba gdab par mos nas/ da pal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka 'a drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste / / sku gsung thugs kyi dngos lpu ba stsa la du gsol/ /zhes brjod pas mdun gyi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de nyid las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du rang dang zhal blta phyog sa mthun par bzhugs par gyur par bsam// slar yang / sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ci /la du gsol / /'es brjod pas spyi bo dang mdun gyi dpal ldan bla ma gnyis kyi sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lngaya/ khyad par du yang dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la brten nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ khyad par byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rang gzhan gyi rgyud la skye sa shing dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la tshozhugs pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi 'u sa ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur te dpal lda na bla ma'i go 'phang mngon du byas byung snyam du bsam/ de nas spyi bo'i rtsa ba'i bla ma/sa bdag gi slob ma 'di la lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rnam/sa da lta nyid du skye bar byin gyis ba rlab tu gsol zhes tshogs zhing rnams la ya nga gsol ba 'a debs pa'i mgron 38

gnyer gyi tshul lta bu mdzad par mos te/ 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ya sangs rgyas byang sems gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes ba rjod pas tshigs rkang dang bo gsu ma gyi skabs su rim bzhin ston pa byams pa thogs med gsum gyi sku 'i don spyi wal gyis gsal btab/ tshigs rkang ba'i ba'i skabs tshogs zhing spyi dang / khyad par sangs rgyas byang sems gsum gyi sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer dang bcas pa'i rgyun babs/rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par rgya che ba'i lam/ gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba 'a gegs byed kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'u sa dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ slar yang / sangs rgyas byang sems gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gnyis pa brjod pa'i skabs su/ sangs rgyas byang sems gsum gyi sku'i cha las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nas rang gzhan sems sems can thamasacad la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams 'a/ sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/khyad par rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rang gzhan sems can tham sa cad kyi rgyud la skyes par gyur snya ma du bsam mo/ de nas/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dbyig gi gnyen/ / zhes pa nas/ drin can bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i bar gso na 'debs kyi tshig dang lan gnyis gnyis bya zhing dmigs rnam byed tshul rigs 'gre/ khyad par rtsa ba'i bla ma'i skabs su mdun dang spyi bo'i bla ma gnyis ka las bdud tsi 'beb sbyang byed pa yin pas 'og tu yang shes par bya'o/ / de yang rgya chen spyod pa'i lam ni/bshe sa gnyen bsten tshul nas bsam gtan gyi nyams len gyi bar gyi thabs kyi cha rnams yin zhing /brtso na 'grus la gnyis ku'i cha yod/ rgya che ba'i lam gyi snying po ni/ dag ma dag gi sgyu ma'i sku gnyis dang / de'i yang snying ni/ longs sprul gyi sku gnyis sam zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku'o/ /de ltar rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba btab nas/ de nas zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs tshul ni/ smra ba zla mred 'dren mchog shākya'i tog/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab kun 'dus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ / zab mo'i don gzigs 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ /smra ba'i gtsug rgyan gsum 'a gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes brjod pas tshigs 39

rkang dang bo gsum gyi skabs sngar ltar sku'i don spyi rnams gsal btab/ tshigs rkang ba'i ba'i tshe yon tan dran pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pas/ tshogs zhing spyi dang / khyad par shākya'i rgyal bo sogs gsum gyi sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lnga snu/ khyad par zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa dang de'i snying bo'i rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba la gegs byed kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad spyangs/ lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ slar yang /smra ba'i gtsug rgyan gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes brjod pas rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nas ra nga gzhan sems can thams cad la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams 'u nga rtogs kyi yo na tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ khyad par du yang zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa dang de'i snyinge po'i rtogs pa khyad par can rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la skyes par gyur snyam du bsam pa sogs rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar rigs 'dra'o/kyi /zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa ni/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga rig pa'i shes rab/gtso bo don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs shes rab kyi cha rnam/sa yin zhing / de'i snying bo ni/dpe dang don zhu 'od gas la gnyis dang / yang snying ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ye shes chos kyi sku'o/ /de nas byin rlabs spung zhus bya ba la kun slong 'di ltar bya ste/ ga re bdag dang bdag 'dra ba'i sems can thams cad khams gsumyo/ 'khor bar 'khor snyeng 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyi dang / khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs shing skrag nas de las thar bar byed pa'i thabs la ma zab mo bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo la sogs pa'i tshogs zhing rnams la mnga' ba la gas pas/ bdag dang bdag 'dra ba'i sems can thams cad la da lta nyid du stsal tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing 'dun pa shugs drag tu byas la/yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur drin can rje/ ma gus pa chen pos bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gnyis brjod pa'i dang bo'i skabs su/ tshogs zhing thams cad kyi sku'i cha la sa bdud tsi sna lngaya/ khyad par du yang bshes gnyen dam pa bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten nus pa la gegs byed kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon dang bcas pa tham sa cad byang zhing dag lus dwangs gsal la 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur /slar yang / gus pa chen pos bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshes brjod pas/ tshogs 4 0

zhing thams cad kyi sku las dang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nasasnu/ tshe dang bsod namasasnu/khyad pa ra du yang bshes gnyen dam pa bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten pa 'o na tan kun gyi rtsa bar mthong nas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi dad pa dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi brka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas bsam/ spyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten par nus pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rang ga'an sems can thams cad kyi rgyud 'a/ skyes par gyur snya/ma du bsam/ de nas/ lan cig rnyed pa'i dal ba'i rten bzang 'di/ /zhes pa nas/ nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar byin gyis rlobs zhes pa'i tshigs rkang lan gnyis gnyis brjod cing / bdud tsi 'beb sbyang byed tshul ga'an 'dra ba la/ khyad par dmigs skor gang yin de dang de'i skabs kyi gegs byed kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs pa dang / de'i skabs kyi rtogs pa khyad par can rang ga'an gyi rgyud la skyes par bas ma pa gong ltar te/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes dpal bzang pos dmigs skor 'al shes zur du mdzad pa las shes par bya'o/ /thun mong lam sbyangs snod du gyur pa na/ /zhes pa'i skabs su sngags bla med dang 'a brel ba'i man ngag mo ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi len tshul rgyas bsdus gnyis bzhugs pa spro na bla ma dam pa'i zhal las shes par bya/ de nas/ ga re dal 'byor gyi rten bzang bo ni thob/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dang ni mjal/ dam pa'i chos zab mo nyams su len rgyu yod pa'i skabs 'dir dal ba don dang ldan par byas la/ bla ma sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa'i gdams pa nyams su blangs la tshe 'di nyid la bla ma sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya'o/ /gal te tshe 'di nyid la ma thob na skye ba gcig gam/ gsum mam/ bdun nam/ ji ltar ring yang skye ba bcu drug tshun la bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o/ /de'i bar la bla ma sangs rgyas dang skad cig tsam/ yang mi 'bral zhing gdams pa rgyud chad med par ston pa dang / de 'i ma/thu las sa lam/ gyi yo na tan thams cad myur du rdzogs nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i phyir (sngo'o snyam du 'dun pa shugs drag byas la/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /zhes so gas brjod do/ de nas tshogs zhing bsdu ba ni/ bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo'i thugs kwa'i lhu las 'od zer 'phros pa ma/tha' 41

skor na bzhugs pa'i zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad la phog pas mtha' nas rim gyis 'od du zhu ste/ rgya chen spyod brgyud dang / zab rno lta brgyud dang / nyams len byin rlabs brgyud dang / chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang 'og ma 'og ma nas rim gyis zhu ste/ rgya chen spyod brgyud byams pa dang / zab mo lta brgyud 'jam dbyangs la thim/ nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang rdo rje 'chang la thim/ chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams kyang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis thub dbang la thim zhing / gdan pad zla gnyis kyang thub pa'i seng khri la thim/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yang thub pa'i dbang bo'i thugs kur thim/ rdo rje 'chang thub pa'i dbang bo'i spyi bo nas byon thugs kur ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ seng khri pad zla gnyis kyang thub pa'i dbang bo'i seng khri pad zlar thim/ thub pa'i dbang bo yang rang gi spyi bo'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/de nyid yo/ngas su gyur pa las rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan 'a ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la/ rnam pa rgyal ba shākya thub pasnu/rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur paramos la/ phun tshogs dge legs snumagos phyag 'tshal/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs ma 'u sa 'bul/ /nongs pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / / zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor zhing brtan par bzhugs/ / dus gsum rnam dkar byang chub chen por bsngo/ /gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab rin chen bdun/ / rin chen maṇḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs/ / bla ma yi dam dkon ma chog gsum la 'bul/ /thugs rjes bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal dang bcas pa ma/dor bsdus phul ba'i rjes su phur tshugs gsol tshu'adebs bya ba ni/ rang dang rang gi mtha' skor na gnas pa'i ma sems can thams cad kyi/ sa mgrin gcig tu gsol ba 'debs par gyurapar bsams la/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ /thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrib bral chos sku'i bdag nyid bla ma lha/ /thub dbang ྾/ /bde chen longs sku'isnu/ /thub dbang snu/ /sna tshogs sprul sku'istu/ /thub dbang snu/ /bla ma kun 'dus bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ /thub dbang 42

snu/ /yi dam kun 'dusasnu/ /thub da bang snu/ / sangs rgyas kun 'dusaglu/ /thub dbang snu/ /dam chosaskru/ /thub dbang snu/ /dge 'dunas/ /thub dbang ྾/ /mkha' 'gros/ /thub dbang snu/ / chos skyong snu/ / thub dbang snu/ / skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma lhag pa'i lha/ / thub dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ / bdag dang ma sems can thams cad 'khor bar skyes nas yun ring la shugs drag pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa zhig myong ba 'di/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du ma bsten pas lan par 'dug pas/ da bdag dang ma sems can thams cad kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten nus par bla ma lhas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i bla ma lha'i sku'i cha las bdud rtsi sna lngas/ khyad par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam/ sbyo ra gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten pa la gegs byed kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag lus dwangs gsalas/ khyad par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten par nus pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rang gzhan gyi rgyud la skyes par gyur snyam du bsam mo/ /da ngos gzhi'i skyong tshul ni/ bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phan yon/ ma bsten pa 'i nyes dmigs bsams te/ bsam pas bsten tshul/ sbyor bas bsten tshul rnams grangs dang go rim ma 'phyugs par bde lam na ma myur lam ltar dpyad sgom gyis nyams su blangs la thun bsdu ba'am/thun der lam rim tshang ba re byed na dmigs skor phyi ma rnams kyi 'gag sdom ma mtha' sa bcad kyi steng nas bshar sgom re bgyis te mjug chog bya'o/ /dmigs skor phyi ma dal 'byor gyi chos skor rgyas par sgom pa'i tshe/ sbyor ba'i chos drug sngon du btang nas bshes gnyen bsten tshul skor bsdus tsam re bgyis te dal 'byor gyi skor lam rim che chung sogs nas blangs te rgyas par bsgoms la dmigs skor 'og ma rnams kyi 'gag sdom la gshar sgom byed pa sogs rigs 'gre'o/ /de yang sbyor ba'i chos drug gi khongs su byin rlabs dpung zhus skabs bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas lhag mthong gi bar gyi dmigs rnam dal bus gsal btab nas/ byin rlabs zhus pa re dang sbyar te bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang byas pas lam rim tshang ma'i khrid skyong ba'i go chod mod/ 'on kyang dmigs skor rnams re re nas dngos gzhir byas te yid 'gyur gyi myong ba ci thon gyi bar rgyas par sgom pa yin/ brel dus gong 4 3

ltar sbyor ba'i chos drug nyams su blangs rjes thun bsdus kyang rung ngo / /mjug tu ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po la dmigs nas gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas/ bla ma rgyal ba shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchod do skya bas su ma chi'o / /zhes lan mang du gsol ba btab pas bla ma thub pa'i dab nga po'i sku las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig chad nas rang nyid la thim pas rang thub pa'i dbang po'i skur lam gyis gyur/ rang thub pa'i dbang bor gsal ba'i sku 'a sa 'od zer 'phros/ ma/tha' skor na yod pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas sem sa can thams cad kyang thub pa'i dbang po'i go 'phang la bkod /rang dang sems can thams cad thub pa'i dbang bor gsal ba'i thugs par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar bo hūṃ ser bos mtshan pa'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ mu ne stukhu/ byere/ (54 snatā/ 25/ 65/ (1) smra// /tā// /khye/ byerdo| shā)she sdirdono༅ razhu traṭa nga/bsdo skyub bsku ba kub da ba/kun 2gab/ ngagarkusatra nga/ mang com/ myo4shugab/ /1/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs bzang bo spyod pa'i smon lam sogs dang / ma dor bsdu na/ lam rim smon lam bton te 'dun pa drag pos bsngo smon bya'o/ /thun mtshams su yang rig pa rgya yan du mi btang bar thun dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi dmigs rnam yang yang gas la btab ste bas ma pa de 'i rtsis zin par bya ba dang / dngos gzhi'i dmigs skor gtso bo gang yin de ston pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa blta zhing gzhan mang bo mi blta/ lam gyi rim pa rgyud la skye ba'i 'gal rkyen ci zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub phyir phyag dang maṇḍal skor ba sogs bsag sbya nga la 'bad pa dang / dran shes dang ldan pas dbang bo'i sgo sdom pa dang / zas kyi tshod rig pa dang / mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson zhing nyal ba'i tshe ji ltar bya ba dang / khrus dang kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la brtson par byed pa sogs ni lam rim chen mo las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar dben sa snyan brgyud kyi man ngag gis brgyan pa'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid nyams su len pa ni/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba mdo sngags mtha' dag gi snying bo bsdus pa'i gdams pa bla na med pa yin te/ 'di'i sbyor ba'i skabs kyi maṇḍal 'bul thebs gcig tsam gyis kyang ma ngon mtho tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs kyi go 'phang 'grub cing / brgyangs phyag 'tshal thebs gcig gis 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi dpal phun su ma tshogs pa lhag dang bcas pa 'grub nus na gzhan lta ci smos/ sngags kyi rjes gnang zab mo'i gnad kyang 'di 'i bdud rtsi 'beb sbyang gi nang du 'dus shing / rang gzhan sem sa can thams cad thub dbang du gsal ba'i sgo nas thurdo 4pa'i mtshan sngags bzlas pas/ lan cig brjod pa tsam gyis bskal ba brgyad khri'i sdig pa

'dag par gsungs/ la/ mthar gzugs snang tham/sa cad thub pa'i sku dang / sgra thams cad mu ne'i sngags kyi gdangs dang / sems zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes su 'char ba zhig dngos gnas la yod pas rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i 'khyer so gsum gyi nyams len dang / bla med kyi dgyel 'khor rgyal mchog gi spyi sgos kyi mdzad pa snod bcud sbyong ba sogs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa yang 'di la 'dus yong ngo / /des na malas grub thams cad spe khyen pas/ rang ngos nas nyams su len nus na dga' ldan snyan ba rgyud kyi man ngag 'dis mchog pa gang yang med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis nyin re bzhin thun bzhi'am ma mtha' thun gcig tu byas te lam gyi rim pa la yid 'gyur gyi myong ba 'don par byas na/ mdo sngags gnyis ga'i lam la bag chags thebs par 'gyur bas dal ba thob pa don dang lda na 'ing / rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyas par byed nus pa yin gsung ngo / / smras pa/ blo bzang rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab srub shing gis/ / mdo rgyad 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ / legs 'od myur lam zab mo'i gdams pa 'di/ /skal ldan thar 'dod 'jug ngogs dam pa la gas/ /'jam ma gon bla ma'i bstan dang mjal rlom yang / / phal cher bzlas brjod snga gas bsnyen tsam la rem / /snyan brgyud gdams pa yid ba'in dbang gi rgyal/ /'di 'drar nges shes rnyed pa nyin skar tsam/ /de phyir grangs med bskal bar mtshan tsam/ yang / /mjal dka'i blo bzang rgyal ba'i thugs kyi bcud/ / tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i myur lam mchog/brtson pas rtse gcig sgrub pa mthar phyin shog / 'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / tshangs spyo da bslab gsum ldan pa'i rten brgyud de/ / ma rgan mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /lam bzang 'di yis myur du sgrol gyur cig/ ces pa 'di ni dbang phyogs bstan pa'i sgron me cha har kho bo cha kun dge bshes bla ma'i sprul ba'i sku rin po che bstan 'dzin legs bshad rgya mtsho'i gsung gis bskul ba'i bor/ /mkhas grub dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos bsten pa rab 'byams smra ba blo bzang don grub kyis sug bris su bgyis pa'o/ / swa sti/gsung rab kun kyi snying bo'i bcud/ /nyams len snying bor dril ba 'di/ /skal ba zang thar 'dod 'jug ngogs su/ / mthong nas skul byed mchog sprul gyis/ / chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i phyir/ /mthun rkyen sbyar te par du bsgrubs/ /dge bas 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan/ /phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur cig/ maṅgā lam̐/45

༄7/ / byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen po las byung ba 'i brda bgrol nyer mkho bsdus pa bzhugs tres/ / na mo gu ru mañdzu shri ye/ rgyal kun yab gcig mkhyen pa'i gter/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rol ba la/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa zhes/ / snyan par grags pa'i dpal der 'dud/ / mgon de'i thugs bcud gdams pa mchog/ gsung rab ku na gyi nying khu nyid/ / legs bshad ma lus 'dus pa'i mtsho/ / tshul 'dir brtson pas 'jug pa ra pya/ / de yang byang chub lam gyi rim pa chen po 'di ji ltar bcom pa'i tshul ni/ rje bdag nyid chen po/ ar byang chub ye shes kyi gdan sa stod lung gnam rtse ldeng ngam yangs pa can du gra gas pa der/ rje btsun red mda' ba dang / rje nyid/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang ste chos rje rnam gsum zhal 'dzom nas dbyar zhal bzhes gnang ste/ bstan pa'i dag ther mdzad/ dgag dbye grol nas rje nyid byang rgyal ba'i dben gnas ra sgreng du phebs te/ brag seng ge 'dra ba'i zhol yang dgon du bzhugs/der 'brom ston pa nyid kyis bzhengs pa'i dzo bo'i sku 'dra byin rlabs can dbu yon ma che chung du grags pa'i sku thang che ba de dbu sngas su gdan drangs te/ lam rim brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs lam mchog sgo 'byed ljags rtsom gnang nas gdung shugs drag pos yu na ring du gsol ba btab pas/ thub pa'i dbang bo nas lho brag nam ma kha' rgyal mtshan gyi bar gyi bla ma ba rgyud pa rnams dang / khyad par jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ po to ba/ sha ra ba rnams zla ba'i bar du zhal gzigs shing / gdams pa dang / rjes su bstan pa'ang mang du bstsal/ mthar po to ba sogs gsum rdzo bo la thim/ a ti sha phyag rje'i spyi bor bzhag nas bstan pa tshol bya ba rgya cher gyis dang / byang chub sgrub pa dang sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs bdag gis bya'o gsungs nas mi snang bar gyar snaX/dri/༷/ la ri

pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung ba na/ gsang phu chos rje dkon mchog tshul khrims/ mkhan chen zul phu ba dkon ma chog rgyal mtshan/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang sogs kyis kyang bskul ba'i dge mtsha na dang rten 'brel legs par 'grig pas/ byang chub lam rim chen mo 'di rtsom pa yin zhing / de'i tshe je btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ nged kyis bstan pa'i nges 'byung / byang chub kyi sem sa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba gsum gyi sgo nas 'khrid pa'i lam der ma 'dus pa yin nam gsungs pa la/ 'dus mod kyang de gsum gtso bor byas te 'a/ma sgron sogs kyi man ngag gis kha bskangs nas skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang sbyar ba yin zhes zhus pa dang / zhi gnas yan chad kyi rtsom pa zin pa na/ lhag mthong brtsams kyang gzhan la phan dka' rna rnadagongs nas thugs 'dun chung ngur song ba'i skabs su/ yang rje btsun 'ja ma dpa'i dbyangs kyis/ cis kyang rtsoms/ phan thogs 'bring cig 'ong gsung / de nas bla ma/ dang rje btsun dbyer med du byas nas gsol ba drag tu btab/ stong nyid la dpyad pa mdzad pa'i skabs su 'bum/ gyi stong nyid nyi shu'i 'gres rkang rnams mdun gyi nam ma kha' la dngul gyi yi ge bris pa'i rnam pa can dang / shog bu'i ngos la bris pa'i rnam pa can gyi nyam/sa snang dpyad pa mdzad res kyis 'ong bar snang gsung / de dag gi tshe gnyan chen thang lha dang / zhigs lha rgyug po sogs dkar phyogs pa du mas khyed kyi ma thun rkyen sgrub pa'i thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes sgo gsum gus pas btud pa na/mjug gi bsngo ba'i skabs/ lam/ bzang bsgrig pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub byed cing / /'gal rkyen sel byed mi dang mi min kun/ /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal bas bsngags pa yi/ /rnam dag lam dang 'bral bar ma gyur cig/ ces bcug pa sogs lo rgyus ngo ma/tshar ba mang du yo/da do/ /lam rim chen mo dgung lo zhe drug bzhes pa'i chu pho rta'i lo brtsams par mngon/ dgung lo nga dgu ba shing mo lug la dbyar dga' ldan du bzhugs ring sngar gyi lam rim chen mo las/ lung 'dren dang / dgag sgrub kyi spro sa pa phal cher dor nas gnad 'gag rnams bsdus te lam rim chung ba mdzad do/ /lam rim chen mo 'di ni/ khyad chos lnga'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin par bka' gdams chos 47

'byung chen po las gsungs te/ bshad bya khyad par du 'phags pa/ rje rang nyid la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gnang ba'i gdams pa lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum la jo bo'i man ngag skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pas brgyan pa/ 'chad tshul khyad par du 'phags pa/ lam/ gyi gol ris bcad nas ngo bo ma nor zhing go rim ma 'khrugs pa grangs lhag chad med pa/ skul ba bo khyad par du 'phags pa/ mkhas shing rnam thar gtsang ba gsang phu chos rje sogs gong smos la sogs pa/ gnas khyad par du 'phags pa/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa byang ra sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas/ 'khor khyad nga ra du 'phags pa/ sras kyi thu bo gnyis lam̐ sogs pa skyes bu chen po rnams so/ / yang rje 'jam dbyangs bzhan pa'i rdo rjes/ cho sa phun sum tshogs pa/ skul mkhan phun sum tshogs pa/ bshes gnyen phun sum tshogs pa las gsan pa/ rtsom pa bo phun sum tshogs pa/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa ste phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan du'ang gsungs so/ / jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha'i gdams pa lam gyi rim/ pa la'ang bka' gdams gzhung ba dang / gdam sa ngag pa sogs nas brgyud pa'i lam rim ngo ma tshar rmad du byung ba mang du bzhugs na'ang / rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi rim pa che chung gi gdams pa la lam gyi lus spyi dang / yan 0/ga so so la sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sus kyang ma thon pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i legs bshad phul du byung ba'i khyad par bla na med pa yod par mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs so/ /lam rim che chung 'di dag bcoms 'phral sras kyi thu bo rnams kyis bshad sgrub zung gi sgo nas rgya cher spel bar mdzad cing / phyis su mchan 'grel gyi rim pa yang / ba so dang /'jam dbyangs stag lung brag pa dang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa rin po che dang /bra ti dge bshes rin chen don grub kyi lhag ma/thong gi mchan bcas rim par byung ngo / /de yang ba so'i mchan ni/ mkhas grub rje'i gcung ba so chos rje dngos ma yin te/khong gi sku 'phreng lnga ba ba so lha dbang chos kyi rgyal ma tshan zhes pas mdzad par gsungs so/ /stag lung brag pa'i mchan du grags pa yang khong gi gsung rgyun rim par brgyud pa dus phyis yang klung chos ma dzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin nam/ kha rog zhal/ snga nas ngag 48

dbang rab brtan zhes bya bas btab pa dang / rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i mchan ni/ rje de nyid pha bong kha'i ma/khan po mdzad dus btab pa ste mchan de gsum rim bzhin dmar mchan/ nag mchan/ ser mchan zhes grags so/ / bra ti dge bshes kyis lhag mthong chen mo la mchan zhib tu btab ste dka' gnad tham/sa cad bkrol ba mdzad cing / zhi gnas yan gyi mchan yod skad mi snang ngo / / dbu'i bshad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag la bzhi/ mchod par brjod pa/bshad par dam bca' ba/ mnyan par bskul ba/ bshad bya'i chos ngos bzung nas 'chad tshul gang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i khungs bstam pa'o/ /dang bo la gnyis/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha la mchod par brjod pa dang / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la mchod par brjod pa'o/ /dang bo ni/ na mo gu ru mañdzu sgo ṣā ya/ zhes pa ste/ bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal 'o / /zhes rwa 'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga/ bstan pa'i bdag/ po ston pa sangs rgyas la mchod par brjod pa/ sras kyi thu bo byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis la mchod par brjod pa/ shing rta chen po rnam gnyis la mchod par brjod pa/ lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag ma/dzang pa bo mnyam med jo bo chen po la mchod par brjod pa/ de dag las gzhan pa'i chos 'di'i bla ma rnams la mchod par brjod pa ste/ phun tsho gas sogs rim bzhin sho lo ka re re'o/ / gnyis pa bshad par dam/ bca' ba ni/ deng dus zhes sogs sho lo ka gnyis te/ rkang ba dang bo drug gis gzhung 'di rtsom pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan nas/ phyi ma gnyis kyis rtsom par dam bca' mdzad do/ / gsum pa mnyan par bskul ba ni/ gang dag ces sogs sho lo ka gcig go/ ba'i pa ni /'dir rgyal ba'i gsung rab ces pa nas phyi ma ltar bshad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te/de yang / bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ /zhes pa yan gyis bshad bya'i chos ngos bzung ba dang / de man chad kyis 'chad tshul gang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i khungs bstan pa'o/ /mchod brjod sogs kyi snga phyi'i 'bres gyis nyams len gyi rim pa 'di ltar bstan te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya ni/ thog mar bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha ngo bo dbyer med du bltas te/ bsam sbor gnyis kyi sgo nas tshal tsāpho ༵༵

bzhin du bsten pa gzhir bzung / de nas gang nyams su blang bya'i chos zab zab zer ba gang yin la yid mi rton par bsta na pa'i bdag po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lasakhungs thug pa zhig nges par dgos la/ de yang sras kyi thu bo gnyis nas brgyud pa'i zab rgyas kyi lam cha tshang la ma nor ba/ shing rta chen po rnam gnyis kyis srol phye ba ltar dgos/ de go rim mthar chags su nyam/sa su len pa ni dam pa'i man ngag la bsten dgos shing / man ngag kyang dpe cha la bla mar bcol ba lta bu ma yin par byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i bla ma'i zhal nas dngos su thob pa zhig dgos so zhes 'doms pa'i ched go rim de dag dang mthun par mchod par brjod nas/ de ltar nyams su len pa'i gdul bya de yang mang thos nyam/sa len gyi gnad la mkhas pa/gzur gnas blo lda na don gnyer sogs snod rung gi mtshan nyid tshang zhing / thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyi yid rtse gcig pa zhig dgos pa yin zhes/ 'doms pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa'i sgo nas snod ldan 'a/ mnyan par bskul bar mdzad do / /mchod brjod kyi tshigs bcad dang bo'i skabs su/ mkhas grub dam pa mang pos/phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i sku/ /ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i sku/ / zhes dang / de bzhin du/ phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i gsung / / zhes sogs dang / phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i thugs/ /zhes sogs tshigs rkang dang bo gsum/ po sku gsung thugs gsum ga la sbyar nas 'chad do/ /de yang / thugs la spyar ba la mi bde ba med mod / ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i sku/ /zhes dang / gzigs pa'i gsung /zhes ji ltar 'thad ce na/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang / yang sgras sku'i cha shas gzhan tham sa cad sdud cing / rdo rje ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin pas/ ye shes de nyid sku'i cha shas dbu skra sogs de dang de'i rnam par shar bas na/ de 'dra'i cha shas re res kyang phyag dang / zhabs dang / dbu dang / zhal gyi bya ba byed nus pas kun tu phyag 50

sogs dang / gzigs pa'i bya ba byed pas kun tu spyan dang / ga san pa'i bya ba byed pas kun tu gsan ldan zhes kyang gsungs te/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ kun tu phyag dang zhabs ldan zhing / / kun tu spyan dang dbu dang zhal/ / kun tu gas na ldan 'jig rten na/ /thams cad g.yogs te rnam par bzhugs/ /zhes dang / dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i kun tu gzigs pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad na sems can 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang / bde 'gror 'gro ba dang /ngan 'gror 'gro ba rnams de bzhin gshegs pas gzigs te/ de bzhin du gtsug tor gyis kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du mdzod spus kyang gzigs so/ / de bzhin du mtshan re res kyang gzigs so/ /de bzhin du dpe byad bzang bo re res kyang gzigs so/ / de bzhin du spu'i khung bu re res kyang gzigs so/ / de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams thams cad na sems can 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba dang / bde 'gror 'gro ba dang / ngan 'gror 'gro ba dag dus gcig tu gzigs so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mtshan dpe re res kyang gzigs na gsung gis gzigs dgos te/ mtshan bzang nang gi tshangs dbyangs dang ldan pa'i gsung dang / dpe byad kyi mnyen cing 'jam pa'i gsung gis gzig sa dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta na'ang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi sku dang gsung rnams ye shes dang ngo bo gcig dang / ye shes kyi bdag nyid kyi gzugs su khas len gyi/ ye shes yin zhes khas blang ba ma yin te/chos thams cad gzigs shing rtogs na shes pa yin pas khyab pa med do/ / des na sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i yon tan ni bsam gyis mi khyab pas lung tshad ma la brten nas yid ches kyi dad pa sgom/ pa gal che'o/ /shākya zhes pa ni/ sha ki nus pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings la rjes 'brel i phyis/ pu sha ka las so/ /zhes pas kṛta rkyen ya byin pas/ shakya zhes pa nus pa'i don la/ bu brgyud la aṇa 'os/ a rkyen sbya ra/ dbyangs dang po 'phel/ ḍā 'phel ba'i don dang / rtags mtha'i a phyas/ drangs pas shākya ste/ bsgyur na nus pa'i rgyud dam phod pa'i rgyud ces pa yin/51

'di'i gtam rgyu da 'dul ba 'u nga na bzhugs pa gleng 'bum chen po'i gzhi smad la bkod yo/da pas der ba lta bar bya'o/ / tshigs bcad gnyis pa'i don ni/ byams 'jam dbyang sa gnyis bskal ba ca grangs med pa'i sngon nas sangs rgyas zin kyang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras kyi tha bo'i tshotshal 'dzin cing / zhing khams rab 'byam sa rnam/sa sa'ang gang zir ba riring〉 dbasko la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston par mdzad do / /tshigs bcad gsum pa'i skabs/ lam rim chen po dag 'a ldan par rnying dang /lhun po rtse'i par gnyis kur/ shin tu dpag par dka' ba rgyal ba'i gzhung / /zhes 'byung zhing / par gas ra mang bor/ shin tu dpag par dka' ba rgyal ba'i yum/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /dang po ltar na/ shing rta chen po rnam gnyis kyis rgya la bas gsungs pa'i theg pa che chung gi gsung rab tha mas ca da kyi dgongs pa rtogs dka' ba rnams bkral ba'i don dang / phyi ma ltar na/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dgongs pa /bu se mas so so'i lugs su bkral ba la bya dgos pas gang ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med tshigs bcad ba zhi ba'i don ni/ rngo bo rjes/ byang chub lam gyi rim pa gsan pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la ga sum yod de/ rje btsun byams pa nas thogs med sku mched sogs 'a brgyud pa'i rgya chen spyod rgyud dang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs nas mgon po klu sgrub yab sras sogs la rim gyis brgyud pa'i zab mo lta rgyud dang / yang nde btsun 'jam dbyangs nas rgyal sras zhi ba lha sogs la brgyud pa'i rlabs chen spyod rgyud de /brgyud pa de gsum ga'i man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa jo bo rje la mnga' bas na brgyud pa 'i chu bo gsum 'dres zhes bya zhing / gdams pa de rnams skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa dang spyar ba lam sgron dang / theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi sgo nas khrid pa'i srol rgya cher dar bar mdzad pas na/ ma nor yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad bsdus pa'i/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin zhes bsngags pa don ldan gyi sgo nas ba stod par mdzad 52

pa'o/ /rgya che ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i brgyud rim la gnyi sa su byas pa ni/ skyes bu chung 'bring dang / spyod pa spyi bslab dang / zhi lhag gi skor la khyad par cher med kyang byang chub kyi sems sbyong ba'i gdams ngag la lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis byung ste/ dang po ni/sher phyin gyi mdo'i dgongs don ltar rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas blo sbyong tshul yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ sdong bo bkod pa'i mdo sogs kyi dgongs don bslab btus dang spyod 'jug las gsungs pa ltar/ bdag ga.an mnyam brje'i sgo nas blo sbyong tshul te/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyo nga don bdun mar grags pa'o / /tshigs bcad lnga ba ni/ rje rang nyid lam rim gsan pa'i dngos kyi bla ma lho brag mkhan chen nam/ mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / grwa skor mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang bo sogs la ma/chod par brjod pa ste/ 'di jo bo man chad kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma gzhan rnam sa 'a 'ang spya ra rung ngo / /rab 'byams gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig/ ces pa'i rab 'byams ni rab tu'am shin tu 'byams klas pa ste/ mtha' med pa'i don dang /lta ba'i mig ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam/ lam rim dang / skal bzang thar bar bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs/ te 'bab stegs sam 'jug sgo mchog ni/ lam rim rang la bya dgos so/ / lam rim 'di ni/ gsung rab rab 'byams lta ba'i mib/ lta bu yin te/de la brten nas gsung rab kun gyi dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /des na lta ba'i mig dang / 'jug ngogs mchog gnyis ka lam rim rang la sbyar na bde'o/ /dpal nā landa zhes pa 'di 'a / dga' ldan par rnying dang / gtsang lhun po rtse'i bar dang / par gsar mang bor/ nā lend+ra zhes 'byung ste/ rgyun gyi dbang bo zhes pa yin gsung / paṇa chen sku gong ma'i gsung las/ nā lend+ra ni 'dam bu'i tshal zhes byung ngo / /yang 'ga' zhig tu/ nā lenda dang / nā land+ra dang / nā rend+ra dang / nā la da zhes ra btags dang 'greng bu yod med sogs yi ge 'dra min ci rigs 'byung yang / yi ge dag pa rnams su nā landa zhes 'byung 'ing / de gzhir byas nas kha cig rgyun sbyin par bsgyur ba'ang yo da kyang / nā la 'dam bu dang / da ni spyin pa'i skad dod yin pas/ ming sngon ma nā la la nu mā a ga ma byin/ mā rjes su nga ro nar bsgyur 53

nas mtshams spya ra bas/ nā landa zhes grub ste/ 'dam bu sbyin zhes pa yin/ mdo sde 'a sa brgya ba las kyang / 'dam bu sbyin zhes bya ba'i grong na/ zhes shā ri bu'i 'khrungs yul la 'dam bu spyin du bsgyur ro/ /shrī nā landa 'di ni yul dbus rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen po'i pho brang dang nye bar yod la/ sngon 'phags pa shā ri bu 'khrungs shing / mthar yang 'khor dgra bcom pa khri phrag brgyad dang bcas te mya ngan las 'das pa'i yul yin/ bar skabs su bram ze'i grong ni stongs shing / shā ri bu'i mchod rten zhig yod pa la chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis rgya cher mchod nas gtsug lag khang chen po zhig bzhengs so/ /de nas bka' bci gsum pa byas pa'i rjes su theg chen gī dang bo'i slob dpon lnga brgyas der theg pa chen po'i chos bstan na shin tu dar bar 'gyur ba'i mtshan ma gzigs nas/ bram ze slob dpon tho btsun grub rje sku mched kyis gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs te/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod kyi glegs bam mtha' das bzhugs par byas so/ / des na nā landa'i gtsug lag khang thog mar 'debs pa bo chos rgyal mya ngan med yin la/ der theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar mdzad pa theg chen gī slob dpon lnga tshobargya dang / tho btsun sku ma ched dang / rgyas par ma/dzad pa slob dpon sgra gcan zin bzang bo dang / theg pa chen po'i chos 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas shin tu rgyas par mdzad pa bo ni slob dpon klu sgrub yin pas rgya gar gyi dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin par gsung / de yang chos 'byung 'ga' zhig tu/ rgyal bo dpal ldan chos skyong las rgyal rabs gsum tsam gyi lnga ba rgyal bo kau pā la zhes pas o tanta bu ri dang nye bar nā lend+ra zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang zhig bzhings pa ra bshad kyang de 'di min no/ /de ltar na nā landa dang / nā lend+ra gnyis so sor bya dgos so/ / bi kra ma/ la shī la zhes pa la'ang / par gsar rnying mang bo las/bri ka ma la shī la zhes byung ste/ a ti sha'i rnam thar chen mo las/ byang phyogs su grags pa ni bri ka ma la shī la zhes bya ba yin te/ tshul khrims kyi dri ngad ldan pa zhes bya ba yin skad/ kha cig ni/ gnod sbyin mnan pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba yin/zhes zer ro/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /yang be ka ma la dang / bri ka ma la zhes kyang 'byang 6)21 chosi mi

mod/ dpe dag pa 95sa/ bi kra ma la shī la zhes 'byung bas/ bi ni rnam bar/ kra ma la gnon pa/ shī la tshul khrims sam dang tshul zhes pa la 'jug pas/ bsgyur na /rnam par gnon pa'i ngang tshul zhes pa yin te/ mkhyen brtse 'o tsā bas/ bi kra ma la shī la rnam par gnon pa'i ngang tshul/ zhes bshad cing / yi ge bsdu ba'i tshe/ bi kra ma shī la dang / bi kra shī la zhes 'byung la/ mngon brjod mang bor yang / bi kra ma ni rnam par gnon/ /zhes bshad do/ /'di ni yul dbus ma ga dha'i byang ngos chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram na brag ri de'u ste dma' mo zhig gi steng du yod de/ dbus su rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen po'i sku tshad dang mnyam pa'i thub pa'i sku bzhugs pa'i lha khang / de'i mtha' skor du gsang sngags nang gi lha khang chung ngu lnga bcu nga gsum/ lha khang dkyus ma lnga bcu nga bzhi bca sa lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad yod pa phyi lcags ris bskor ba zhig yin la/der paṇḍi ta bzhugs pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i bya ba du ma mdza da pa/ khyad par snga gas kyi slob dpon mkhas pa mang bos bstan pa bskyangs shing / jo bo rje yang bod du de nas gdan drangs pa yin/ dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba yang shin tu bzang bo'i gnas ga zhi zhig ste/ 'di bzhengs pa bo ni/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i sbyin bdag chos rgyal dharma pā la zhes pa de yi na par chos/ 'byung dang lo rgyus ma/nga bo las bshad do/ /de yang slob dpon gyi ngag dag pa ni/ ma rtogs log rtog gi nor 'khrul/rnamed pa dang / slo ba ma'i rgyud dag pa ni/ mkhas grags dang klan ka 'tshol 'dod dang / 'gran sems dang phrag dog sogs kyis rgyud ma bslad pa dang / bshad bya'i chos dag pa ni/chos khungs btsun zhing skabs kyi brjod don tshang la ma nor ba/ thar 'dod rnams kyi nyer mkho nyams su blang byar gyur pa zhig dgos pa'o/ /'chad tshul gnyis kyi snga ma mi 'thad pa min yang / jo bo rje ni/ bi kra ma la shī la'i paṇḍi ta yin pas 'dir de dag gi bzhed srol dang mthun pa'i ched yin no/ /de mdzad pa bo nyid 'di'i yang mdzad pa bo'o/ /zhes pa'i don la 'chad tshul 'thad ldan yin min mang tsam yo/da kyang / rang lugs mdor bsdus na/ lam sgro na de mdzad pa bo a ti sha nyid/ lam/ rim chen mo 'di'i brjod bya gsung rab thams cad kyi gnad 'gag skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim 55

par bsdus nas nyam/sa su len pa'i man ngag gi yang mdzad pa bo yin/ zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ lam sgron mdzad pa bo de lam rim chen po mdzad pa bo yi na zhes pa'i don ga la yin/ de yang lam rim gyi gdams ngag gi khungs ni/ spyir mngon rtogs rgyan gyi gdams ngag yin zhing / khyad par du mngon rtogs rgyan gyi gdams ngag de nyid skyes bu gsum gyi la ma gyi rim pa dang sbyar nas nyams su len tshul gyi man ngag gi gzhung ni lam sgron yin pas/ de mdzad pa bo lam/ rim gyi skabs 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i man ngag 'di'i yang mdzad pa bo yin zhes pa'i don no/ /dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na ni jo bo'i rab byung gi ma tshan yin te/ dī pa mar me/ ka ra ma/dzad/ shī dpa' / dzñā na ye shes te dpa9ra mar me mdzad ye shes zhes pa yin/ a ti sha ni/ kha cig sa dhe lhag pa/ a sha ya bsam pa zhes pa mtshams sbyar bas a dma sha ste/ lhag pa'i bsam/ pa dang lda na pa zhes pa yin zer/ yang 'ga' zhig a ti sha la yi ge bsnan pa'i nges tshig gis bshad na/ kun spangs dge sbyong snang byed zer ba yin zer / yang a ti shin tu/shanti zhi ba ste/ yi ge bsdu sa pa'i a ti shi shin tu zhi ba'i don la'ang 'jug kyang /rje bla mas/ phul byung nas ni su ma brgya bcu/ /song zer zhes gsungs pa ltar a ti sha ni phul byung ngam phul du phyin pa zhes pa yin/ de'i don la bka' gdam sa chos/ 'byung chen por/ jo bo chen po 'di nyid mkhyen pa dang thugs rje phul du byung ba nyid kyis paṇḍi ta gzhan 'a sa khyad par du 'phags shing / bstan pa rin po che ches cher gsal bar nus pa nyi da du mthong nas/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis a ti sha zhes mtshan gsol ba yin te/ don ni phul du byung ba zhes bya ba'o / /zhes gsungs so/ /lo tstsha ba ni legs sbyar ba zhes bshad cing / skad dod ltar na/ lo ka 'jig rten dang / tsa kṣu mig yin pas yi ge bsdus pa'i lo tstsha ba ni/ 'jig rten mig ces pa'o/ / shar phyogs za hor yul rnamachog na/ /zhes so gas kyi skabs 'dir gong 'og tu drang sa pa rnam sa nag tshos mdzad pa'i bstod par tshig ris ji lta ba bzhin yod cing / bka' gdams chos 'byung chen por/ paṇḍi ta sa'i snyi nga pos mdza da pa'i bstod pa las/ zhes drangs pas gnyis gas mdzad par tshig ris phal cher 'dra bar yod pas khyad med do/ / za 56

hor ni/ sa hor zhes pa rgya gar gyi rgyal rigs shig gi ming zur chags pas za hor zer ba yin/ grong khyer ni/ bzo'i bye brag bco brgyad tshang ba la grong khyer dang /de ma tshang bzlu khyim gcig gnyis sog sa la grong dang / tshong ba mang bo yod pa'i gnas la grong rdal dang / mi rigs bzhi tshang ba'i yul phyogs la ljongs zhes brgyad stong 'grel chen las gsungs/ mngon brjod 'ga' zhig tu/ bye ba'i grong gis nges bcings yul/ /'bum phrag grong gis yul 'khor dang / / brgyad brgya'i grong gis grong khyer te/ /zhes bshad do/ /bi kra ma/ ni pū ra ni/ rnam par rim pa'i grong khyer zhes pa ste/ bi rnam par/ kra ma/ ni rim/ pa/ pū ra grong khyer zhes pa'o/ / rgyal bo'i khab dang / rgyal bo'i khyim dang / rgyal/ khang dang / rgyal bo'i pho brang rnams ming gi rnam/ grangs su mngon brjod dag 'a sa bshad de/ khyim gyi skad dod kṛ ha zhes pa de rnams ci rigs par bsgyur ba'o/ /gser gyi rgyal mtshan ni deng sang gser 'a phru zhes grags pa de yin zer/ rgya nag stong khun zhes pa'i don la/ kha cig glang bo che stong stong gi nang nas ghi wa nga yod pa'i glang chen re re tsam 'byung zhing de khun pa byed pas na/ de 'dra'i khun pa byed pa'i glang bo che stong yod pa'i don yin zer/ yang kha cigagaser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong ba 'i rtsibs re 'i steng du zas sna re ba'ag nas rgyan bo'i mdun du bskor bas mdun phyogs gang byung ba za ba tsam las gzhan rnams za ma nus te khun pa byed pa 'i don yin zer/ 'ga' zhig stong khun ni 'dod rgyal gyi brda yin pas sgra ba shad med gsung ngo / /de la thams cad mkhyen pa rol pa'i rdo rjes/ bshad pa snga ma rna mas rgya nag gi skad ma mkhyen pa'i bshad pa yin/ 'di'i stong khun zhes pa rgya na ga gi skad skrung kus zhes pa yin te/ tūng ni shar dang / kus ni rgyal blon sogs la zhe sa'i che 'bod yin pa sa na/ don la rgya nag shar phyogs rgyal bo 'dra/ /zhes pa yin gsungs pa ltar legs zhes bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma rje byams pa dge legs dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas dngos su thos so/ /dha na shrī ni dpal 'bras zhes pa yin te/ dha na 'bras so ba'i ming ngo / /birya tsand+ra ni brtson 'grus zla ba ste/ birya brtson 'grus dang / tsand+ra zla ba'o/ /'di grub thob a mo gha badzra chen po'i slob ma yin zhing /57

gshin rje gshed la nus pa thob pa bod yu/la phal cher du byon/ yar klungs klu dgon du yun ring bzhub/sa/ slar rgya gar du phebs pa de yin par mngon/ gnyan na re/de nyi ma sbas pa yin/ dam dzos bdud rtsi grub pas tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes te/ da lta yang lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la yo da zer ro/ / zhes 'byung ngo / /smyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi ni/lung phran tshegs kyi 'grel bar gsungs pa dang / bye brag rtogs byed chen po las byung ba mi 'dra ste/ bye rtogs las/ bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu/ rol mo'i bye brag ba co brgyad/ glu dbyangs kyi nge sa pa bdun/ gar gyi cha byad dgu bcas re bzhi gsung / yang rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rtsa 'grel du/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi gsungs pa 'di dang gta na nas mi 'dra'o/ / rig gnas bco brgyad la /'dul ba lung dang / ko sa la'i rgyan dang / ma/ dzod rang 'grel dang / dus 'khor dang / skyes rabs rgya cher 'grel sogs las gsungs pa mi 'dra la/ sgra rig pa zho /rgya gar na ind+ra byā ka ra ṇa sogs sgra mdo chen po brgyad yod par grags shing / slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag me long / pa ṇḍi ta 'chi med seng ge'i mngon brjod 'chi med ma dzod dang / sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung ga nas dang / 'a jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar sogs ni sgra rig pa'i yan la ga tu gtogs so/ / gtan tshigs rig pa ni/ phyi rol pa'i rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad ston pa'i bstan bcos dang / nang pa'i tshad ma mdo dang / tshad ma sde bdun sogs so/ / bzo rig pa la/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bzo gsum dang /'dul ba lung las bzo skyang bco brgyad dang / rgya cher rol ba'i mdo las yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / yang / lus ngag yid kyi rtsal gsum gsum ste pho rtsal sna dgu dang / gtam/ yig rtsis gsum/ mda' rdo mchod gsum/ bang rtsal spe gsum ste pho rtsed sna dgu sogs yod cing / spyir rig gnas thams cad bzo rig pa'i khongs su gtogs par ba shad pa'ang yod do/ / gso ba rig pa ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sbyor ba brgya ba dang / slob dpon dpa' bo'i sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa sogs mang ngo / /rtsis rig ni/ dus 'khor nas gsungs pa'i skar rtsis dang / rgya 58

nag gi nag rtsis dang / dbyangs 'char gyi rgyud las byung pa'i rtsis dang mkhyud spyad sogs mang du yod do/ /khyad par du lo bco lnga bzhes pa'i tshe/ zhes pa nas/ gro lung ba chen po gsung ngo / /zhes pa'i don ni/ jo bo bla ma zhig gi drung du bzhugs skabs bla ma de phyi rol pa'i rtog ge ba zhig dang bcod pas bla ma rgyal du nye ba na/ klad pa'i nang du 'bu zhig gi rkyen gyis smyo 'brog lang rgyu yod pa de la ngas nas bla ma de 'gyel/der jo bos bla ma'i tshab mdzad nas rtsod pas jo bo rgyal te mu stegs pa meg med du bcom zhes paṇa chen sku gong mas gsungs/ jo bo'i rnam bar chen po las byung ba 'gre' zhig skabs 'di'i gsungs tshul dang mi mthun par snang ngo / /rā hu la gupta ni/sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa'am gsang ba zhes pa yin/ grub chen 'dis mkhas grub khyung bo rnal 'byor 'pha na yul 'jog po ri la sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe man ngag sgo skyel gyi tshul du dzu 'phrul gyis phebs nas/ mgon po'i chos skor gnang zhing bod du zla ba drug bzhugs/ slar rgya gar la phebs te cho'i rig 'dzin brnyes nas ri nag po'i gtsug lag khang du da lta yang bzhugs par gsung ngo / / ḍā ki ni mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa ste/sngags kyi dngos grub grub cing nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i rdzu 'phrul sogs thob pas de skad grags so/ /jo bos/ ga'an du ma zad/ nub gcig gi rmi lam du'ang paṇḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dang mjal nas/ rgyud 'bum phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya nga gcig gam nga lnga gsan/ mnal sad pa na tshig don rnams ma brjed par 'dug gsung / gsang sngags la nga mkhas dgongs pa'i tshe/ nub gcig rmi lam du mkha' 'gro ma mang bos mdun gyi nam mkhar sngags kyi glegs bam mang bo brtsigs nas/rgyud 'di 'di skad bya ba yin/ khyod kyis shes sam zhes re re nas dris pas/ jo bos/sngar mtshan tsam yang ma thos shing / logs shig tu glegs bam chung ngu la kha shas bzhugs pa la/ khyod kyis shes pa 'di rnams yin gsung / yang rje btsun ma sgrol mas/ jo bo la/ khyed mi yul na rta 'i spu rtse tsam las med de/ sngags kyi rgyud sde mang bo mkha' 'gro ma'i la ga na yod pa yin gsung / jo bo'i thugs dgongs la/ mi yul na bzhugs pa'i gsang sngags la nga mkhas so snya ma pa na/ phyis bod du byon nas/59

bsam yas su dkor mdzod gcig kha phye nas rgya dpe la gzigs pas/ sngar gsan gzigs med pa'i rgyud sde mang bo bzhugs pas/ 'di rna mas slob dpon gyis/ lha klu'i yu9ra sogs nas gdan drangs pa yin par gda'/ gsang sngags 'di 'a mtha' yod pa zhig min par gda' gsungs nas thugs rgyal chag ces 'byung ngo / / bla ma dang yi dam rab tu byung bar bskul ba ni/ nub gcig rmi la ma du/ dpal he ru ka ma/dun gyi nam mkhar byon nas / rigs kyi bu/ a wa dhū tī spyod pas gar yang mi phyin gyi/ rab tu byung na phyis rab tu byung ba'i gdu' bya mang bo 'ong bar 'dug go 'es lung bstan/ yang rmi lam du/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'khor bcas gdugs tshod gsol gyin yod pa'i gral gsham na jo bo nyid kyang bzhugs 'dug pa la/ bcom lda na 'das kyis jo bo la gzigs nas mi ma gi ci la chags nas rab tu mi 'byung /zhes sa su ngas pa zhig rmis nas rab tu byung bar thugs thag bcad de/ dgung 'o nyer dgu ba la rdo rje gdan gyi ma ti bhi ha ra'i gtsug lag khang du rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ / bka' gdams chos 'byung chen por/ dgung lo nyer drug pa la rab tu byung bar bshad do/ / shī la rakṣi ta ni/ tshul khrims bsrungs pa'am go cha zhes pa yin/ rakṣi ta bsrungs pa'am go cha la'ang 'jug de kho na nyid kyi phyogs gcig la zhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ theg pa chen po'i sbyor lam bzod pa'i ming yin/ de yang theg pa chen po'i sbyor lam drod la snang ba thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rtse mo la snang ba mched pa dang / bzod pa la de kho na nyid kyi phyogs gcig la zhugs pa dang / chos mchog 'a de ma thag pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya'o/ / bye brag tu bshad pa zhes pa ni zhib mor bshad pa'i don yin la/ 'di la mchan 'grel du/ dgra bcom nyer sbas sam chos skyabs sam chos kyi tshong dpon gyis mdzad pa bam po brgyad brgya yod par grags gsung / bu sto na chos 'byung las/ sngon dgra bcom pa zhi lda na dang sgur bo la sog sa pa mang bos mngon pa sde bdun dang lung gi don bsdus pa bstan bcos bye brag tu bshad pa zhes bzhung 'bum phrag gcig tu 'o ngas pa zhig mdzad/ bye brag bshad mtsho zhes pa ni/ bye brag tu bshad pa rgya mtshor gzugs ca na gyi rgyan gyis ston pa 60

yi na gyi ming dngos ma yin 97/ bye brab/ bshad mdzod ces pa mi 'thad gsung / yang 'a ga' zhig du/ thams cad 'dod dang / sgur bo sogs dgra bcom pa lnga brgyas bya nga phyogs ri bo 'bigs bye da gar mkhan gyi gtsug lag khang du ma/dzad zer/ 'di bod du ma/ bsgyu ra ro/ /dharma rakli ta ni/ chos kyi go cha'am chos bsrungs zhes nga/'o/ /o ta na ta pū ri ni/ 'phur byed kyi grong khyer zhes pa ste/ o tan ta 'phur byed dang /pū ra grong khyer gyi ming ngo / / 'di sngon nang ba'i dge bsnyen zhig gis/ ma ga dha'i phyogs na mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor ba na ra dā zer ba zhig ro la ngas sgrub pa'i grogs byas pas/ ro langs kyi lce ral grir song ba de dge bsnyen zhus khyer te ri rab kyi rtser phyin nas gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas yud kyis bskor nas/ slar ral gri mu stegs pa la gtad pas kho lha yul du song / dge bsnyen gyis ro langs kyi lus gser du gyur pa des kho rang gis gling bzhi sogs mthong ba'i bkod pa lta ra o tan tu pū ra'i gtsug lag khang bzhings te/ dge slong brgya dang dge bsnyen brgya'i 'tsho ba lo mang bor sbyar ba yi na gsung / 'ga' zhig tu/ dge slong lnga brgya dang dge bsnyen lnga brgya zhes 'byung ngo / /ro 'a ngas kyi gser de rus pa la ma thug par bcad na/ de ring bcad pa'i shul do nub khengs nas zad mi shes pa 'ong ba yin zer / gtsug lag khang 'di slob dpon seng bzang gi sbyin bdag chos rgyal dharma pā la'i rgyal rabs gcig tsam gyi sngon du bzhengs par mngon/ bod kyi bsam yas 'di mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos zhal bkod mdzad nas o tan tu pū ra'i bkod pa ltar bzhengs pa yin zer ro/ /khyod ni nyan thos theg pa'i sgor zhug sa nas/ /zhes pa nyan thos kyi theg pa'i lugs kyi so thar gyi sdom pa'i sgor zhugs zhes pa yin gyi/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i sgor zhugs zhes pa min no/ / rnga rtsid la chags pa'i g.yag ni/ gangs g.yag yin te/ de yang bsil dum gangs khro da na gnas pa'i g.yag de rnga rtsid la shin tu chags te/ 'gro ba'i tshe rnga ma wa mjug ltar mi rkyong bar steng du gzar te shin tu gces 9spras byed cing / gal te rdza rtsid nyag re tsam shing la thogs na rngon pas srog dang 'bral bar mthong yang ma shi'i bar du mi gcod par bsrung ba lta/ra/ khas blangs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi chen po lta ci smos/ nyes byas 61

phra mo re'ang spyod lam thams cad du bag yod ba sten nas srog dang bsdos te srung ba'i don yin par 'dul ba'i rgya 'grel 'ga' zhig tu gsung ngo / /a ba dhū tī ni / rnam thar chen mor/ len dang 'jigs dang ngo tsha ba / / spangs pa a ba dhū tī yin/ /zhes 'byung zhing / skabs 'dir kun spang sa zhes pa'i don yin/ brtul zhugs zhes pa'i brtul ni/ bsdus pa zhes pa'i brda rnying yin pas/ lus ngag gi cha lugs nges med rnam sa bsdus nas gcig tu nges pa'i cha 'u gas kyi rjes su zhugs pas brtul zhugs zhes bya'o/ / u rgyan ni/ au ḍi ya na ste 'phur 'gro zhes pa yin/ zur chag pas u rgyan dang / o rgyan zer te rgyal bo ind+ra bhu ti byon pa'i yul yin/ de 9sha byings bsgrubs byas na/ o ṭwā lngan zhes grub pa/ ring 'phur ram mkha' 'gro'am/ 'phur 'gro zhes kyang byung ngo / /mu stegs kyi smra ba ngan pa lan gsum du pham par mdzad tshul ni/ jo bo rdo rje gdan du bskor ba mdzad cing bzhugs pa na/ lho phyogs nas mu stegs byi paṇḍi ta gdugs bcu gsum phub pa zhig byung nas de dang brtsad pas jo bo rgyal nas gdugs bcu gsum jo bo la phul / phyi rol ba thams cad nang pa la bcug yang sang phod mu stegs pa gdugs brgyad phub pa zhig byung ba la sngar bzhin tshar bcad/ de'i sang phod sgra tshad la shin tu mkhas pa gdugs lnga phub pa zhig byung ba'ang tshar bcad de nang ba la btsud par mdzad do/ /byang chub chen po'i pho brang ni/ dgra bcom pa nyer sbas bstan pa bskyang dus yul ma ga dha na sangs rgyas kyi zhal dngos su mjal ba'i bram ze mo zhig yod pa/ de'i bu bram ze dge ba zhes bya bas rdo rje gdan du lha khang bzhengs nas lha'i bzo bo mi'i rnam par spru la te/ sangs rgyas dngos dang 'dra ba'i ston pa'i sku bzhengs pa la ma/tshan mo'ang spyan 'bras dang mdzod spu'i nor bu'i 'od kyi snang bas khyab pa/ byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba zhig bzhugs pa de la ma hā bo dhi ste byang chub chen po zhes grags so/ / ma ga dha ni/ kha cig bying 'dzin dang / mnyam dka' zer yang / dbus gyur 'chang zhes pa yin te/ ma ni ma dhya ste dbus/ ga ni ga ta ste gyur pa/ dha ni dha ra ste 'chang ba la 'jug pa yi ge bsdus pa'o/ /padma sambha ba ni padma 'byung gnas zhes pa'o/ /dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang padma sambha bas bstan pa'i 62

srol btsugs pa la/ zhes pa yar bcad/ stong ba nyid kyi go ba gnad du ma song ba zhes sogs mar sbyar dgos te/ hwa shang gi lta ba gnad du ma song ba yin gyi/ slob dpon gnyis kyi lta ba gnad du ma song zhes pa'i don min no/ /hwa shang ni rgya na ga gi skad de btsun pa zhes pa yin/ ka ma la shī la ni/ padma'i ngang tshul zhes pa ste/ ka ma la ni chu rgyan te padma'i ming ngo / /bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gyi mtshams ni/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa yan la snga dar dang / de rjes bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dang / lo chen rin chen bzang bos bstan pa'i mi ro bsos pa la phyi dar zer ro/ /paṇḍi ta zhes pa ni mkhas pa'am/ mdzangs pa zhes 'byung / don 'gyur lnga ri ga pa zhe sa bshad de/ rig pa'i gnas lnga tshoshes pa'i don no/ /man ngag gi skad dod u pa de sha ni /'thad 'gyur byas na nyi bar ston pa zhes pa ste/ u pa nye ba dang / de sha ston pa la 'jug pas/ gnad don go sla bar ston pa'i don no/ /dam tshig gsum bkod ces pa'i dam tshig gsum ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum mam/ yang na khri la mi nyal ba/ chang mi 'thung ba/ phyag rgya 'dra ba mi be ba gsum ste/ phyi ma'i don ni/zas la lha'i phyag mtshan padma dang rdo rje sogs kyi dbyibs bya sa te mi za ba'i don yin gsung / gsang sngags la'ang brgyud pa lugs lnga ni/ gsang sngags mtha' dag gi brgyud pa/ gas nga 'dus kyi brgyud pa/ ma rgyud kyi brgyud pa/ bya spyod dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi brgyud pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi brgyud pa dang lngar rnam thar chen mor gsung / shanti ni zhi ba/ bha dra bo rnyi ni byang chub bzang bo/ dzñā na shrī ni ye shes dpal zhes pa'o/ /pi to ba ni/ pi ḍo pa zhes kyang byung bas/ bsod snyoms pa'i skad dod piṇḍa pa zhes pa zur chag par sems/ dharma ā ka ra ma ti ni/ chos 'byung blo gros zhes pa'o/ /mdzad pa bo'i che ba yan chad do / /shing rta chen po gnyis kyi lugs la mkhas pa'i bla ma gnyis ni/ thogs med kyi lugs la mkhas pa gser gling pa dang / klu sgrub kyi sngags la mkhas pa ri ga pa'i khu byug chung ba'o/ / de yang ku sa li chung ba ni bla ma byams pa'i rnal 'byor ba yin te /byams pa kho na khyad par du sgom pas de ltar grags/ rig pa'i khu byag chang ba 'di bla ༄ ༄ 63

ma a ba dhū tī ba yin par mngon gsung / che ba bzhi ni/ theg pa che chung gi gsung bye rab thams cad gcig grogs su gcig 'gyur bar go ba ni/ lung gi bstan pa thams cad 'gal med du rtogs tshul dang / theg pa gsum gyi spangs rtogs kyi rigs tham/sa cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du go ba ni/ rtogs pa'i bstan pa tha mas cad 'gal med du rtog sa tshul lo/ /gsung rab thams cad gang zag gcig gi 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs sha sti ga ston par go ba ni/ gsung rab thams cad gdams ngag tu 'char tshul dang / dka' tshegs med par gsung rab kun gyi gnad don thams cad nges pa ni/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag tu rnyed tshul dang / gsung rab thams ca da 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs sha sta ga ston par go ba la brten nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' la bzang ngan dang blang dor gnyis su mi 'byed pa ni/ nyes spyod chen po rang 'gags su 'a gro ba'i tshul yin/ sambha ṭi ni kha sbyor zhes pa'o/ / gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer shes pa/zhes pa'i gru bzhi'i don la/ dam pa 'ga' zhig skyes bu gsum gyi lam dang snga gas lam ste bzhi la byed gsung / de ba'in dul la/ bslab pa gsum dang sngags lam dang bzhi dang / yang sde snod gsum dang sba gas gzhung dang bzhi zer ba dang / rje sgrub khang pa dge legs rgya mtsho'i 'al nas/ nges 'byung bya nga sem sa yang dag pa'i lta ba'i skor gsum dang / sngags kyi skor dang ba zhi yin gsung / yongs 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bos/ 'di'i gru bzhi ni/ dper na/ sho gru bzhi lta bu la zer ba yin/ des ngos gang nas bltas kyang gru bzhi lam 'a ma rang yong ba bzhin du/ byang chub lam rim/ 'di'i dmigs skor ga 'dra zhig nyams su len yang de rang gi nang du bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas zung 'jug gi bar cha tshang ba re lam lam gyis yong ba yin pas dpe de dang 'dra/ grangs bzhi brtsi rgyu min gsung /yang / 'di bzhi brtsi rgyu min te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa mtha' dag grwa ma nyams zur ma chag par gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du khyer/ zhes pa'i don yin par rje 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bzhed ces dam pa 'ga' cig gsung ngo / / rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhas gru ba chen po rje byams pa dge legs kyis/ lam/ rim rang nas gong de ma 6 1

tha ga gsungs pa bzhin/ da lta nyams su len nus pa rnams nyams su blang ba/ dngos sumi nus pa rnam sa smon pa'i yul du byas nas de'i rgyur tsho gas gsog pa / sgrib pa sbyang ba/ smon lam gdab pa dang ba'i yin zhes gsung / 'di ni dpe chos rin chen srungs pa'i mjug gi don bsdus skabs/ dgra zin phye nas grwa bzhi nas/ / zhes pa'i grwa bzhi ngos gzung ba'i tshe/ lam/ phyogs/ bzhi nas 'bad dgos te/ sdom khrim sa dang / tshogs gsog dang / sdig bshags dang / dmigs pa la blo sbyo nga ba dang bzhi'i sgo nas 'bad dgos te/ zhes gsungs pa dang phal cher mthun no/ /lus ngag yid gsum ga yo sgyu med par drang bo'i phyogs su srong bas na drang srong zhes bya zhing /de la phyi nang gnyis ka yod/ sangs rgyas la drang srong chen po zhes bya'o/ / bshad chos su byas zhes pa ni/ bshad bya'i chos su byas pa yin gyi/ nyams len gyi gnad ston pa min snyam du 'dzin pa'o/ /phyi'i go rgya tsam gcod pa'o zhes pa ni/ phyi'i chos rnams la go rgya'am shes rgya tsam byed pa'i sgro 'dogs sam the tshom gcod pa tsam yin zhes pa'am/yang na/ kha phyi bltas kyi go ba rgya chen po tsam rtsad gcod pa'o zhes pa ste/ de ya nga phyi'i go ba rgya cher 'tshol ba tsam ma gtogs/ nang rgyud la skor ba'i nyams len sto na pa min snyam pa'o/ / nang byan tshud pa ni nang rgyus lon pa'am / gnad don rnyed pa ste/dper na/ rang gi nang gi bca' lag rnams rang sems la nges nges yod pa ni/ nang rgyus lon pa'o/ / be'u bum ni/ po ti chung ngu'i ming ngo / / dkyus ni dkyus ma'i lam mo/ / chos rgyab tsam zhes pa ni/ bshad bya'i chos kyi rgyab skyor tsam zhes pa'i don no/ /de skad smra ba thams cad gzhung chen po rnams thos pa rgya cher byed pa la mkho ba tsam ma gtogs nyams len la dgos pa min / zhes thos pa byed pa dang nyams len byed pa'i gzhung gnyis 'gal bar 'dod pa sha sta ga go de yang gang thos pa de nyid bsam sgom gyis nyams su blang dgos pas man ngag rnams gzhung chen po nas byung ba zhig dgos kyi/ gzhung chen po dang mi ma thun pa'i man ngag ni dor bya kho na'o/ /'on kyang gzhung chen por ma na ngag rnams 'a thor 'azlogs su bzhugs pa dam pa'i man ngag gis go rim 'khrugs sdeb byas pa tsam yin no/ / gaṅgā'i bye ma zhes pa 'i gaṅgā ni/ chu bo 65

bzhi'i ya rgyal gyi gaṅgā min gī/ chu klung chen po rgya ma/tsho yin la/ de'i bye ma ni de'i chu rdul gyi ming ngo / /'o na rgya mtsho la chu klung chen po zhes gang du bshad ce na/ mdo myang 'das las/ chu klung zhes bya ba ni rgya mtsho la bya ste/ zhes gsungs so/ /gaṅgā ni bod du bsgyur na 'gro ldan ma zhes pa'o/ /rang gi shas kyang de ni nyo ba'i rigs/ /zhes pa ni/phyi'i nor tsam du ma zad/ nang rang gi lus kyi sha bcad de rin du byin nas kyang thos pa nyo bar rigs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /de yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sngon shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas byon te/ shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo sde gsungs pa'i tshe/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di dbul po zhig tu skyes pas chos mnyan pa'i yon med pa na/ nad pa gcig la zla ba gcig gi bar nyin rer rang gi lus kyi sha srang gsum gsum bcad de gser gyi dong tse lnga la btsong nas chos ma/nyan par mdo mya ngan 'das chen 'a sa gsungs so/ /skyes kyi mchog ces pa'i skyes ni rdzong ba ste/ rang gi grogs bshes lta bu thag ring du 'gro ba'am/ de nas tshur 'ong ba'i tshe/ phan tshun yid dga' ba'i mtshon byed nor dum re ster ba de'o/ /skye ba'i rdzong la sa zhes pa'i rdzong ni/ brag rdzong lta bu ste/phyogs kun nas brag gam ra ba 'thug cing dpangs mtho bas bskor te thar dka' ba'i gnas kyi ming yin/ rna blags pa ni rna ba gtad pa/ tsand+ra kau mi ni dge bsnyen zla ba/brlang bo ni brda rnying ste/ rtsing pa'am rtsub mo la 'jug de la lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa rtsub cing mi legs pa gsum yod/ su ta sa zhes pa ni/ su dā sa ste legs pa'i 'bangs sam bran bzang zhes pa'o/ /de yang sngon su dā sa'i bu'am rgyal po rkang bkra zhes bya ba drang srong gi dmo/da pas mi sha za ba'i srin por gyur pa la rgyal bu zla bas btul te slar kho rang gi rgyal srid la bkod pa ste skyes rabs so gcig pa na yo/da do/ /brtun pa ni brtson pa zhes pa'i brda rnying ngo / /dpe mkhyud ni rang gi shes pa ser snas gzhan la sbas pa'o/ /do ker can ni mgo'i skra gtsug tor ltar bcings pa dang / skabs 'di'i bzhin pa'i steng na 'dug pa ni/ rta glang las gzhan shing rta sogs kyi steng na 'dug pa dang / 'di'i mtshon ni na/dung la sogs pa dang / dgra cha ni dgra sta dang mda' gzhu la bshad do / /sngon 'gro'i skor song / 66

bshe sa gnyen bsten tshul skabs ni/ bkri/ ba ni brda rnying ste / 'khrid pa zhes pa'o/ /drang ba dang / 'gugs pa la'ang 'jug go kha blan dka/ 'a ba ni kha bsgyur dka' ba'am kha phyogs par dka' ba/ gzer rnon brgya ba dang / btab pa dang /rgyag pa rnams yul skad kyi khyad par te don gcig go lag tu len pa na bstan pa'i tha ma la zhes pa 'di la/ ba so'i mchan las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i tha ma 'a zhes 'byung la/ paṇa chen sku gong mas/ bsta na pa'i tha ma zhes pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i tha ma zer rgyu min gyi/ gnas skabs kyi chos gang 'dra zhig bstan kyang de'i mjug tu zhes pa'i don yin gsung / blo la skyel ba la gzo ba ni mkhas pa'i don no/ /po to ba ni/ spras kyi po to dgon par bzhugs pas de skad grags la/ ma tshan dngos rin chen gsal zhes pa'o/ /li mo'i bu zhes pa la/ ba so'i mchan la sa/ spyan snga ba la li mo'i bu zhes thugs nye ba'i sgo nas bos nas/ zhes gsungs/ be'u bum sngon po'i 'grel bar/ po to ba rang nyid la li mo'i bu zhes 'byung ngo / /rnam thar phal che bar/ po to ba'i yum gyi mtshan le mo zhes dang / spyan snga ba'i yum la li mo ye shes sgro na zhes 'a byung / de ltar na po to ba rang nyid la sbyar na le mo'i bu byas na 'khrul gzhi chung ngo / /gla bo drin du bcags pa re zhes pa ni/ gling mo thugs la btags pa re zhes pa'i don no/ / gla bo dang / gle bo zhes kyang 'byung bas gleng mo zhes pa'i yul skad do/ / bsrel tam ni/ tshags byas sam dang / do dam byas yod dam zhe sa pa'o/ /sgrin pa'am grim po ni le shor med pa'i ming ngo / /nyan pa stangs zhan ni nyan stangs sam nyan 'u gas mi legs zhes pa'o/ /dge bshes ston pa'i bla ma lnga ni/ rgya gar ba gnyis ni jo bo rje dang / paṇḍi ta sgra'i tsher ma ste smṛ ti'o/ / bod gsum ni/ se btsun/'ang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug g.yung chos mgon no/ /sna sha sbyin du mi btub ni/ sna sha'am sna thag sbyin mi rung zhes pa ste/ glang ngam rnga mong lta bu sna thag gzhan lag tu shor na gar 'khrid sar 'gro dgos pa ltar/ dbang su yin la ster mi chog ces pa'i don no/ /yi mi 'phrig pa ni/ dogs pa'am rnam rtog mi bya ba/ a re ni/ skabs 'dir thugs mnyes pa'i tshig go/ bsngo ba ni mnyam zla'am 'gran pa/ rna ba ta zhes 6 7

pa'i ta ni/ cung ma rangs pa'i yul skad de/ yu 'a skad 'ga' zhib/ la rna ba rang zer ba lta bu'o/ /nod pa ni len pa dang thob pa dang bzhag pa la'ang 'jug mnos pa ni thob zin pa dang blangs pa dang bsams pa la 'jug go/ 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor ston pa ni/ sa ngas rgyas 'khor bcas mthong bar byed pa/ mchod pa'i rnam grangs so sor phye tshe / rnyed pa ni gco bor nor longs spyod 'bul ba dang / bsnyen bkur ni bza' bca' dang btung ba 'bul ba dang / bkur sti ni phyag dang sngon du ldang ba sogs gus pa byed pa dang / rim gro ni bsnyun g.yog dang zhabs phyis sgrub pa dang / sri zhu ni khrus dang sku mnye dang dril phyis byed pa dang / ri mor bya ba ni /'u sa ngag gis zhes bya ba dang / rjed par bya ba ni/ yon tan dran te yid kyis 'du da pa la gtso bor 'jug mod/ 'o na kyang skabs thob kyis bye brag pa la nd+ra ra tshul nges pa med do/ /gtsigs pa bzung ba ni/ rtsis ka blangs pa zhes pa yin la/ skabs 'dir zhal bzhes zhus pa'i don te/ ba/tsigs bzung / khas blangs/ dam bca'/chad byas/ 'gal bzung rnams ming gi rnam grangs su ma/ngon brjod sogs las bshad do/ /ja sun re ni/ ja phor ba re zhes pa'i yul skad/ nga la ta zhes pa ni nga la ni'am nga la da ni zhes pa'o/ / brgyad bkag ni/ brda rnying yin te/ bka' bkyon nam bsdigs pa'i ming yin/ de yang brgyad bkag dang / rgya gad dang / bsdigs pa/gshe ba/ spyo ba/ spyos nga// bkyon pa rnam sa yul skad kyi khyad par ma gtogs phal cher don 'dra'o/ / bsdigs pa'am bkyon tshul rnal nang gses khyad par mang phyir/ brda rnying las/ brgyad bkag ni khas smras sam bkyon pa/ spyo ba dang brgyad pa ni 'thab pa'am smad pa/ zhes dang / yang spyos ba ni 'thab pa ma kha smras/ zhes dang /mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos rnams su/ brgyad bkag ni/ bsdigs pa'ang 'ji gas pa skyed pa'i tshig ces dang / yang brgyad bkag ni/ gdong du sal ba dang / smod pa dang / rma phab pa/ zhes dang / co 'dri ba/ brnyas thabs byed pa/ kyal ka byed pa/ yongs su lab pa/ tshar bcad pa zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa rnams 'ga' zhig yul skad kyi khyang par dang / la la bkyon tshul gyi khyad 68

par yin pas de 'dra'i rigs la blo sbubs 'thum gyi som nyi mi bya bar skabs thob kyi khyad nga/ra shes pa gal che'o/ / yon tan rnam par 'phrul ba ni/ gzhan blo sgyur ba'i yon tan sna tshogs pa'i don no/ /'o skol phal du slog hrul du 'gro ba ni/ bdag cag bla ma phal cher gyi drung du rgyug rgyug mang na slog hrul te/ pags pa'i gos rnying ral rul lta bur 'gro ba yin te/ pags gos ral ru' de sa 'a drud na sdur ma/ ste rtswa dang tsher ma khye lud skam po sogs 'byar la gser rdog po mi 'byar/ zhes pa'i don no/ /thams cad du yud yud byas pa ni/ thams cad kyi rtsar rgyug rgyug byas pa zhes pa'i yul ska da do/ /mi bzad pa ni/ drag po/ drag shul/ mi sdug pa/ tshabs chen/ rtsub drag sogs kyi brda rnying yin/ me sha can ni/ sdig pa ra tsa dang / dur khrod kyi mi sha za ba'i rtsod sogs la bshad pa yo/da kyang / rme sha can rigs ngan shan pa la bya bar gzhung khungs btsun ma/nga bor 'byung ngo / /tha ba ni/ rtsub pa dang / sra mkhregs kyi ming dang / 'jungs pa ni/ zhen chags che ba'am ser sna'i brda rnying ngo / /dong ba ni/ mda' shubs kyi ming ste/ dong ba/ sag thag stag ral/ ma da' shubs rnam grangs su bshad do/ /'bring las mi thengs ni/ 'bring tsam 'a sa yan mi 'gro zhes pa ste/ 'gro dka' ba'i don no/ /mchad ka ba zhes pa'i mchad ni/ dur gyi ming ste /khong mi rtag pa dran pa'i ched du dur bzhag sar phebs nas bzhugs pas mchad ka ba zhes grags pa yin gsungs pas/ mas 'phul dag pa yin/ bla ma bsten bdo tsa na spangs dogs yod ni/ bla ma bsten ran dus na bor dogs yod zhes pa'o/ /khri'u ni khri chung ngu / g.yam la rgyug pa ni zhor la rgyug pa zhes pa'i brda rnying / spos zhim po'i lde gu ni dri bzang spangs pa'i chu dang / phur ma tshoni dar ras sogs kyi thum po'o/ /'a nga du song ba ni ngan lang la song ba/ bob/sa ni skyed dam nus pa/ rgyags pa ni rgod bag gi dregs pa dang / bsnyems pa ni nga rgya 'a te/ 'dir 'gying ba'am pha rol gnon pa dang / 'tshag pa ni mdangs bzang ba'am/ nyams rgyas pa'am yan lag dang nying lag rgyas pa/ de la rgyags pa dang / 'chog pa'i phyir zas za ba ni 'dod chags kyis za ba dang / bsnyems pa'i phyir za ba ni zhe sdang gis za bar rje red mda' bas gsungs 69

so/ /lus brtas pa ni lus rgyas ba/ thum/ phras ni thum tsam gyis srab mo ste/ de yang 'jigs skrag dang bcas pa'i gnyid srab mo thum tsam thum tsam re byed pa'i don no/ /sangs rgyas kyis gan/ ba'i mi nyal ba thams cad du bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes pa ni nyan sa las byung ba ltar bkod kyang / 'di la nag mchan du/ nyal ba zhes bshad na/'og gi sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i seng ge'i nyal stangs las lhag chad med par nyal lo/ /zhes pa dang 'brel lam// zhes 'byung bar brten/ dam pa 'ga' zhig mi nyal ba zhes pa ma dag gsung / rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos/sangs rgyas kyi nyal lugs 'di lta bus mi nyal zhes gsungs pa sogs mi nyal tshul gang gsung sa pa de bzhin du bdag gis bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i 'du shes yin pas /'di la ma chan bu 'gar mi nyal zhes pa ma dag tshul 'dug pa mi 'thad dam snyam/ /zhes gsungs so/ / 'di ni ldang ba'i 'du shes la ga sum gyi gnyis pa yin pas/ nyal ba thams cad du bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa ni lda nga ba'i 'du shes dang ma 'brel la seng ge'i nyal stangs las lhag chad med par nyal lo zhes pa dang yang mi 'brel rgyu med par mngon/des na par gsar rnying thams cad las/ mi nyal ba zhes 'byung ba ltar legs snyam mo/ /mchan 'grel par ma dag las/ sems gnas dgu'i 'dod sems rtse gcig pa lta bu'i zhes pa'i mchan/ 'dod pa'i sa la zhes pa'i gong du dgod dgos pa mjug du bcug pa ni mchan bcug mtshams nor ba'o/ / zhe rtsigs med ces pa/ par rnying gnyis su zhe rtsis med ces 'byung ba ltar te/ zhe thag pa nas rtsis med ces pa'i don no/ / mkhas pa dang ku sa li zhes pa'i mkhas pa ni/ phyi nang gi shes bya'i gnas la mkhas pa dang / ku sa li ni/ phyi'i spros pa thams cad bcad nas nang la mchog tu gzhol ba la zer te/ de gnyis la phyi nang gnyis ka yod do/ /kha cig ku su lu ste ma bcos pa zhes pa yin zer/ 'ga' zhig gis/ mkhas pa'am dge ba can zhes pa yin gsung / rje sa paṇa chen pos/ ku su lu zhes pa ma dag ku sa li ni dge ba can zhes bya ba yin/ 'tshang rgya ba 'a dang bor shes bya tham sa cad la mkhas par byas nas ting nge 'dzin snying bor byed dgos pas/ paṇḍi ta dang ku sa li'i gzhi mthan zhig //rte/du/ ri gi

dgos pa yin gsung / rje bla mas kyang / ku sa li chung pa la/ 'gro kun brtse bas rjes 'dzin dge ba can/ /zhes ku sa li ni dge ba can zhes bzhed do/ /gud du bya ba ni logs su bya ba'o/ /dal 'byor gyi skor ni/ gong 'og tu drangs pa'i bshes spring gi 'grel ba ni/slob dpon blo gros chen pos ma/dzad pa'i rgya 'grel yin/ mi khom pa brgyad kyi gtam ni slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad do/ /rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga'i sdom tshig ni nyan sa'i lung ngo / /byang chub kyi snying bo la gnyis las/ gnas byang chub kyi snying bo ni/'og min dang rdo rje gdan lta bu dang / rtogs pa byang chub kyi snying bo ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes nyid la bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i 'byor ba bcu tshang ba ni/ dge slong 'char ka lta bu yin la/ da lta gzhan 'byor dang bo bzhi mi tshang yang dod thub tshang bas go chod par gsung / ji ltar glang bo khron zab kha nas 'khrungs pa yi / / zhes sogs kyi don ni/ rgya nag gi mtha' dang rgya gar sogs na glang bo che ri dwags lta bur yod pa de rnams kyi phru gu 'dzin pa'i tshe/ glang bo che gnas pa'i phyogs su sa la dong zab mo brkos nas de'i kha shing leb sogs kyis bsgribs/ steng du sa bkab nas rtswa bzang bo bskyed du bcug nas bzhag pas/ glang bo'i phru gu phyogs der yong nas rtswa de la chags te za bar brtsams pa'i tshe/ dong de nang du lhung ba dang /de nas dong nang du yun ring du bskor nas glang bo che 'dul mkhan gyis legs par btul nas dong nang nas bton te khyer ba yin/ glang bo che lo sum brgya bzhi brgya 'o na zhing / lo bcu gnyis na phru gu re skye ba yin brer ro/ /spyod 'jug gi/ ci zhig ltar stes zhes pa'i stes ni/ sta bas legs zhes pa'i don te/ shin tu dka' ba ltar yin pa la stabs ka legs nas rnyed ces pa'i don yin/ me'u zan ni nas kyi zan zhes rgyal dbang bdun pa gsung / yongs 'dzin khri chen ngag dbang snyan grags dpal bzang bos/ rme'u ni nas kyi brda rnying yin gsung ngo / /de la sne'u dang sne zhes kyang 'byung ste/'ga' zhig rme'u ni mar zan yin zer/ brnag pa ni bsam pa/ spyan snga ba zhes pa ni dge bshes ston pa'i spyan sngar gsol dpon lta bu mdzad de bzhugs pas spyan snga bar 71
