rim/ pa gsum gsungs pa'i gdul bya so so tha dad pa 'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir / 'o na /gzungs rgyal gyi rim/ pa gsum 'jog tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ bden bzhi'i khyad chos mi rtag sogs skyes bu 'bring gi chos skor dngos su ston pa'i theg chen gyi mdo rna mas gzungs rgyal gyi rim pa dang bo dang / rnam/ thar sgo gsum sogs stong nyid dngos su ston pa'i theg chen gī mdo rnams de'i rim pa gnyis pa dang / sems bskyed sogs theg chen gyi thabs khyad par can rnam sa dngos su ston pa'i mdo de'i rim pa gsum pa'i mdo la 'jog go/ 'di'i rim pa gsum dang / dgongs 'grel las gsungs pa'i 'khor lo gsum so sor 'gal lam/ mi 'ag la zhe na/ yum don gsal ba'i sgron mee las paṇa chen bsod grags pa'i phar phyin spyi don/ 'di 'i rim si dang bo dang / dgongs 'grel gyi 'khor lo dang bo gnyis 'gal ba kho na yin te/ 'di'i rim pa dang bo yin na/ theg chen gyi mdo yin dgos/ dgongs 'grel/ gyi 'khor lo dang bo yin na/theg dman gyi mdo yi na dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di'i rim pa gnyis pa dang / dgongs 'grel gyi 'khor lo bar ba mi 'gal te/ yum rgyas 'a bring bsdu sa gsum de gnyis ka 417

yin pa'i phyir/ thal 'gyur ba ltar na/ gzungs rgyal gyi rim pa gsum pa dang /dgongs 'grel gyi 'khor lo tha ma 'gal ba yin te/ dang bo de yin na/ nges don gyi mdo yin pas khyab/ phyi ma de yin na/ drang don gyi mdo yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/zhi 'tsho yab sras ltar na/ 'gal mi 'gal dpyad par 'os shing / 'phags seng gnyis zhi 'tsho yab sras kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i phyogs mi 'dod na/ thal 'gyur ba dang mthun par bya dgos te/ zhes gsungs so/ /gzungs rgyal gyi mdo 'di theg chen gyi mdo yin pas/ de'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin na/ theg chen gyi rigs can yin pas khyab la/ de'i gdul bya tsam la theg chen gyi rigs can gyis ma khyab ste/ de la gdul bya rigs can gsum ga yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rgyud bla dar ṭīka las/rang bzhin sna tshogs kyi rgyu can zhes pas rigs can gsum ga bstan te/ zhes gsu ngas pa'i phyir/ des na 'khor lo bar ba'i gzhung tshig tu gyur pa'i bden bzhi khyad chos mi rtag sogs bcu drug gtso bor dngos su bsta na pa'i ma/do rnam/sa gzungs rgyal gyi rim pa dang bo dang / der gyur pa'i rnam/ thar sgo gsum gyi stong nyid gtso bor dngos su bstan pa'i mdo rnams de'i rim pa gnyis pa dang / der gyur pa'i theg chen sems bskyed sogs thabs shes khyad par can rnam sa gtso bor dngos su bstan pa'i mdo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying bo'i mdo rnams gzungs rgyal gyi mdo las bshad pa'i rim pa gsum pa la 'jog go/ yang na/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum de/ gzungs rgyal gyi mdo las gsungs pa'i rim pa gsum gar khas blang bar bshad de/ de'i gdul bya tsam la rigs can gsum ga yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sher phyin gyi mdo gsungs pa'i tshe/ 'khor gyi gdul bya 'ga' zhig theg pa gsum so sor sems bskyed pa dang / la la rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu dang / phyir 'ong dang / phyir mi 'ong dang / la la dgra bcom thob pa dang / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sogs yod par sher phyin gyi mdo nyid las gsungs pa la dgongs pa yod pa'i phyir/mkhas pa 'ga' zhig yang na/ bka' dang bo bden bzhi'i chos 'khor de/gzungs rgyal gyi mdo las bshad pa'i rim pa dang po dang / yum/ rgyas 'bring bsdus 448

ga sum de/ tre rda 'dra'i 3 ma pa tshog nyis sa da dzee/ de/ba zhin gzhigs ba'i snying bo'i/ co dzra/do lda /tsho sdeX 'a drari'i rim snatshog su spa me la khrojog steci/ gtso che ba 'i sgo nas de ltarwa 'a jo ge lke ji ga 4po'i phyis 3 tshos zhi ra ro/ / don gnyeboyid 2kyi nu/chi na sel twa / /kyile ga sa bshashādage sgron mesasbas the bo/ /dbyings cananadagarnor baji blo grose te / / dge 0 sa ku nyol phanaji ñtsa slu ci gci/ sob ma sgo lle/ 1 — 44 khye

༄tsho/ / skabs lnga ba'i gzhung don chigs su bcad pa blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / bstan pa'i bdag po rnam 'dren shākya'i tog/ de sras thu dza mi pham mgon po dang / /'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras sogs/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ / dbang du bya ba'i 'bras bu rtse sbyor ni/ / sbyor la ma drod sogs bzhi dang mthong sgom dang / / bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor log rtog bcas/ /mtshon byed rna ma pa brgyad kyis bstan pa'o/ /de 'a dang bo drod kyi rtse sbyor ni/ /'dir bstan rtags ni bcu gnyis gang rung bo/ / thob pa'i nges 'byed cha ma thun dang bo ste/ / dbye ba chung ngu 'bring dang chen po gsum/ / mdo las bshad pa'i rtags rnams 'di lta ste/ / thabs shes khyad par can gyi rnal 'byor 'a / / shin tu goms phyir rmi lam nang na yang / / chos kun rmi lam sogs bzhin lta ba dang / /nyan rang sogs kyi sa la dga' mi bskyed/ /bde gshegs 'khor zhus bskor nas chos ston dang / / rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba sto na pa mthong / /7'di gnyis la nyi khri las rmi lam du sangs rgyas kyis chos ston pa dang / rdzu 'phrul sto na pa mthong ba la gsungs / 'phags pa brgyad stong bar rmi lam du byang sems dang nyid sangs rgyas su gyur te/ chos ston pa dang rdzu 'phrul sto na par ma thong spo gsungs pas na rmi lam gyi rtags 'a de 'dra gnyis yod do/ /rmi 'a ma 'dra bar chos sto na sems skye dang / / dmyal sogs mthong nas de spong rjes su dran/ /bden tshig brjod pas me yi gnod pa dang / /gnod sbyin la sogs mi min gnod pa zhi/ / bdud las zil gyis gnon pa'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /mnyam rjes kun tu sher phyin don la slob/ /sgom byung stobs kyis bde na zhen mngon gyur med/ /rtse sbyor mthu yis rdzogs byang la nyer gyur/ /de la dang bo brgyad ni 'bras rtags dang / / tha ma bzhi bo rang bzhin rtags yin par/ / rngog lo chen po blo ldan shes rab bzhed/ / 'di da ga rmi lam sad dus skabs gang gi/ rtags su 'jog tshul ma/nga yang 150

burnya shrīs/ /dang bo drug po rmi lam skabs dang ni/ /bdun pa brgyud pa sad rmi gnyis ka dang / / tha ma bzhi ni sad pa'i rtags su bshad/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i legs bshad gser phreng du/ /rang gi bzhed pa buddhā shrī ltar bkod/ / rnam bshad snying bo'i rgyan gyi tshig zin la/ /dang bo lnga ni rmi la ma skabs dang sbyar/ /drug pa bdun pa sad rmi gnyis ka dang / / brgyad pa sad pa'i skabs la sbyar nas ni/ / lhag ma bzhi la gsal kha ma mdzad mod/ /'on kyang sad pa'i rtags su phal cher mthun/ /mkhas pa paṇa chen bsong grags la/ 'ga' zhig rtags ni bcu gnyis po/ /re re la yang rmi lam sad dus kyi/ /rtags ni 'jog tshul gnyis gnyis yod par gsu/ngas/ /rtse mo'i rtse sbyor gyi ni ngo bo ni/ /'dir bsta na bsod nams rnam 'phel bcu drug po/ /tshang ba'i nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis pa ste/ /dbye na sngar bzhin chung 'bring che gsum yod/ /stong gsum sems can grangs mnyam bde gshegs la/ /mchod pa las kyang bsod nams che lha ga ldan nyi khri dang de'i 'grel ba las 'dzam bu gling gi sems can gyi grangs ni mchod yul du gsungs la/ brgyad stong ba dang de'i 'grel ba rnams su 'dzam gling gi sems can gyi grangs mchod pa bor gsungs pas gang ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /de bzhin rang rang sngon ma las lhag pa'i/ /nyin ma/tshan kun tu sher phyin yid la byed/ /spros bral mi skye'i chos la bzod pa thob/ /rgyu 'bras chos rnams bden par mi dmigs dang / /dge sogs snyoms 'jug thob las khyad par 'phags/ /lha'i ris thams cad drung du nye bar 'ong / /sher phyin mthu yis bdud las zil gyis gnon/ /ston pa dang 'drar kun la mtshungs par gnas/ /'di brgyad gang za ga gzhan 'a ltos phyir phyi/ /lhag ma brgyad ni nang gtsor gyur pa ste/ /thabs la ma khas pas bslab pa yongs su dag/ rtse mo'i mthu yis sangs rgyas rigs can 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid thob rgyu mtshan sems bskyed lhag/ phyin drug mi mthun phyogs kyi sems rnams dang / /gzugs sogs bden zhen mngon gyur sems mi skye/ / pha rol phyin kun bsdus na sa nyams len shes/ / theg gsum rtogs rigs phun sum tshogs pa thob/ / rtse mo'i mthu yis rdzogs byang la nyer gyur/ /de dag rtse mo'i rtse sbyor thob pa yi/ / bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba bcu drug go/ bzod pa'i rtse mo'i sbyor ba'i ngo bo ni/ / thabs shes 451

brtan pa thob pa'i theg chen gyi/ /nges par 'byed pa'i cha mthun gsum pa ste/ /dbye na chung 'a bring chen po gsum du yod/ /gzhan don snying rje chen pos sems can gyi/ /don rnam sa sgrub pa yongs su mi gtong zhing / /rang don rtogs pa mkhyen pa gsum/ gyi chos/ /sum cu'i rtogs rigs yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ /de ltar thabs shes brtan pa khyad par can/ /thob phyir nges nga/ra brtan pa'i rtse sbyor ro/ /spyor lam chos mchog rtse sbyo ra ngo bo ni/ /mthong lam dngos skyed ting 'dzin mtha' yas pa'i/ /sems ni kun tu gnas pa thob pa yi/ / theg chen nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi ba ste/ / de la dbye na chung 'bring che gsum yod/ /de ni mdo las stong gsum rdul grangs dang / /chu thigs tshad bzung rung yang byang sems bzhi'i/ /dge bar rjes su yi rang bsod nams kyi/ /tshad bzung med pas mtshon nas bstan pa yin/ /rjes su yi rang yul gyi byang sems ni/ /theg par dang bor zhugs dang spyod par zhugs/ / phyir mi ldo ga da nga skye ba gcig thogs te/ / rim bzhin sar gnas mthong sgo ma gnas skabs dang / /spyor rtse bzhi la byi ra ba'i lugs yod kyang / /slob dpon rang lugs mos spyod sa dang ni/ /ma/ dag sa bdun dag pa sa gsum dang / / sa bcu ba la rim bzhin 'dzeg pa yin/ /yi rang byed po chos ma/chog rtse sbyor ba'o/ / dngos bstan rjes su yi rang dge ba yis/ chos mchog ting 'dzin ji ltar mtshon zhe na/ / yi rang ting 'dzin dmigs pa yin pas na/ / gcig gis cig shos mtshon par byed pa yin/ / drod rtse bzod pa ma/chog rtse sbyor bzhi bo la/ / rtags dang bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba dang / /brtan dang sems kun gnas pa zhes pa ni/ /rim bzhin rtags rnams gsar du thob pa dang / / rtags de bsod nams 'phel bar thob pa dang / / rnam 'phel rtogs pa brtan por thob pa dang / / de nyid mthong lam dngos su 'dren nus kyi/ /ting nge 'dzin du gyur pa thob pas so/ /de ltar spang bya rtogs pa mngon gyur pa'i/ /gnyen po sgom tshul drod sogs bzhi bshad nas/ /gnyis pa spang bya'i sa bon 'joms byed kyi/ / gnyen po 'chad par mthong lam rtse sbyor ni/ /'gal rkyen spang bya rtog pa rnam bzhi dang / / mthun rkyen lhan cig byed rkyen nyer len rgyu/ /'bras bu dang ni ngo bo byed 'a sa te/ /khyad chos lnga yi sgo nas bstan pa'o/ /spang bya rtog 115 2

pa de la gzung rtog gnyis/ /'jug pa gzung rtog ldog pa gzung rtog dang / / 'dzin rtog gnyis te rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / /btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis bcas rnam/ pa bzhi/ /rtsa bas mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyis 'chad/ /dmigs yul byang sems lam gyi 'jug bya dang / /ldog bya'i chos la dmigs nas longs spyad byar/ /bden par zhen pa'i bden 'dzin kun btags de/ /rim bzhin mthong spang 'jug pa gzung rtog dang / /ldog pa gzung rtog gnyis kyi rya tshan nyid yin/ /dbye na yu la gyi sgo nas dgu dgu ste/ / ngo bo nyid kyi theg chen 'a ma 'bras dang / / theg pa chen po'i rigs su nges pa dang / /mthong sogs lam ni yang dag 'grub pa dang / /theg chen shes pa'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul dang / /mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po sel skyed dang / / rang gi yul ni ji bzhin rtogs pa dang / /sems can dom byed pa dang bya ba'i las / /bya ba'i 'bras bu dang bcas yul dgu la/ /'jug byar dmi gas pa'i 'jug pa gzung rtog dgu/ /yul dgu rim par 'jug bya spyi tsam dang / /khyad par la yang lam gyi rgyu dang ni/ /lam/ gyi ngo bo lam gyi dmigs pa dang / / lam gyi spang bya 'dzem/sa pa 'i nus pa dang / / lam gyi 'bras bu rang gi don dang ni/ / gzhan don byed pa'i nus pa bya ba'i las/ / bya ba'i 'bras bu'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /sdopa/ pa gzung rtog gang la dmigs pa'i yul/ /srid zhi'i mthar ltung rtogs pa dman pa dang / / khyad par can gyi yongs 'dzin med pa dang / /gzhan don sgrub pa'i lam ma tshang pa dang / / thar par gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'gro ba dang / / gnyis don ched du bya ba log pa dang / / spang bya spong ba'i byed pa nyi tshe dang / /rtogs pa mtho dman sna tshogs pa nyid dang / / lam la gnas dang 'jug la rmongs pa dang / /rjes 'gro thob byar nyes pa dang bcas pa'i/ /yul dgu la ni ldog byar dmigs pa yi/ /sdog pa gzung rtog rnam pa dgu dang ni/ /yul dgu rim bzhin rtogs pa dman pa dang / /yongs 'dzin dam/na dang gzhan don rang don dang / /gnyis don sgrub pa'i thabs rnams dam na pa dang / / spangs pa dman dang rtogs pa dman pa dang / /lam 'bras khyad par can las nyams pa'o/ / rtog pa gnyis rnapo de dag mdo ra bsdus na/ /sems dpa'i 'jug yul theg chen lam 'bras dang / /de yi ldog yul theg 453

dman lam 'bras la/ /blang dang dor byar bden par 'dzin pa'o/ /dmigs yul rdzas 'dzi na ba tags 'dzin rnam gnyis la/ / so sor longs spyod byed du bden zhen gyi / /bden 'dzin kun btags gnyis ni rim pa bzhin/ /mthong spang 'dzin rtog gnyis kyi ngo bo yin/ / dbye na yu la gyi sgo nas dgu dgu ste/ / dang po rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i yul dgu ni/ /yon tan 'dzin dang skyon 'dor gang zag dang / / chos rnams bden par yid la byed po dang / /khams gsum gang dang nye bar 'brel ba dang / /chos ku/ na bden par gzung nas gnas pa dang / / bdag med la ni mngon nga/ra zhen pa dang / / chos kyi ngo bo btags catsam khong chud dang / / de bzhin mi mthun phyogs la chags pa dang / /mtshan 'dzin gnyen po byed pa bo dang ni/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'gro rnams gang zag ste/ /dang bo gsum ni blang dor dag dang ni/ /kun slo/nga bden zhen de yi nyes dmigs te/ /spyod pa la ni zhen pa rnam gsum yin/ /de nas gsum ni dngos por bden zhen dang / /bden med zhen dang btags tsam zhen pa ste/ /shes bya la ni zhen pa gsum yin la / / bdun pa brgyad pa mi mthun phyogs da nga ni/ /gnyen por zhen te spang gnyen la zhen gnyis/ / de brgyad rnaca/ mkhyen rgyu las nyams pa dang / / tha ma 'bras bu la sa mi nyams pa'o/ /dmi gas yu la de rnam sa la ni dmigs pa yi/ /longs spyod byed du bden par zhen pa dgu'o/ /de ba'in btags 'dzin rtog pa'i yul dgu yang / /ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung skyes bu dang / /la ma/ la lam min ngos 'dzin skyes bur btags/ /skye 'gags don dam zhen pa'i skyes bu dang / / dngos po ldan dang mi ldan bden 'dzin dang / /bden par zhen pa'i yul gyis gnas pa dang / / nyan thos la sogs rigs ni 'jig pa dang / / sangs rgyas don gnyer 'dod pa med pa dang / /rgyu ni sher phyin sgom/tshopa med pa rnam/sa/ /skyes bur btags pa la ni dmigs pa dang / /bar gcod phyir rgol ba yi dngos po ste/ /rim bzhin 'bras bu 'dod bzhin mi thob dang / /lam la phyin ci log tu zhen pa dang / /dgag sgrub dang ni chos ldan mi lda na dang / /gnas lu gas don rnams bden par 'dzin pa dang / / dman pa'i rigs nyams 'bras bu khyad par can/ /don gnyer med dang de'i rgyu sher phyin med / /nyes dmigs 'gal rkyen gyis ni 454

zin pa'o/ / de rnams mdo las gnyen po dngos su dang / / spang bya rtog pa phal cher shugs la 'phangs/ / bstan bco sa las ni de las ldog ste bstan/ / gnyis pa ma/thong rtse'i mthun rkyen rgyu tshogs ni/ /theg pa chen po'i rigs can gzhan dag la/ /byang chub thob pa'i thabs ni ston pa dang / /de'i rgyu sher phyin tshig don yongs gtod gnyis/ /lhan cig byed rkyen yin te nyer len ni/ / rang nyid mnyam rjes gnyis su rim pa bzhin/ /sher phyin sgom dang gzhan la ston pa sogs/ /bsod nams mang ldan tshogs la slob pa'o/ /'bras bu'i sgo nas khyad par dbu ma ba'i/ /rang gi lugs kyi byang chen bstan pa dang / / bden grub 'dod nas byang chen khas blangs pa/ /rigs pa dang ni khas blangs 'gal ba dang / /byang chen 'dod pas chos kun bden ston du/ /khas len dgos pa bzhi yis ston pa la/ / rim bzhin dri ma/ zad dang mi skye ba'i/ / zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa bzhi gsungs so/ /dri ma zad dang mi skye bden med du/ /mngon su ma rtogs pa'i mthar thug ye shes de/ /'bras bu byang chub chen po'i ngo bo yin/ / skabs 'dir 'grel bar byang chen thob pa'i lam/ /nyams su len tshul gang zag bdag med dang / /gnyis stong dang ni bden med rtogs pa yi/ /rnal 'byor sa ni rnam pa gsum/ bstan to/ /rtsa bas 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /ces so/gas tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang ba yi/ /gnyis dang gcig dang gcig gi go rim/sa ba'in/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dbu ma 'chad pas na/ /rnal 'byor sa yi gsum pa gtso bor bstan/ /ngo bo sbyin sogs phar phyin re re'i nang / /phyin drug bsdus nas nyams lan gyis zin pa'i/ /sdug bsngal chos bzod bar chad med lam ni/ / skabs 'dir mthong lam rtse mo'i sbyor ba yin/ /byed las spang ba la ni dbang byed ched/ /rnam grol lam gyis bsdus pa'i mnyam gzhag tu/ / seng ge rnam bsgyings ting 'dzin la zhugs nas/ / rjes thob tu ni rten 'brel lugs mthun dang / /lugs mi mthun la rtog par byed pa'o/ / des na skabs 'dir rten 'brel mtha' dpyod ni/ /spyi yi mtshon nyid so so'i dbye bsdu dang / /rkyen du gyur tshul rang rang byed las dang / /tshe du la rdzogs sa mtshungs rnam/ gzhag dang / /ji ltar sgom tshul sgom pa'i phan yon te/ /rnam pa brgyad kyi sgo nas shes par bya/ /gsum pa sgom 455

lam rtse sbyo ra bshad pa la/ /gnyen po sgo ma 'a ma spang bya rtog pa dang / / gnyen pos spang bya spangs pa'i phan yon te/ / khyad pa ra gsum gyis 'chad pa'i dang bo ni/ / rtsa bar 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur/ / zhes sogs tshigs/ su bcad pa gnyis gsungs so/ / skabs 'dir thod rgal snyoms 'jug bshad pa la/ / spel gzhi 'gog snyoms spel tshe bsam gzugs brgyad/ / 'dod sems spel na snyoms 'jug dag yin la / bsam gzugs brgyad ni bden pa'i rnam can dang / / 'gog snyom/sa tshor 'du rags pa 'gag pa yi/ /'phags pa'i rgyud kyi lda na min zhig la byed/ /spel chos 'gog snyoms dang ni 'dod sems te/ /'di ni rim par khams gsum sems dag las/ /zhi ba dang ni ma zhi'i mthar thug phyir/ / spel na lhag par rtsal byang 'gyur la dgongs/'di mi 'dod sems 'dod pa'i gzugs la sogs/ /snang ba'i shes pa zhig la byed par snang / /ji ltar spel tshul sbyor ba dngos gzhi gnyis/ /mthar gnas snyo mas par 'jug pa dgu bo 'a / /bar du spel chos gang yang ma spel bar/ /lugs mthun mi mthun gnyis gar 'jug pa ni/ /rang sbyor seng ge rnam par 7mkhas grub tham sa cad mkhyen pa'i phar phyin rnam bshad rtogs dka'i snang bar 'dod sems rtse gcig pa 'i gnas kyi char gyur pa'o zhes gsungs/bsgyings pa dang / /de rjes lugs ma/khyen kho nar snyoms 'jug pa/ /nye sbyor yin te da nga bo ring sbyor la/ / yar song stoms 'jug dgu dang mar 'ong la/ / bsam gzugs brgyad de gnas ni bcu bdun yod/ / 'di la kha cig bco brgyad zer rno da kyang /gser phreng las ni 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug la/ / zhugs thebs gcig las med phyi ra bcu bdun gsungs/ /nye sbyor la ni gnas dgu yod pa ste/ /de gnyis thod rgal snyo mas 'jug dngos ma yin/ / legs bshad gser phreng las ni nye sbyor 'di/ / thod rgal mtshan nyid pa ru gsungs na yang / / rnam bshad snying po'i rgyan las nye sbyor de/ /thod rgal dkyus sa bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ /spel chos gang yang bar du ma bcug phyir/ /thod rgal dngos kyi don ma tshang bar gsung sa/ /spel gzhi snyoms 'jug dgu bo gang rung la/ / spel chos 'gog snyoms dang ni 'dod pa'i sems/ / gang rung spel nas snyoms par 'jug pa de/ /thod rgal gyi ni dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug yin/ /dbye na yar song 456

mar 'ong thod rgal gnyis/ / de 'dra'i spel gzhi dang ni spel chos gnyis/ / gang rung gong bzhin spe17 na lugs mthun du/ /snyoms par 'jug pa yar song thod rgal dang / /lugs mi mthun du 'jug pa mar 'ong yin/ /re re la yang 'gog snyoms spel ba dang / /'dod sems spel ba'i thod bol gnyis gnyis yod/ / mdo yi dngos bsta na yar song 'gog snyoms dang / / mar 'ong 'dod sems spel bar gsungs pa ni/ / dang bor 'jug tshul mtshon pa tsam yin te/ /phyis nas dbang thob pa la der ma nges/ /'gog pa spel tshe spel gzhi bsam gzugs brgyad/ /spel chos 'gog brgyad de yi gnas bcu drug/'dod sems spel na spel gzhi snyom sa 'jug dgu/ / spel chos 'dod sems dgu ste gnas bco brgyad/ / yar song mtha' yi srid rtse nad chung dang / / ma tsham/sa 'dzin 'dod sems gnas la mi 'dren no/ /de yang cung zad zhib tu bshad na ni/ /thod thol ting 'dzin dngos la 'jug pa'i tshul/ /dang bor sbyor ba rnam gnyis sngon btang ste/ /bsam gtan dang bo de nas 'gog pa dang / / de rjes bsam gtan gnyis pa nas bzung ste/ / 'gog pa spel nas srid rtse'i bar du 'jug/ de nas 'gog pa de yi mjug thogs su/ /srid rtse'i nud chung mngon du byas nas ni/ /mtshams 'dzin 'dod pa'i sems su langs pa yin / /de ni spel gzhi bsam gzugs brgyad po la/ / 'gog khu4 spel ba'i yar song thod rgal te/ / srid rtse'i nad chung mtshams 'dzin 'dod sem sa gnyis/ / yar ma/ra gnyis kyi sa mtshams shes ched yin/ / spel gzhi spel chos gang du'ang mi gtogs so/ / ma ra 'ong 'dod sems spel ba'i thod rgal ni/ / sa mtshams 'dzin byed 'dod sems rjes thogs su/ / 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug de nas 'dod sems dang / / de nas rim par srid rtse na sa bzung ste/ /'dod sems spel te bsam gtan dang po'i bar/ /snyoms par 'jug rjes 'dod pa'i sems su langs/ / de nas spel gzhi snyom/sa 'jug dgu bo la/ /'dod sems spel ba'i mar 'ong thod rgal yin/ /ting nge 'dzin la rtsal ma byang ba yi/ / byang sem sa 'ga' zhig yar song thod rgal gyi/ /ma/tha' yi 'gog snyoms las ni langs ma thag/ 'dod sems mngon du byed mi nus pas na / /bar du srid rtse'i nung chung byas pa yin/ /de la dgongs nas khri brgyad stong ba 457

ru/ / srid rtse la ni nud chung byed par ba/sungs/ / dbang rnon 'ga' zhig de 'dra'i 'gog snyoms mthar/ /'phral du 'dod sems mngon du byed nus phyir/ /byang sems de yi da bang du mdzad nas ni/ /yu/ma mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum po las/ /de 'dra'i srid rtse'i nud chung ma bsta na to/ /'o na ya ra song ma/tha' yi 'gog pa yi/ /mjug thogs de ma thag tu 'dod sems su/ /langs mi nus kyang mar 'ong thog ma yi/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug las ni langs ma/ thag/ spel chos 'dod sems mngon du byed nus pa'i/ /rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na 'di la ni/ /'dod tshul mi 'dra kha shas sna nga na yang / /rang lugs yar song mtha' yi 'gog pa ni/ /srid rtse'i sems kyi de ma thag rkyen byas/ /mar 'ong thog ma'i 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug de/ /'dod sems de ma thag rkyen byas las byung / /des na de gnyis de ma thag rkyen la/ /phra rags khyad par byung ba'i dbang gis yin/ /dgos pa ting nge 'dzin la rtsa sbyong ched/ / sa mtshams sa gnyis pa nas 'jog pa yin/ / rnam bshad snying bo'i rgyan gyi tshig zin la/ /rigs nges dbang du byas nas sa drug pa/ /yan chad gsungs pa phal che ba la dgongs/ /de yang mdo dang bstan bcos rtsa 'grel gyis/ /gnyen po sgom lam rtse mo'i sbyo ra ba de/ /thod rgal snyo mas 'ju ga sgo nas bsta na pas na/ /thod rgal rnam gzhag shes pa shin tu gces/ /des na cung zad gsal bar bshad pa 'di/ /gzur gnas don gnyer ldan pa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /de nas spang bya rtog pa rnam bzhi yang / /sngar bzhin yul gyi sgo nas dgu dgu ste/ rtsa bas rim par bstan te dang po ni/ /'jug pa gzung rtog gi ni yul dgu bo/ / chos ni ma/dor bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis/ / brjod bya dang bcas de bzhin sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstangs 7bstangs pa ni brda rnying mgon dang grogs la 'jug pas 'dir mgon gyi don te/ de'i phyir bstangs pa dang btang ba gnyis gcig tu 'khrul nas phyir btang ba'i don du mi bya'o / /pas yongs su ma bzung gnyen po ru/ /sher phyin rnal 'byor yid la byed pa dang / /'das pa sbyo ra lam da lta mthong lam dang / /ma 'ong sgom lam gsum gyi yon tan ni/ /don dam/ med pa tha snyad du yod dang / /legs par mya ngan 'das par ba grod pa yi/ /sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam rnams de dag la/ /dmigs nas 'jug byar bden par zhen pa dgu/ /458

de rnams bsdus na rnam pa bzhir 'dus te/ /shes bya spyod pa lam gyi yon tan dang / /lam gyi ngo bo dbang du byas pa ste/ / rim bzhin gnyis dang ga cig dang gsum dang gsum/ / gzung rtog gnyis pa'i yul dgu 'di dag ste/ / byang chub sems mi skye dang byang chub kyi/ /snying bo chos sku yid la mi byed dang / /nyan thos theg pa yid la byed pa dang / / de bzhin rang rgyal theg pa yid byed dang / / rdzogs byang thob byar yid la mi byed dang / / dmigs bcas sher phyin gzugs brnyan sgom pa dang / / dmigs med gnas lugs sgom pa med pa dang / /gnas lugs sgom pa'ang med la mi rtag sogs/ /sgom pa med pa'ang ma yin pa nyid dang / / gnas 'u gas don ni ji bzhin min par zhen/ /de rnams la ni ldog byar zhen pa dgu'o/ /dang bo bzhi ni theg dma' tshogs spyo ra dang / / gnyis gnyis sbyar zhing de na sa ma/thong sgo ma dang / / mi slob lam dang de las bzlog pa dang / / yul la phyin ci log tu rgol pa ste/ / bdun du 'dus so rdzas 'dzin yul dgu yang / / phung bo lnga la sems can btags tsam dang / /phung sogs la ni chos su btags tsam dang / /chos kun tha snyad du yang sto nga min nyid/ /so skye chos la bden par chags pa dang / / byang sems gnas lugs chos la rab 'byed dang / / zhi ba'i dngos por ched bya don gnyer byed/ / byang sems theg gsum nges par 'byung ba dang / /nyan rang sbyin pa'i yon ni ma dag dang / /sbyin drug spyod pa rnam par 'khrugs pa la/ /dmigs nas 'o ngas spyod byed du bden zhen dgu/ /de rnams shes bya lta ba spyod pa dang / /nyan rang lta spyod dbang du byas pa bzhin/ /'dus te rim bzhin gsum dang gnyis gnyis so/ / de nas btags 'dzin rtog pa'i yul dgu ni/ / rnam mkhyen sgrib spong la ni kun rmongs dang / / lam shes sgrib spong la ni kun rmongs dang / / gzhi shes sgrib spong la ni kun rmongs dang / /sgrib kun zhi ba'i las la kun rmongs dang / / bde na gnyis ngo bo gcig dang tha dad la/ / kun tu rmongs pa theg pa che chung gi/ lam mi mnyam la kun tu rmongs pa dang / /bden bzhi'i chos nyid la ni kun rmongs dang / /nyon mongs rang bzhin la ni ku na rmongs dang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis su med la kun rmongs te/ /kun rmongs dgu bo skyes bur btags pa la/ /longs spyod byed du bden par zhen 4 19

pa'o/ /de dag bsdus na lam gyi sgrib pa dang / /ngo bo dmigs pa gnas lugs don dang ni/ /spang bya'i rang bzhin bdag med rags pa la/ /rmongs pa drug tu 'dus te rim/ pa bzhin/ / dang bo la ni gsum ste gnyis par gcig/ gsum pa la gnyis lhag ma re re'o/ /mdo las sgom spong rtog pa 'di dag kyang / /gnyen po dngos dang rtog pa shugs la bstan/ / gnyen pos spang bya spangs pa'i phan yon ni/ / rtsa bar yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis 'chad/ / don ni sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i sems dpa' la/ /theg gsum spangs rtogs rigs kun ldan pa ste/ / 'ag la rkyen sgom spang rim sa nad 'dra ba zad/ /mthun rkyen rgya mtshor chu bo 'du bzhin du/ /yon tan phun tshogs mtha' dag 'byung ba'i phyir/ /bzhi ba bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor la/ /rtse sbyor dngos dang log rtog bsal ba'o/ /dang bo stong gsum skye bo nyan thos dang / / zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan pa ste/ / rang 'bras rnam mkhyen dngos su skyed byed kyi/ /rgyun mtha'i ye shes de yi ngo bo'o/ /mdo las sto nga gsum/ skye bo nyan rang dang / / sems dpa'i sa la bkod ṅge'i dge ba bas/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas bsod nams mang ba yis/ / mtshon nas bar chad med rtse bstan pa yin/ / bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rnam 'chad pa la / /rtsa bar de yi dmigs pa dngos med de/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig byung dmigs pa ni/ /bden pa'i dngos por med pa'i chos kun dang / /bdag rkyen dran pa theg chen sems bskyed dang / /rnam pa rang bzhin gyis ni zhi ba'o/ /dmigs rnam gnas 'di shin tu zab pas na/ /bden gnyis 'gal bar smra rnams brgyud mar rgol/ / gnyis pa log rtog bsal ba 'chad pa la/ / rtsa bar dmigs pa tha dad de yi ni/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis bstan/ /de yang bden gnyis 'gal bar smra ba rnams/ /'bras bu rnam mkhyen nyid dang de yi rgyu/ /bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dmigs rnam/ la/ /yul gyi sgo nas log rtog bcu drug ste/ /dmigs pa dang ni dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /spros bral nges par gzung ba'i rnam pa dang / /rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / /dam pa'i don dang kun rdzob bden pa dang / / zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i sbyor ba dang / /spyod rten sangs rgyas chos dang 460

dge 'dun dang / / thabs la mkhas dang thub pa 'i mngon rtogs dang / / rtag 'dzin la sogs phyin ci log bzhi dang / /lam dang gnyen po mi mthun phyogs dag dang / /bsgom bya chos kyi rang spyi 'i ma tshan nyid dang / / de bsgom pa la log par rtog pa'o/ / de yang mdo dang bstan bcos rnam gnyis kyis/ / log rtog bcu drug dngos su bstan nas ni/ / log rtog de yi kun nas bslangs pa yi/ / klan ka bcu drug don gyis 'chad pa ste/ / kun rdzob dang ni don dam/ sgo can gyi/ / klan ka ga nyis su de rnams 'dus pa yin/ / dab ma ba yi kun rdzob khas blangs de/ / rtags sa bkod nas don dam san ri ring ri bzhu rig byi 'byin pa/ / 'dir bstan kun rdzob sgo can kla na ka dang / /dbu ma ba yi don dam khas blangs pa/ / rtag sa su bko/ da nas kun rdzob sun 'byin pa/ / 'dir bstan don dam sgo can kla na ka yin/ / klan ka dang bor don dam/ sgo nas dang / / phyi ma ra kun rdzob sgo nas lan gdab bo/ / de ltar rtse sbyor skabs kyi gzhung gi don/ / zla bral legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba dang / / sngon med dgongs 'grel rnam/ bshad snying bo rgyan/ / rnam gnyis dgongs pa ji bzhin bkod pa yin/ / 'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ / tshang sa spyod rnam smin brgyad ldan rten thob ste/ / 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdo sngag sa bsta na pa la/ /zhugs nas thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin shog/ 'di ni phul byung rnam dpyod can/ / bshes gnyen 7lha ra mas bstan srung gang des bskul ba'i ngor/ / bya bral khur 'dzin snyoms las pa/ /dbyangs can da ga' ba'i blo gros sbyar/ /marga lam̐/ /461

༄tsho/ / dbu ma'i thal bzlog gi brjed byang tshig sa kub25rngad zuge rngubaXspyashākabasko beb/ /bla ma mgon po 'jam dpal la/ / sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag 'tshal lo/ / grangs can bdag skye 'a dod tshul ni/ /dngos po thams cad rang rgyu'i dus/ /rgyu yi rang ba zhin mi gsal bar/ / yod pa de nyid rkyen sog sa kyis/ / gsal bar byas la skye zhes rna btags/ /gsal 5zin slar yang mi skye zer/ /log rtog de nyid 'gog pa la/ /'grel ba budha pā li tar/ / mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis sbyar te/ / slar yang skye ba don yod dang / /yod pa 'gal bar brjod pa yi/ / thal 'gyur ga nyis kyis da sa/ga par mdzad/ /de la grangs can ma khyab ces/ /smra mod skyorno spong mi nus so/ / de la slob dpon legs ldan 'byed/ / ma/dor bstan kho na'i gzhu nga drangs nas/ /skye ba don med thug med du/ /thal ba 'phangs par dgongs nas ni/ / rang rgyud dpe rtags ma brjod dang / / gzhan smras nyes rnga/ ma bsal dang / / rgol ba gzhan gyis glags rnyed pa'i/ / skyon gsum yo da ces sun 'byin mdzad/ / de ni ba dag skye 'gog nus kyi/ / rang rgyud rtags sbyor yang dag dang / / rtags chos gnyis ldan mthun dpe zhig / brjod dgos pa la ma brjod dang / / grangs can gzhan gyis 'di skad du/ / bdag la sa skye ba med zer ba/ / gsal zin dngos po yin na ni/ /kho bos grub zin sgrub pa yin/ /rgyu yi bdag nyid mi gsal ba/ /yin na skye ldan dngos po kun/ / de las skye bas khyab dang 'gal/ /zhes pa'i nyes pa ma bsal dang / / gzhan yang 'grel dag de nyid la/ / gzhan gyis klan pa'i glags rnyed de/ /tshig zin ltar na 'brel med phyir/ / skabs kyi do na las bzlog dgos te/ /dngos zin rtags gnyis bzlog pa na/ / skye ba don bcas thug bcas 'gyur/ / de yi shugs kyis dam/ bca' ni/ / bdag las skye ba med ces pa/ / med dgag tsam du ma bsdad par/ / gzhan skye 'phangs par 'gyur bas na/ / 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras 462

kyis/ /mtha' bzhi'i skye med dam bca' kun/ /med dgag tsam du gsungs pa yi/ /grub pa'i mtha' dang 'gal lo gsung / / de ltar brjod pa'i skyon de rnams/ / sangs rgyas bskyangs la mi 'jug par/ / dpal ldan zla bas bshad tshul ni/ /'grel ngag de yis rang rgyud kyi/ / gtan tshigs dpe bcas mi bstan kyang / / 'gal ba brjod pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ / grangs can rang gi khas len la/ / nang 'gal mthong nas dam bca' 'dor/ /bsgrub bya rtogs par 'gyur ba yin/ / khas blangs 'gal bas brtsad pas kyang / / nang 'gal mthong yang mi ldo ga na/ / mngon sum la ni bsnyon 'dings phyir/ /mkhas pa'i rtsod zlar 'os ma yin/ /des na skabs 'dir rang rgyud kyi/ /dpe rtags brjod la dgos pa dang / /nus pa lhag po ci yang med/ /rang rgyud don ni rang mtshan gyis/ /grub pa'i chos la byed pas na/ /de 'dra'i rang mtshan dbu ma bas/ /khas len rigs pa ma yin no/ /thal 'gyur tsam la brten pa ni/ /rjes dpag tshad ma skye nus pas/ /bsgrub bya rtogs phyir gzhan grags kyi/ /rtags dpe dgos pa min mod kyang / /gal/ te dgos na'ang 'grel ngag gis/ /sgrub ngag yan lag lnga ldan gyi/ /sgo nas gzhan grags gtan tshigs bstan/ /dam bca' khyab pa dpe brjod dang / /nyer gtod ma/jug sdud yan lag lnga/ / bsdu na rgyas bshad dang bo yi/ / thal 'gyur rtags sbyor tshul du bkod/ / mngon gsal myu gu mthun dper gzung / / skyon brjod gnyis pa don med de/ / rang rgyud gtan tshigs khas mi len/ / gzhan grags rtags la rgyu dus su/ /mi gsal myu gu chos can dang / /gsal zin mthun dper bzung bas na/ /grub zin sgrub dang gtan tshigs ni/ / 'gal ba'i dogs pa med pas na/ / gzhan smras nyes pa mi 'byung ngo / / skyon brjod gsum/ pa'ang ma 'jug ste/ / sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi 'grel ngag gi/ thal 'gyur de ni grangs can la/ /khas blangs nang 'gal ston phyir yin/ /bzlog don sgrub phyir 'phangs pa min/ /de phyir de yi bzlog don gyi/ /slar yang skye ba don bcas sogs/ /pha rol grangs can khas blangs kyi/ /kho bo cag gi khas len min/ /legs ldan 'byed kyi dgongs tshod kyi/ / thal 'gyur de ni 'grel ngag gi/ dngos shugs gang gi'ang don min phyir/ /bzlog don khas len mi dgos pas/ /gzhan gyis 463

glags rnyed ga la 'gyur/ /de phyir kho bo cag la ni/ /grub mtha' 'gal ba'i nyes med do/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bskyangs la ni/ /skyon mi 'jug par ma zad kyi/ /legs ldan rang gi 'grel ngag la/ /skyon mang zhugs pa 'di lta ste/ /yod pa'i rtags kyis don dam par/ /mig sogs bdag la sa mi skye ste/ /shes pa yod pa nyid bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i sbyor bar don dam gyi/ /khyad nga/ra sbyar ba mi 'thad de/ /chos la sbyar na dbu ma pas/ /bdag skye gtan nas mi 'dod phyir/ /tha snyad tsam du dgag dgos so/ /phyi rgol grangs can bden gnyis las/ /nyams la gnyis gar dgag par rigs/ /'jig rten rang gas skye tsam las/ /bad ga skye gzhan skye mi dpyod pas/ /gang la ltos kyang dgos med do/ / chos can la sbya ra snga rgol la/ / ltos pa'i chos can ma grub pa'i/ / phyogs sam rtags kyi skyon du 'gyur/ /gal te kun rdzob chos can la/ /sbyar na don dam sbyor sa 'jig/ de skad brjod rigs ma smras dang / / smras na'ang grangs can mig la sogs/ /bden par grub par 'dod pas na/ /gzhi ma grub pa'i phyogs skyon 'gyur/ /rang sde 'og mas bye brag par/ /sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshe/ /'byung 'gyur nam mkha'i yon tan sogs/ /rang rang thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /khyad par dor ba'i sgra tsam zhig/chos can nyid du 'dzin pa bzhin/ /'dir yang don dam kun rdzob kyi/ /khyad par dor ba'i mig sogs tsam/ /chos can 'dzin phyir ma/ grub pa'i/ /phyogs kyi skyon sogs med ce na/ /don ni de ltar mi 'thad de/ /legs ldan chos kun rang mtshan gyis/ /grub par khas blangs de lta na/ /mig sogs gnas lugs 'jal ba yi/ /ma 'khrul tshad ma'i rnyed don du/ /khas len dgos phyir grangs can gyi/ /'khrul shes yul du med dgos te/ /phyin ci log dang ma log pa'i/ /rnyed don gnyis po 'ga' bas so/ /yang na dbu ma'i lugs la ni/ /mig sogs phyin ci log tsam gyi/ /shes pa'i rnyed don yin dgos la/ /dngos smras lugs la ma log pa'i/ /rnyed don yin par 'dod pas na/ /chos can rgol ba gnyis ka la/ /tshad mas gru ba tshul mthun snang med/ /rab rib yod med gnyis ka la/ /skra shad mthun snang med bzhin no/ /mdor na rang mtshan khas blangs phyin/ /don dam kun rdzob gang gi yang / /khyad par dor ba'i don tsam la/ /tshad mar 'gro tshul 464

mi srid do/ /dpe ni 'dra ba ma/ yin te/ /rang rgyud man chad rang mtshan gyis/ / grub pa khas len mthun pas na/ /chos can grub tshul mthun snang yo da/ / thal rang gnyis la chos can ni/ / tshad mas grub tshul ma thun snang med/ / chos can mthun sna nga ma grub pa'i/ / phyogs skyon 'gyur ba'i rigs pa des/ / sbyor ba'i gtan tshigs yod pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa'ang ma grub tshul la sbyar/ /de ltar sbya ra nas 'gog tshul de/ /legs ldan don gyis khas blangs te/ / dngos/ smras sgrub byed bkod pa yi/ / rtags la legs ldan bden gnyis kyi/ / brtags pa byas nas 'gog pas na/ / de ni rang la'ang mtshungs pas so/ /rang rgyud sbyor ba gzhan rnams la'ang / /skyon brjod de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ / yod pa rtags su bkod pa de/ /shes pa yod bzhin mi skye ba'am/ /bum sogs ltar du skye snyam du/ /grangs can ma nges skyon yang yod/ /ji skad bshad pa'i skyon de rnams/ /rang la mi mtshungs rang rgyud kyi/ /rtags sbyor 'dod pa ma yin la/ /gzhan grags rtags la skyon mi 'jug/ rtags chos don gsum rang ngos nas/ /grub par sol ba gnyis ga'i ngor/ /ma/thun snang grub la rang rgyud zer/ /de ltar mthun snang mi dgos par/ /phyi rgol rang gi khas blangs la/ /'khris pa'i rtags ni gzhan grags yin/ /mdor na rang rgyud 'gog pa ni/ / chos can mthun snang 'gog tshul dang / / de yang rang ngos nas grub pa/ / 'gog pa'i gnad la thug pa yin/ / rang bzhin gyis grub rgyu gzhan las/ / de 'dra'i 'bras gzhan skye ba ni/ /gzhan skye'i don te thal 'gyur ba/ /ma gtogs rang sde tham sa cad dang / /gzhan sde 'gas kyang 'dod pa yin/ /'gog tshul buddhā pā li tar/ /gzhan las skye dang thams cad las/ /tham/sa cad mi skye 'gal brjod kyi/ / thal 'gyur sgo nas dgag par mdzad/ / de 'a slob dpon legs ldan gyis/ / gzhan skye rang yang 'dod dgos phyir/ / tha snyad tsam du 'gog mi rigs/ /don dam dbang du 'gog byed kyi/ /rtags dpe yang dag ma brjod dang / /dngos zin don las bzlog dgos phyir/ /gzhan gyis klan ku'i glags/ rnyed ces/ /skyon brjod rnam pa gnyis mdzad do/ / skyon de'ang 'jug pa ma yin te/ /slob dpon gzhan skye mi bzhed cing / /'gal ba brjod pa'i thal 'gyur gyis/ /gzhan skye'i dam bca' 'gog nus phyir/ /rang rgyud dpe rtags 465

brjod mi rigs/ / bzlog pa 'phang sa kyang rgyu 'bra sa kyi/ / 'brel ba nges pa sa skyon med do/ ༈ / bdag gzhan gnyis ka las skye ba/ / mu steg sa gcer bu pa 'dod de/ / rdza bum 'jim pa 'a sa skye phyir/ / de la ltos te ba dag skye dang / / dza mkhan 'kho ra lo la sogs la/ / lto sa te ga zhan skye yi na no zer/ / 'gog tshu la bdag gzhan so so ba/ / 'gog pa'i tshul dang mtshungs pa'o / / rgyang 'phe na pa ni dngo sa po rnam/sa/ / rgyu me da pa la sa skye bar 'dod/ / rma bya'i ma dongs kyi mdog sna tsho gas/ / rang gi rang gis skye bzhin zer/ / 'di la' nga buddhā pā 4li tar/ / rgyu med pa las skye ba da nga / / rta ga tu tham sa cad thams cad las/ /mi skye rtsom pa don yod pa/ / 'gal ba ba rjod pa'i tha la 'gyu ra gyi sa/ / log rtogo tha chad de bkag go/ 'di la'ang slob dpo na legs ldan gyis / / gong bzhin dpe rtags ma brjod dang / / glags rnyed pa yi skyon gnyis brjod/ / skyon mi 'jug tshul rig sa bsgre 'o/ / de yang budha pā li tar/ / thal 'a gyur khoranas dgag pa la/ / legs ldan de nyid ma dgongs par/ / don med skyon mang bzung ba la/ / dpal ldan zla bas skyon bas la nas/ / 'khru la med rang 'u ga sa gsal ma dza da do / / da bu ma 'i tha la bzlog ces grags pa 'i/ / rags rim tshig sa su ba cad pa 'di/ / dbyangs can dga' ba 'i blo gros kyis/ / rang gi ba rjed byang ched du bris/ / nongs gang gzur gnas ma/khas la bshags/ / le gas cha skal mnyam rnams la 'bul/ / dge bas klu sgrub ya ba sras kyi / / dgongs don ma nor rtogs gyu ra ci ga/ sarba maṅgā lam̐ / / 466

༄7/ / 'dul ba'i sdom chig gnad bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru mu nī ndha ya/ snyan pa'i ba da na 'jig rten gsum du grags/ / dam pa'i chos sgra seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa/ / tha ma sa cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog mdzod brnyes pa/ / zhabs la tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bus gtugs/ /ston pa mchog de sngo na tshe rdza mkhan gyi/ / khye'u 'od yangs pa zhes gyur pa na/ / shākya thub pa chen por bsnyen bkur te/ / dang bor byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas / / brtson 'grus spyod kyis phung bo chen po nas/ / gtsug tor can bar bdun khri lnga sto nga dang / / shes rab ba zang bos dkon mchog ya/na lag nas/ / mar me mdzad par bdun khri drug stong dang / /khye'u spri na gyis mar me mdzad nas bzung / / rnam gzigs bar du bdun khri bdun sto nga la/ /rwa chod pas grangs med gsum gyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ / dmyal ba'i rten la sems bskyed ces pa de/ / theg chen lugs sam snying rje chen por dgongs/ / de nas rnam gzigs nas bzu nga 'od srung bar/ / mtshan bzang rgyu ru bskal brgya'i tshogs bsags te/ / skar rgyal bstod pas bska la dgu'i tshogs 'dums phyir/ / de bar bskal ba go gcig yod par gsungs/ / lung gzhir cung zad mi 'dra gsungs pa de/ / 'o da srung bar du mtshan bzang rgyu bcas dang / / gzhan rnams rags zhib khyad par tsam du sems/ / khye'u bla mas 'od srung bsnyen bkur te/ / dga' ldan gnas su dam pa tog dkar gyur/ / tshe lo brgya par byams mgon dbang bskur te/ / dus yul rigs rus yum/ ste lngar gzigs nas/ / sa ga'i yar tshes bco lnga'i gung thun la/ / dga' ldan gnas 'phros glang chen rnam pa'i tshul/ / lhums zhugs chu stod bshol bcas me pho rta'i / / mchu zla'i nya la/ ngo mtshar ltas bcas bltam/sa/ / bzo gnas mkhas dang btsun mo 'khor dgyes rol / /nyer dgu khab bzhugs ro la mo'i sgras bskul zhing / / po/ na shi 467

dang dge slong gzigs rkyen gyis/ /shing khyi'i sa ga'i tshes brgyad mngon par byung / /lo drug bar du dka' spyad dpag med mdzad/ /dga' stobs dga' mos 'o thug rtswa tshong khye'u/ /bkra shis rtswa phul bzhes te shing drung du/ /bdud btul bco lngar ñtsa gas 'brug sa ga'i tshes/ /bco lnga'i thun drug dang po lnga 'das shing / /tha ma thor thun cha la rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /tho rangs la'ang cha gsum du phye ba'i cha dang bo'i phyed nas skya rengs shar bas na skya rengs ma shar gong tsam du sangs rgyas pa yin pas skya rengs dang tho rangs rnagacig tu 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /re shig snod ni brtag phyir btang snyoms bzhugs/ /bdun phrag dang bor gnas der lha rnams mchod/ /gnyis par stong gsum/ rgyang ring 'chag par mdzad/ /gsum par byang chub shing la mi 'dzum gzigs/ /bzhi par shar nub rgya ma/tsho'i bar du 'chag/lnga par btang bzung klu yi gnas su byon/ / drug par nu gro dha skyong drung du bzhud/ /bdun par sgrol rgyu'i drung bzhugs ga gon sogs/ / sbrang rtsi bu ram phul ba rgyal chen bzhis/ /rdo yi lhung bzed phung ba'i nang du bzhes/ /tshong pa rnams la shes brjod lung yang bstan/ /de nas tshangs pa sogs kyis gsol btab ste/ /wa ra ṇa sir byon nas ko'u di n+ya/ /rta thul rlangs pa ming chen bzang lda na la/ /rang nyid bdud rtsi thob par zhal bzhes tshe/ /mod la skra byi ngur smrig gos kyis klubs/ /bdun phrag bdun mthar chu stod tshes bzhi la/ /bgrang yas 'khor lnga bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor/ /'dul ba'i bcas 'tshams sde snod gsum la sogs/ /rim byung lo grangs bzhi bcu rtsa drug bar/ / gdul bya dpag med smin cing grol mdzad nas/ /re shig rtag 'dzin can rnams bskul ba'i phyir/ /dgung lo gya gcig bzhes pa'i me stag gi/ sa ga'i nya la mya ngan 'das tshul bstan/ /de nas deng sang rab yid lcags stag yan/ /lo grangs nyis stong drug brgya re lnga 'das/ /da nas lo grangs nyis sto nga sum brgya dang / /so lnga ma 'ongs bstan pa'i gnas tshad yin/ /rgyal bstan lnga brgya phrag bcur gnas pa ste/ /'bras dus sgrub dus lung dus gsum gsum dang / /rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya phrag gcig go/ theg chen 'dul mngon mdo sde rim bzhin du/ /byams pa 'jam dbyangs kun tu bzang bos bsdus/ /gsang bdag theg chen mtha' dag bsdu ba'ang bshad/ /'od srung chen pos 468

rgyun zhugs kun dga' bor/ /zhus dang ma zhus lan log brdzis dang chu/ /bag yangs bstan pa gnyis bcas nyes pa brgyad/ /bsgra gas shing gnas dbyung byas pas thugs skyo ste/ /bri ji'i gnas su bsgoms pas dgra bcom thob/ /lo der rgyal khab n+ya gro dha'i phug tu/ /theg pa thun mong mdo sde kun dga' bo/ /nye bar 'khor gyis 'dul ba 'od srung gis/ /mngon pa bsdus shing sbyin bdag ma skyes dgra/ /'brel dang mtshams sbyor 'di skad bdag thos rnams/ / bcug ste blo nas bton pa bsdu tshul yin/ /'od srung kun dga' sha na'i gos can dang / / nyer sbas dhi ddhā ka dang nag po dang / / legs mthong dang bcas bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ / de nas lo grangs brgya dang bcu 'das tshe/ /yangs pa can du sbyin bdag mya ngan med/ /dgra bcom grags pa la sogs bdun brgya yis/ / a la la dang yi rang kun spyod tshwa/ / lam dang sor gnyis nad dkrugs gding dang gser/ /rung min ga zhi bcu sun phyung sde snod gsum/ /blo nas bton cing bka' bsdu gnyis pa mdzad/ /sum brgya 'das rjes dza la ddhā ra ru/ /sbyin bdag ka ni ga byas byang sems dang / /dgra bcom lnga brgya so skye'i paṇḍi ta/ /khri dang drug stong sde ba bco brgyad kyi/ /mdo rnams bkar bsgrubs sde snod zhal 'don ma/dzad/ /glegs bam du yang bkod pa sa/sum par grags/ /glang gnyis sbre gnyis tsan dan phye khru ma ra/ /khron rtsod ras yug kṛ kṛ'i rmi ltas bcu/ / thams cad yod smra'i slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin/ /legs sbyar skad du so thar mdo 'don cing / / rnam phran dgu nas nyer lnga'i bar zung min/ / grwa rtags 'khor lo nor bu utpal sogs/ / nub lhag khru phyed dgus chod thub pa dang / /byin len lag gnyis bkan te blangs pas chags/ / gzhi kun pa dang 'od srung sa ston sde/ /chos srung mang thos gos dmar sde ba dang / /rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde dang bdun/ /dge 'dun phal cher 'dus phyir phal chen pa/ /bram ze sbyangs pa'i ma/chog gyur 'od srung che/ /rang bzhin skad dang bdun nas nyer gsum par/ /grwa rtags dung sogs nub lhag yol bas chod/ /byin len snod 'a/ chags shing shar nub ri/ / gangs rir gnas dang 'jig rten 'das smra dang / / btags par smra ba'i sde bcas rnam pa lnga/ /gnas brtan 'phags rigs smra bas gnas brtan pa/ /mkhan rgyud 469

rje'u rigs ka tya ya na dang / / sha za'i skad dang lnga nas nyer gcig par/ / grwa rtags dpal be'u sogs dang tha ga pas chod/ /byin len 'phrog thabs rgyal byed tshal gnas dang / / 'jigs med rir gnas gtsug lag khang gnas gsum/ / skye bo mang bos bkur phyir ma nga bkur pa/ /breg mkhan 'dul 'dzin mchog gyur nye bar 'khor/ /zur chag skad 'don rnam phran grwa rtags sogs/ /gong mtshungs nub lhag ri mos chod pas thub/ /byin len bskyur thabs sa sgrog ri ba da nga / / srung ba ba dang gnas ma/ bu'i sde gsum/ / sde snod gsum las ma chog gyur 9radul/ ba ste/ /lung rtogs yon tan kun gyi gzhi dang rten/ /rgyal bstan yod med 'di yi rjes su 'a gro/ /ston dang bstan pa gnyis ga'i go chod gsung / /'di la brjod bya rjod byed 'dul ba gnyis/ /spong bdun 'khor bcas tshul khrims nyon mongs dang / /rnam smin sgrib pa 'dul phyir 'dul ba dngos/ /rjo da byed 'dul bar rtsa mdo pha ma yi/ /so thar gnyis dang bshad pa'i ma/do bzhi ste/ /rnam 'byed ga zhi dang phran tshegs gzhung dam pa'o/ /lung bar ma dang ring bo yang dag ldan/ /gcig las 'phros te mdo sde'i lung sde bzhi/ /'dul ba'i phyogs mthun mdo ni dge slong la/ /rab tu gces pa'i mdo la sogs pa mang / /bstan bcos 'a yang spyi dang ri so so yi/ /dgongs 'grel phyogs mthun bstan bcos rna mas su yod/ /log rtog bzhi dang the tshom bzhi bsal te/ /'jug phyir brjod bya zhing dgos dngos su dang / /dgos pa 'brel ba gnyis po shugs kyis bstan/ /spyir na bstan bcos lus dang dgos 'brel dang / /ngag tsam la yod dgos sogs bzhi tshan gsum/ /de la'ang gnyis rer phye bas brgyad brgyad 'gyur/ /rtsa 'grel bcas dang rjes bcas rung mthun dang / /tshig gzhan don gzhan bstan pa rtogs pa dang / / log rtog sel dang ma dor bsdus la dga' ba'i/ / bsam pa bskang phyir lung dang zlo sa skyon spong / / ngo bo rab dbye so so'i ngos 'dzin dang / /skye ba'i rgyu dang gtong rgyu phan yon te/ /drug gis 'phros don sdom pa rnam par bshad/ / ngo bo bye smra thal gyur gzugs can dang / /gzhan rnams spong sems sa bon ci rigs 'dod/ /dbye ba bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen pha ma dang / /dge tshul pha ma dge slob ma nyid dang / /dge slong pha ma 'i sdom bcas rigs brgyad do/ /bsdu na dang bo 470

gsum po khyim/ pa'i phyogs/ /gzhan lnga rab byung phyogs kyi sdom par 'dus/ /rdzas kyis bzhir 'dus pha ma'i gnyis rdzas gcig/ rtsa bzhi yan lag bzhi dang brgyad spong ba'i/ /so thar sdom pa bsnyen gnas sdom pa ste/ /len yul so thar sdom ldan 'khor rnam bzhi/ /zla ba byung ngo cog gi nya stong brgyad/ /cho 'phrul zla phyed bsnyen gnas dus gcig tu/ /len rung 'di la grub mtha' gong 'og dang / /mkhas pa'i bzhed tshul mi 'dra mang tsam mchis/ /gsod rku rdzun smra mi tshangs spyod rtsa bzhi/ /khri stan che mtho chang 'thung gar sogs dang / / phreng sogs phyi dro'i kha zas yan lag bzhi/ / myang 'das la ni nye bar gnas byed dang / /dge rtsa gsos 'debs ltung ba sbyong byed phyir/ /bsnyen gnas dang ni gso sbyong zhes kyang bya/ /gsod rku rdzun dang log g.yem chang dang lnga/ /spong ba dge bsnyen sgras brjod rigs kyis bdun/ /skyabs 'gro sna gcig sna 'ga' phar cher spyod/ /yongs rdzogs tshangs spyod go ma'i dge bsnyen bdun/ / dang po bzhi ni dge bsnyen btags pa ba/ /mi tshangs spyod spong dge bsnyen tshangs spyod dang / /ji srid 'tsho'i bar bsnyen gnas spang bya brgyad/ /spong ba'i rab byung rtags can go mi'o/ /rtsa bzhi yan lag drug spong dge tshul te/ /gar sogs phreng sogs gnyis dang gser dngul len/ /rnam gsum phye bas yan lag drug tu /'gyur/ /dge tshul thob rjes rtsa ba'i chos drug dang / /rjes mthun chos drug spong ba dge slob ma/ /gcig pur la ma 'gro chu bo'i pha rol rkyal/ /skyes pa la ni reg dang lhan cig 'dug/ smyan 'gyur kha na ma tho 'chab pa drug/gser bzung 'doms kyi sru ni breg pa dang / /byin len ma byas gsog 'jog za ba dang / /rtswa sngon mi gtsang 'dod dang sa rko ste/ /spang bya'i rjes mthun chos ni rnam drug go/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du lus ngag gi / nyes spyod mtha' dag spong ba bsnyen rdzogs sdom/ /pham/ bzhi lhag ma bcu gsum spang ltung ni/ /sum cu ltung byed dgu bcu sor bshags bzhi/ /nyes byas brgya rtsa bcu gnyis bsdoms pa yi/ /nyis brgya nga gsum spong ba dge slong dang / /pham brgyad lhag ma nyi shu spang ltung ni/ /so gsum ltung byed 'ba' zhig brgya brgyad cu/ /sor bshags bcu gnyis nyes byas brgya bcu gnyis/ /yongs bsdoms sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams/ /spong bar byed pa dge slong ma yin 471

no/ / bye smras sdom gsum rim blangs rdzas tha dad/ / gzhan gyis gan sa 'gyur ngo bo gcig par 'dod/ /mi min za ma ma ning sgra mi snyan/ /ma gtogs gling gsum rten la gsar du skye/ /gtong rgyu bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos dang / /mtshan gnyis cig car byung dang lan gsum gyur/ /dge rtsa chad rnams thun mo nga gtong rgyu dang / /bye brag nyi shu ma lon der she sa dang / / bsten phyir khas blangs nyin zhig 'das pa gsum/ / rim bzhin dge slong pha dang dge slob ma/ / bsnyen gnas rnams kyi gtong rgyu thun mong min/ /phan yon mdor na gnas skabs lha mi dang / /mthar thug byang chub gsum po ci rigs 'thob/ /spyir btang bsnyen par rdzogs tshul bcu yod de/ /'dren pa rang rgyal rang byung tshul gcig cing / /ye shes khong chud tshur shog skyabs 'gro dang / / ston par khas blangs dris mnyes lci chos blangs/ /'phrin dar yul dbus bcu ste mtha' 'khob lnga/ /gsol bzhi'i las kyi sngon gyi cho ga'o/ /dang bo bdun ni sdom pa'i 'bogs chog min/ / brgyad pa da chog dgu par cha gnyis yod/ /sngon chog rab byung bsnyen rdzogs cig car du/ / sgrub pa'i gsol bzhi'i las te yul dang rten/ / cho ga yongs rdzogs 'bras bu'i khyad par bzhi/ /sdo/ma pa skye yang da ltar byar mi rung / /'o drug bar byung de nas 'ga' zhig gis/ /chos gos legs par ma bgos rgyud ma sbyang / / rgod bag can gyur nad g.yog med gzigs nas/ / mkhan slob dge 'dun bcas pa'i da chog glu gnang / /da chog nyes med phun tshogs ni/ /tshigs snga dge tshul sgrub pa la/ /dang bo'i ma/khan pos bsgrub bya la/ /bar chad dris nas dag pa bzung / /rim gyis slob dang phun tshogs phyir/ /sdom gsum/ rim gyis sbyin par bya/ /dge ba myang 'das la bsnyen phyir/ /dge bsnyen zhes bya dge tshul ni/ /shra ma ṇi ra ngal ba ste/ /rang gi bla ma'i bya ba la/ /ngal zhing rub par byed pa'o/ /dge ba myang 'das don 'tshol zhing / /chos ldan bsod snyoms slong bas na/ / dge slong zhes bya sgra don gzhan/ / dge ba slong dang zas slong dang / /nye bar zhi dang chags spangs dang / /legs par 'tsho dang lam zhugs dang / /yid 'ong phyir na dge slong yin/ / dbye na ming dang khas 'che dang / / slong dang nyon mongs bcom pa dang / /gsol bzhi'i las kyi dge slong lnga/ /dang bo gsum ni btags 472

pa ba'o/ / thog ma/ra dge bsnyen sgrub pa 'a / / dge tshul sbrel tshe bar chad dri/ / dge bsnyen rkyang bar 'dri mi dgos/ /ston pa de nas slob dpon la/ /phyag 'tshal thal sbyar tsog pur 'dug/ dngos gzhi sngags tshig lan gsum bzlas/ /skyabs brjod bdag brjod gzhan brjod gsum/ /skyabs 'gros nges 'byung brtan po sgrub/ /bdag brjod rdzogs mthar sdom pa skye/ /bslab pa brjod pa lan cig bya/ /snod rung bya phyir rab byung ni/ / dge 'dun la zhu mkhan por gsol / / lus bsgyur mtshan ni ma tshor brtag/bsam pa brje dang ming brje ste/ / sngags tshig lan gsum thabs legs bya/ / dngos gzhir sdom pa skye dang gnas/ /khyad par 'gyur dang mdzes pa yi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad bzhi bral zhing / /yul rgyu rtags bsam cho ga ste/ /mthun rkyen lnga/ tshang yul mthun pa/ /dkon mchog gsum dang slob dpon dang / /rgyun mthun rnying pas rgyud ma bkag/snga ma sngon song tshogs 'o ngas min/ /rtags mthun lu sa kyi byi byad dang / /gos dang snod spyad rtags rnams tshang / /bsam mthun bsam pa rang bzhin gnas/ /snying nas thob 'dod thob dus shes/ /sems can yan lag yul dus dang / /gnas/ skabs nges pa lnga bral dang / / nges 'byung bsam/ pas zin dang lnga/ / cho ga sbyor dngos mjug gsum tshang / /dngos gzhi cho ga lan gsum dang / / dus go brjod dang bslab pa ni/ /khas blangs tshul gyis lan cig brjod/ /khyad chos drug ldan dge ba'i bshes/ /skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa yi/ /bla mar 'os pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /khrim sa ldan 'dul ba'i cho ga shes/ /snying brtse 'khor dag dus su 'doms/ /chos dang shing zing phan 'dogs drug/dbye na rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi/ /mkhan po gnyis dang slob dpon lnga/ /spyir na rab byung dge slong dang / / dge slob ma yi mkhan po gsum/ /slob dpon brgyad de bsnyen gnas dang / /dge bsnyen dge tshul slob dpon dang / /gsang ston las byed klog pa dang / /gnas dang 'phrin gyi slob dpo na no/ /la sa slob gsum ste dge slob ma/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas bsnyen rdzogs kyi'o/ / bsdu na mkhan slob gnyis su 'dus/ / brtan mkhas gnyis ldan kha skang 'os/ / dge slong mkhan por 'os pa ste/ / gsol ba lan gsum btab tshe gyur/ /dge slong chos drug ldan pa'i steng / / dge tshul 'bogs chog 47 3

'khrul med thon/ / mkhan po'i tshig gis bskos pa de/ / dge tshul slob dpon 'os pa ste/ / dge tshul sdom/ pa skyes tshe gyur/ / bsnyen rdzogs sdom pa rnam dag cing / / lta ba mthun dang mtshan mthun pa/ / tha snyad gsum lda na tha mal gnas/ / sa ni rang ba'in gnas pa drug/ gnas kyi slob dpon 'os pa dang / /mkhan por 'os pa don gcig cing / / bsgrub bya'i gnas 'cha'i cho ga byas/ / gnas med nyes pa zhag gcig bkag/skya rengs shar tshe gnas su gyur/ /mkhan por gnas che cho ga spang / /drug lda na bar chad 'dri mkhas pa/ / gsang ston 'os pa'i mtshan nyid de/ / bar chad dris zin zhus tshe gyur/ /drug ldan bsnyen rdzogs 'bogs chog tshig/ 'khrul med thon pa bsnyen rdzogs kyi/ /las slob 'os pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ / ngo bo bya ba byed pa ste/ / cha gsum bya ba rdzogs mthar gyur/ /sdom pa rnam dag dang ldan zhing / /rang gi bslab bya'i chos mkhas pa/ /klog pa'i slob dpon 'os pa ste/ / phan tshun chos 'brel bsam pa yis/ /tshigs bcad 'a na gsum bzlas tshe gyur/ /mkhan slob bdun po re re la'ang / /'os dang yin pa gnyis/ gnyis yo/da/ /gyur dus mkhan slob gang byed kyi/ /don grub pa na der gyur ro/ / bde gshegs mkhan slob btsun pa dang / /gnas brtan dge slong dge bshes dang / /tshe dang ldan pa la sogs pa/ /nye tshig che chung gang 'os pa/ / ma spyar rjen pa'i ming mi brjod/ /tshigs ni phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs ni/ /ma khan po gsang ston med kyang skye/ /las slob dge bdun grangs tshang ba/ / med na sdom/ pa mi skye phyir/ /dge 'dun grangs tshang kha skong 'os/ /mi mthun gnyis dang bral ba ste/ /khyad par ba/sum ldan da ge bdun yul/ /rten ni lus dang bsam/ pa dang / /cha lugs phun sum/ tshogs pa dang / /tshigs snga sngon song bzhi ldan no/ /bsnyen rdzogs sdo ma pa rgyu drug 'a sa/ /byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung rgyu dang / / skad cig gnyis pa phan chad ni/ / skal mnyam rgyu las skye ba yin/ / rkyen bzhi'i nang nas rgyu rkyen dang / / bdag rkyen gnyis las skye bar bshad/ / mdo sde ba rnam sa rkyen bzhi dang / /mtshungs ldan rgyu la sa skye bar 'dod/ / sangs rgyas dge 'dun mkhan por gsol/ /gos kyi gnyis dang lhung bzed dang / /gsang ste ston dang mjug yon dang / / sangs rgyas dge 'dun la sa byed la'o/ /'di la bzhed tshal 'ga' snang 71rshaṇa41 chog mi

phyir/ / yang na lhung bzed phya ga med par/ / nang du bar chad dri phyag bgrang / / las chog dgongs par mthun pas legs/ / dang bor bya dang mkhan po dang / / chos gos gnyis dang lhung bzad gnyis/ /gsol ba'i las dang blo mthun dang / /spro bya gso la ba gsang ston dang / /zhu dang gsol dang gsol ba dri/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'a dun dang / / mkhan slob bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod dang / / rdzogs pa'i yo byad yo ngas dag dang / / gsol ba 'a sa rnam/sa mngon gyur bcu/ / bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod bsam pa'i rten / /khyad chos lnga dang lda na pa dang / /mkhan slob dge 'dun bcas pa rnams/ / kun slong bsam pa 'du shes te/ /thugs dgongs gsum po gsal gdab cing / /'a sa slob dngos gzhi gsol bzhi'i las/ / 'khrul med blo nas thon pa gces/ / dus go lo dang du sa tshig sa zla/ / zla ba'i ngo dang tshes grangs dang / / nyin mtshan cha dang grib so bdun/ /byi ba la sogs 'o bcu gnyis/ /re rer shing me sa lcags chu/ / lnga lngar phye bas drug cur gyur/ / dus tshigs skabs 'dir lnga yin la/ / mgo rgya la ma chu dbo nag pa dang / / sa ga sbyon dang chu stod dang / /gro zhun khrums dang tha skar dang / /smin drug zla ba bcu gnyis kyi/ / dkar phyogs mar phyogs re re la/ / dga' bzang rgyal stong rdzogs pa lngar/ / dang bo gnyis pa gsum pa zhes/ / gsum/ gsum sbyar bas bco lnga dang / /nyin mtshan cha ni nyer gnyis brjod/ /gdams ngag pha ma/ gnyis po la/ / mdo tshan bcu gcig bcu gnyis dang / / zhib tu phye na nyi shu dang / / so gcig yod de gnas rnams dang / / ltu nga dang dge sbyor mchog 'dod dang / / tshul khrims mnyam dang tshul 'brel dang / /dul dang dgos dang ma brjod dang / /gus pa dang ni bsgrub bya ba'o/ / dang bo dgu ni bslab bya'i yul/ /phyi ma gnyis po spong byed kyi/ /gnyen por gdams pa gnyis su 'dus/ / bsod snyoms pa dang stan gcig phyis mi len/ /chos gos gsum dang phyir pa phyag dar khrod/ /dgon pa ba dang shing drung bla gab me da/ / dur khrod pa dang tsog pu gzhi ji bzhin/ /bcu gnyis zhib tu phye na nyi shu'am/ /so gnyis bsdu na bzhi 'am gsum du 'dus/ /dus tshigs gsum dang bzhi dang lnga/ / drug tu phye tshul rna ma pa bzhi/ /phyag dar khrod kyi gos shes ched/ / dgun dpyid dbyar te gsum/ du phye/ / ra ngo 'bring bo tha 475

chung dang / / 'jig rten tha snyad dang bstun phyir/ / dgun dpyid dbyar ston bzhir bshad do/ /shi 'a dra'i dbyar thung dus rtogs ched/ /dgun dpyid dbyar tsam dbyar thung du/ /dbyar ring bo ste dus lngar gsung / / gso sbyong bcu bzhi ba yi dus/ /shes phyir dgun dang dgun smad dpyid/ /so ga dbyar ston drug tu phye/ /de rnams gang ltar byas kyang rung / /hor zla bcu ba'i bcu drug gi/ skya rengs shar tshe lo dang dgun/ /mgo zla gsum gyi thog ma 'dzin/ /dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshigs su bcad pa 'dis/ / dbyar dgun nyi ldog dngos su dang / / ston dpyid nyin ma tshan phu mnyam pa gnyis/ /shugs la bstan par 'chad pa dang / / de las bzlo ga ste bstan pa yi/ / bzhed tshul gnyis las phyi ma ni/ / deng sang shin tu mthun pas legs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs rje btsun chos kyi rgyal ma tshan gyi gsung rgyun mdzod las kyang phyi ma ltar 'byung ngo / / tshes zhag nyin zhag khyim 'ag gsum/ / tshes zag zla ba'i 'phel 'grib la/ / sum cur bgos pa'i cha gcig yin/ /nyin zhag da nang nam langs nas/ / sang gi nam/ 'a ngas bar la 'jog/ khyim zhag khyim ni bcu gnyis kyi/ /khyim rer nyi ma gnas pa'i yun/ /sum cur bgos rnga/'i cha gcig go/ gzhu dang chu srin bum pa nya/ /lug glang 'khrig pa ka rka ṭa/ /seng ge bu mo srang sdig pa/ /smin drug snar ma mgo dang ldo/ga/ nab so rgyal skag ba dun po shar/ / mchu dang bre dbo me bzhi dang / / nag pa sa ri sa ga byang / / lha mtshams ston snrub chu stod dang / /chu smad gro zhun byi zhun nub/ /mon gre mon gru khrams stod smad/ /nam gru tha skar bra nye lho/ /byi zhun gro zhun skar khongs su/ / bsdus nas rgyu skar nyer bdun gyi/ /gnyis dang bzhi char nyi ma yis/ / rang 'gros tshul gyis longs spyod pa'i/ / yun tshad khyim der 'jog pa ste/ / snrub dang chu stod chu smad kyi/ /bzhi cha gcig spyod gzhu yi khyim/ /chu smad bzhi gsum gro zhun dang / /mon gre phyed bcas chu srin khyim/ /rngo na phyed mon gru khrums sto da kyi/ /bzhi cha gsum ni bum/ pa'i khyim/ /khrums stod ba'i cha khrums smad dang / / nam gru rdzogs pa nya yi khyim/ / tha skar bra nye smin drug gi/bzhi cha gcig gis lug khyim rdzogs/ /smin drug bzhi gsum snar ma dang / / mgo phyed glang khyim mgo phyed lag/ nab so'i bzhi gsum 'khrig pa'i khyim/ /nab so'i cha gcig 4176

rgyal skag rdzogs/ /ga rka ṭa dang mchu dang bre/ /dbo yi bzhi cha seng ge'i khyim/ /dbo gsum me bzhi nag pa'i phyed/ / bu mo'i khyim dang nag pa'i phyed/ / sa ri sa ga'i bzhi gsum srang / /sa ga'i cha gcig lha mtshams sgron/ /rdzogs pa sdig pa'i khyim du bshad/ /dung gnyis bye brgyad sa ya lnga/ /gling bzhi 'di yi skar ma'i grangs/ /che ba rgyang grags bco brgyad dang / /chung ba rgyang grags bzhi'am gcig/ khug pa'i dbugs drug chu sra/nga gcig/ chu srang drug cu chu tshod gcig/ chu chod drug cu nyin zhag gcig/khyim zhag chu srang nga gnyis lhag/ chu tshod nga dgu rjes 'brang bcas/ /tshes zhag gcig go de sum cu/ /tshes zla yin te lo gcig la/ /khyim zhag sum brgya drug cur nges/ /nyin zhag sum brgya re lnga ste/ /tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig dang / /chu tshod rjes 'brang dang bcas yod/ /rags zhib dbang gis zla ba ni/ /so gnyis phyed dang so gsum nas/ /zla ba'i bshol re 'don pa yin/ /lung gi gleng bzhir lo drug nas/ /'don par gsungs pa khyim zhag dang / /nyin zhag bar nas 'don tshul lo/ /dbyar kun nyi ldog ston dpyid kyi/ /nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gzer bzhi'i bar du khyim zhag grangs/ /dgu bcur nges shing nyin zhag ni/ /go gcig chu chod bcu dgu dang / /chu srang gsum dang dbugs gsum mo/ /de bzhin tshes zhag go gnyis dang / /chu tshod zhe drug chu srang dgu/ /dbugs gcig rdzogs mthar 'byung ba yin/ /phal cher mar ngo sngon 'gro yi/ /ra ba bzhi'am 'bring bzhir 'char/ /lo zla zhag gsum brtsi tshul la/ /mdzod dang dus 'khor 'chi med ma/dzod/ / rdo rje ma/kha' 'gro'i rgyud sogs kyi/ / bshad tshul mi 'dra —mangs kyis dogs/ / dus kyi 'khor lor rang rang gi/ phra dbugs nyi khri chig stong dang / / drug brgya zhag gcig zhag sum cu/ /zla ba gcig dang de bcu gnyis/ / rang rang lo du 'jog par gsungs/ /gnyis pa'i yar ngo cho 'phrul tshe/ /drug pa'i bzhi la chos 'khor bskor/ / dgu ba'i nyer gnyis lha las babs/ / bzhi ba'i bco lnga rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dus chen bzhi yi spyi sdom mo/ /lha babs dbyug pa zla ba yi/ /bco lngar bshad pa'i tshul gnyis yod/ / sa ga'i nya 'a mngon byang chub/ / lhum sa zhugs myang 'das gsum 'dzom mo/ / bzang bo'i dus chen de rnams la/ /yid ches dge ba gang 477

bsgrubs de/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i 'gyur du gsungs/ /nyi 'dzin bye ba 'bum 'gyur te/ /zla 'dzin bye ba bdun 'gyur du/ /gsungs phyi ra dus chen de rnam/sa la/ /da ge sgrub tshu la la brtson pa gces/ / sdo ma pa mi nya mas srung thabs ni/ / bshes gnyen bsam sbyor 'gal rkyen shes/ / bslab pa yongs sbyong bder gnas rkyen/ / brten pa lnga las dang po ni/ / thog mar gan sa kyi bla ma mchog/ bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten / /phyag 'tshal tsog pur thal spya ra te/ / bya ba rung dang the tshom can/ / gnang ba thob dang rung mi ru nga / / shes phyir gus pa sa nges par zhu/ / bya ba mi rung mi zhu ste/ / mi gnang gnang yang byar mi rigs/ / bya ba glo bur nam byung dang / / nar ma rang rang ming smos te/ /nyin re lan gsum zhu bar bya/ / rgyang grags kyis chod lan re dang / / rgyang grags lngas chod zhag lnga dang / / dpag tshad phyed dang gsum chod ni/ / gso spyong tshe na mja' rnazhing zhu/ /nga la gso gnas bkag phran tshegs sogs/ /yul rten bya ba'i dmigs bsal gsum/ / rim bzhin bzhi dang brgyad dang dgu/ / gnas la ma zhus nyes mi 'byung / / bsnyen rdzogs sdo ma pa bar ma chad/ / lo bcu ma lon gzhan dag gi/ mkhan po nyid dang gnas nyid dang / /rang yang gnas med 'dug mi bya/ /lo bcu lon kyang lnga phrugs dang / /mi ldan mkhan sogs byar mi rung / / lnga tshan de yang lung gzhi la sa/ / lo bcu lon dang 'dzi na dang mkhas/ / rig dang gsal dang 'dzin 'jug dang / / slob dang slob 'jug rnam gnyis dang / / phun sum tshogs gnyis rnam pa gsum/ / slob dang mi slob byung shes dang / /gnas 'cha' 'char 'jug ltung ba shes/ /lho yi ri la rgyu ba yi/ /sde tshan yang dag bsdus pa yin/ /zhes gsu ngas pa ltar nyer gcig ste/ /sde snod gnyis dang gsum shes dang / / dge sbyo ra tshul dang 'dul ba'i gzhung / / shes pa'i yon tan bzhi ru 'dus/ / lo bcu 'o na dang nad g.yog dang / / 'gyod sel sdig lta spong ba dang / / ma/ngon par mi dga' 'dor ba bzhi/ / byed dam byed du 'jug nus lnga / / sde snod gsum 'dzin tshig don 'dzin/ / mkhas pa tshig don ma 'dres 'byed/ /rig pa sde snod gsum rtsom nus/ / gsal ba gzhan la gsum gsal nus/ / gzhan la'ang gsum 'dzin 'jug par nus/ / bslab gsum rang gis slob pa dang / / de nyid gzhan la'ang 478

slob 'jug ste/ / bdun la mang thos tshul ldan bani/na/ /'dul slob lhag spyod 'dul ba dang / /so thar slob dang slob 'jug nus/ /gnyis la tshul ldan mang thos bsnan/ /dad dang tshul khrims 'dul mang thos/ / gtong dang shes rab phun tshogs gong / / tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam/ grol de shes de mthong 'og/ dran ldan dran pa nyer bzhag ldan/ / nang 'jog bying rgod ma bral 'jog/ mnyam bzhag bying rgod dang bral bzhag/ tshul lda na 'dul ba mang thos dang / /yang dag spong brtson shes rab bsnan/ /slob dang mi slob lnga phrugs gnyis/ /so so'i zag med tshul khrim/sa dang / /ting 'dzin shes rab rnam grol dang / / de shes de mthong phun tshogs lnga'o/ / byung shes byung dang bcas pa dang / /rjes bcas bkag dang gnang shes lnga / /slob ma gzhan la gtan du 'am/ / re shig gnas 'chang 'jug nus shing / / bar gcod bar gcod min pa shes/ /smra bo nyid dang rjes ston shes / /ltung she sa ltung dang ltung med shes/ / yang dang lci shes so thar dang / /rgyas pa kha ton thon pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid dang byed pa gzhi/ /bsam dang tshogs kyis lci ya nga lnga/ / sde sno da gzhan gnyis gang rung shes/ /yon tan ldan pa khyad par can/ / 'dul rkyang shes pa khyad par min/ / bslab gsu ma slob dang slob 'jug nus/ / phun tshogs 'og dang slob mi slo ba/ / lnga bo 'phags nga/ kho na dang / /gzhan rnams skye 'phags thun mong ngo / / brtan mkhas yon tan gnyis ldan gyi/ /dge slong gang zag rang dbang can/ /dge slo nga gzhan rnams de ma yi/ na/ / mang thos tshul ldan brtson brtsams shes/ /bar du gcod dang gcod min shes/ /ting 'dzin shes rab rnam grol dang / / de shes de mthong ma gtogs pa/ / lhag ma yan lag rang dbang can/ / rang nyid rgyud la ldan pa la/ /lnga phrugs gzhan ldan mi dgos pa/ / lnga phrugs rang dbang can yin la/ / cig shos rang dbang can min no/ / bslab pa 'cha' ba'i gleng gzhi sogs/ /byung ba shes pa byung shes te/ /byung la bcas dang ma bcas ga nyis/ /dgag sgrub gnang gsum bslab gzhi'i mtsham/sa/ /ston byed bka 'a ni bcas pa yin/ / rjes bcas bya ba'i rigs gcig la/ /bcas pa gnyis pa mdzad pa ste/ /sgrub rjes sgrub gnang dgag gsum dang / / gnang rjes gnang sgrub dgag gsum dang / /dgag rjes 479

dgag sgrub gnang gsum ste/ /ma dor mu gsum dor ba drug/ dgag pa srog la babs kyang 'di/ /mi bya zhes par bkag pa ste/ /bcas rang bkag pa gnyis su yod/ /gnang ba byas rung ma byas rung / /ltung med ci dgar gnang ba'o/ /lnga phrugs lda na pa'i gzhon la yang / / rgan pa med tshe gnas 'cha' zhing / / phyag 'tshal ma gtogs gzhan kun bya/ /lo lnga lon zhing lnga phrugs lda na/ /gnas la ma brten ljongs rgyu rung / / gzhan du dgra bcom gsum rig kyang / /gnas med ljongs rgyur mi bya gsung / /sdom pa skye ba'i bar chad 'a / / sprul dang pho mo ma ning dang / / lan gsum mtshan 'gyur ma/tshan dug ma/ / ma/tshan med za ma dud 'gro dang / /mi min sgra mi snyan dang bcu/ / rku thabs mu stegs can zhugs dang / / ma tshams med byas dang ma sun phyung / / 'chab bcas sngon rab byung dang drug/ khyim pa mu stegs rtags 'dzin dang / /rab byung rtags spong lo ma lon/ /bzlog pa'i chad pa mi len lnga/ /mu stegs lta gnas sdo len sems log/ dug gsum drag pos gzir ba dang / /sdom pa thob mi shes dang bzhi/ /rim bzhin lus rten las sgrib dang / /gnas skabs bsam pas mi skye ba'o/ /gnas pa'i bar chad rgyal bo dang / / pha ma dag dang bud med khyo/ / bran rjes ma gnang bu lon can/ / khyad par 'gyur ba sha haṃ las/ / mdze sogs lus nad zhe gsum gsung / /mdzes pa'i bar chad lung gzhi'i skabs/ /lag rdum nas bzung gta' gam bar/ /nyer gsum bshad cing phran tshegs skabs/ /skra ser sogs nas lus nyams par/ / don gnyis zhu ba'i skabs las kyang / /sen mo gcig nas phung krol bar/ /lnga bcu gsungs shing phreng rgyud las/ /rigs kyis gshed ma smig ma mkhan/ / g.yung bo shing rta gsal shing mkhan/ / chang 'tshong drug sogs bshad mod kyi/ / gang bshad grangs tsam der ma nges/ / bsdu tshul gtso phal dus dang gnyis/ /zhib par 'dul ṭīka sogs la ltos/ /skyes nas zla phyed 'khyud ldang dang / /phrag dog nyams lnga ma ning pho/ /gtan du zla mtshan 'dzag mi 'dzag/gle 'dams mtshan tsam mtshan dug mo'o/ / skra sen breg dang khrus bya ba/ / bsro gang legs sbyar khrus bsten sogs/ /brtul zhugs can gyis tshul ldan bya/ /lhung bzed sa dang lcags las bya/ / kha dog gnag cing gsal ba dang / / sgong phyed bkas ltar 480

dbyibs zlum/ pa/ / lhan pa lnga yan ma phog cing / / spyad ba zod byin gyis bslab rung dgos/ /ya khyor nyer gcig bod bre gang / /de yi bdun cha bdun phul dang / /drug cha drug phul gang yin la / /des na drug phul dgu shong ba/ /chung tshad bco brgyad shong ba ni/ /pha yi lhung bzed chen po'i ched/ /de yi bar rnams 'bring tshad do/ /drug phul do la ma ga dha'i/ /bre'u chung gang du 'jog par bshad/ /pha yi lhung bzed chung tshad de / /ma yi che tshad ma rang nyid/ /ji tsam 'grangs pa'i zas shong ba/ /chung tshad de bar 'bring tshad yin/ /dbye na chung 'bring che gsum la/ / sa lcags las byas gnyis gnyis drug /pha ma'i dbye ba sa bcu gnyis gyur/ /gnas pas nam smad la langs nas/ /nam langs bar du kha ton bya/ / gdong dang so dri legs bkrus te/ / gal te gnas khang tha dad na/ /dkon ma/chog de rjes bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal bsnyun gsol 'dag rdzas sogs/ /phul nas zas kyi bya ba bsgrub/ /gnas khang gcig tshe bla ma dang / /de rjes dkon ma chog 'a phyag bya/ /bsod snyoms 'gro tshe gsil byed bcang / /mkhar gsil bar gso/ma stod smad lcags/ /yang sne brgyad gzhogs mchod rten gnyis/ / rwa bzhir mnyan bya gsum gsum dang / /mar sne gzhogs bdun rgya mdud can/ /gsog gshang khyi sprod ces kyang brjod/ /mtshon don dran pas bcang bar bya/ /de nas ma yi cho ga ni/ /mkhan mo sdom rgyun nyi shu lon/ / pham brgyad ma gos dge bsnyen nas/ /slob dpon ma/ yis dge tshul bar/ /sgrub tshul pha dang rigs 'dra'o/ /khyim so bzung na lo bcu dang / /ma bzung lo ni bco brgyad mar/ /bsnyen rdzogs par du lo gnyis kyi/ /dge slob ma yi bslab tshigs sbyin/ / yul dbus ma ma/tha' dge slong ma/ / bcu gnyis mtha' 'khob drug sogs kyis/ /ston dang dge 'dun mkhan mo la/ /gsum gsum phyag bya mkhan mor gsol/ /las slob ma yis gsol gzhug ste/ / gsol gnyis las kyi sdom pa sbyin/ / dus go gdams ngag chos drug dang / /rjes mthun chos drug brjod par bya/ /de nyid lo gnyis spyad pa'i rjes/ /mkhan mo dge 'dun gong bzhin dbus/ /mkhan mor gsol dang gos lnga dang / /lhung bzad byin rlabs gos bskon dang / /ltung rna thun byin rlabs blo mthun dang / /gsang ston bskos nas bar chad dri/ /zhu dang gsol gdab gsol ba dang / /(181

bar chad dris shing gsol gnyis kyis/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas sdom pa sbyin/ /de steng dge slong bcu'am lnga/ / bsnan te gnyis ku'i dge 'dun gyis/ / bsnyen rdzogs ma ru sgrub pa'i tshul/ /gsol gdab gsol dang bar chad dri/ /gsol bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs/ / dus go shing drung ma gtogs pa'i/ / gnas dang pham brgyad lci chos brgyad/ /gzhan dgu pha chog bzhin du brjod/ /ma yi lci ba'i chos brgyad ni/ /pha las gdams ngag mi nod dang / / dge slong gnas su dbyar mi gnas/ / dgag dbye mgu spyo da gsol gdab gsum/ /gnyis ga'i sde la mi byed dang / /dge slong gsang la phyag mi 'tshal/ /dge slong rnams la co dri dang / /ltung ba gleng dran byed pa ste/ /bzlog phyo gas brgyad la byed pa'ang yod/ /spang bya dgag pa'i bslab bya la/ /mi yin smra shes don go ba/ /shes pa rang bzhin du gnas shing / /ma ning mtshan gnyis min pa ste/ /tha snyad lnga lda na tha ma la gnas/ /bslab pa 'bul yul 'bul rten ni/ /tha mal shes pa rang bzhin gnas/ /ji ltar 'bul tshul ngo bo rten/ /bdag rkyen bzhi dang mi mthun phyogs/ /khas blangs nga dang rnam pa lnga/ /phul nyam/sa khyad par rnam rig gas/ /dngos su go byed phul ba dang / / brgyud nas go byed nyams pa'o/ /dgos pa sngar bsrungs phan yon thob/ /ltung ba mi 'byung phyis skye gsum/ / spyir btang phul ba dgag pa'i dang / / dmigs bsal sgrub pa'i bslab byar 'gyur/ / dbye bsdu ngo bo mtshan nyid rgyu/ / grangs nges go rim sgra don dang / / phan yon nyes dmi ga sa dang bcas bcu/ / ngo bo dang ni sde tshan gyis/ / ltung ba'i dbye sgo gnyis su yod/ /bsdu na dngos sam byed las dang / /ngo bo'i sgo nas bsdu tshul gsum/ /yang na 'du shes sbyor ba dang / /ngo bo mthar thug gzhi dang byed/ /'byung dang bya ba'i cha nas brgyad/ /ngo bo rnam par rig byed dang / /rig byed min pa'i gzugs gnyis yod/ / sdig ltung ngo bo gci ga tu 'dod/ / ston pa'i bcas 'gal nyes byas de/ /so thar ltung ba'i mtshan nyid yin/ /bsnyen rdzogs rten la 'byung ba yi// /dngos gzhi yongs rdzogs ltung ba gang / /dag byed bslab byin la ltos dang / / ngo bo'i sgo nas 'dag rung dang / / lhag ma las yang sor bshags las/ / lci ba zhes sogs rigs 'dra stor/ / sde lnga so so'i mtshan nyid do/ / mi shes pa dang bag med sgyu482 4

dang / /nyon mongs mang dang ma gus rgyu/ /grang sa nges ltung ba sde lnga ru/ /dbyer yod de las mang mi dgos/ / nyung na mi 'du'i skyon dang bral/ /sbom po pham lhag gnyis su ga togs/ /dge slong dben pa skyabs yo da du/ /'dom gang ma chod chod pa ru/ /rngo dang lhan cig gnas pa yi/ /gsum dang gnyis su ma nges ltung / /rim bzhin pham lhag ltung byed dang / /lhag ma ltung byed ci rigs 'dus/ / go rim lci yang dbang du byas/ /mi mthun phyogs rgyal gnyen po pham/ /gso rung lhag ma tsam lus dang / /ngan song gnas su ltung byed dang / /so sor mthol zhing bshags dgos dang / /legs pa min pa byas pa'i phyir/ /rim bzhin pham pa zhes sogs brjod/ / bsrungs pa'i phan yon bam lnga las/ / 'gyod med gnyis dang snyan bde bsrung / / 'jigs med phan gnyis 'grub gnyis bcu/ / ma bsrungs nyes dmigs bcu gsungs te/ / smod pa gnyis dang smod 'gyur gnyis/ /gsar thos mi 'gyur thos rnam/sa brjed/ /ma/ rtob/sa mi rtogs mi snyan grags/ / 'gyod bzhin 'chi dang ngan 'gror skye/ / rgyal bstan lo grangs bcu gnyis bar/ /skyo/na med bcu gsum la babs tshe/ /yul dang gang za ga nyon mongs dang / /nyes pa'i gzhi ste gleng gzhi ni/ /spong byed yul du bzang sbyin gyis/ /chags pas mi tshangs spyang/ par brten/ /dge 'dun bsdu dang legs par bsdu/ /bder gnas khrel med tshar bcad dang / / ngo tsha shes la phan gdags dang / / ma dad dad 'gyur dad rnams 'phel/ /zag pa bsdam dang zag pa bzlog/ bstan pa yun ring gnas pa ste/ /phan yon rnam pa bcu gzigs nas/ / ston pas pham/ pa'i bcas pa ma dzad/ / dgag bya ngan 'gror skye ba dang / /ma dad 'gyur dang sa lam sgrib/ /rang gzhan tshangs spyod la gnod sogs/ /mi dang mi min gson shi'ang rung / /lus phyed yan gyi ma nyams pa'i/ /rma sgo gsum po gang rung du/ /las rung nor bu bcug pa'i bde/ /rdzogs par myangs che sdom pa gtong / /'di ni dngos po gtso ba'i phyir/ /'du shes 'khrul dang ma 'khrul 'dra/ /gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug gi/ yan lag gzhan rnams kun tshang zhing / /gcig gnyis ma tshang spom po dang / /gzhi yi gcig dang mthar thug gnyis/ /ma/ tshang shin tu na smad 'gyur/ /sbyor ba reg nas ma/thar thug bde/ /ma myong tshun der sbom po yin/ /kun 483

slong skyes nas lus ngag tu/ / ma thon par ni bsdam bya dang / / thon nas sbyor tshun bshags bya ste/ /lhag ma kun la ci rigs spyar/ /stobs bzhis sdig lhu nga dag mod kyi/ /phyir bcos tshul bzhin ma byas na/ /dag pa'i tha snyad mi thob phyir/ /las kyi kha skong mi 'os so/ / bslab byin phyir mi 'ong thob tshe/ / pham pas dag kyang tha snyad med/ / gleng gzhi rgyal ba'i khab nying du/ /dge slong nor can rgyal bo'i shing / / ma byin blangs pas bcas pa mdzad/ / dge slong tshong ba phan tshun gyi/ / sho gam bzlas pas rjes bcas mdzad/ / rang dang nor rdzas tha dad cing / / sgra mi snya na pa'i rdzas min pa/ /yul dus rang gzhan gnyis ka la/ /ltos pa'i rin thang tshang ba'i nor/ /rang ngam gzhan la bsgo ba yis/ / nan 'gugs dngan 'then grangs rtsis dang / / rgyan la sogs la dor byed dang / / gnad la bsgre sogs sgyu thabs dang / / brnyas bskyis gtams pa bston pa dang / /gru btsas sho gam gla rngan rnams/ /tshad du 'o ngas pa mi 'jal sogs/ /kha zas dur khrod rdzas min na/ / thob blo skyes tshe pham par 'gyur/ / brku bya rku byed gnyis ka dang / /sbyor ba gcig dang yul dus la / /ltos pa'i rin thang tshang ba gsum/ /bcu yi 'jog rdzas dge slong bcus/ /'jog rdzas phyir du brkus gyur na/ /rin thang tshang ba gcig gis pham/ / de 'dra'i bgod rdzas bkod rdzas phyir/ / brkus na rin thang brgya tshang dgos/ / de lta'i 'jog rdzas bgod rdzas dang / / bgod rdzas 'jog rdzas phyir brkus na/ /rin thang tshang ba bcu dgos so/ /gnyis pa'i don ni rku sems rgyun/ /ma/ log sbyo ra ba tha dad kyang / / rin thang tshang tshe pham pa skyed/ / rku se mas log na sbyor gcig la/ /rin thang tshang ba nges par dgos/ /phyi ma dmigs bsal ma nges kyang / /rku ba'i yul dus de la ni/ / rin thang tshang ba dgos pa'o/ / rin thang tshang la mang gsungs kyang / /yul dus gnas skabs gang du yang / / dngul zho gang ngam gser se ba/ / gsum tsam brkus na pham pa bskyed/ / se ba ma ru mgo nag gi/ ljid mnyam gser la bshad pa snang / /bdag med rang dang mi min dang / /dur khrod rdzas dang kha zas dang / / lhag med mya ngan 'das sogs kyi/ / rin thang tshang ba'i rdzas brkus dang / /mi'i rdzas rin thang ma tshang dang / /ya na lag tshang na phub ma tsam/ /brkus kyang 484

spom po gzhi'i sel ba/ /gzhan nor rang dang rang nor gzhan/ / bad ga po med pa'i 'du shes dang / /gzhan gyi don dang mchod sogs dang / /bdag po nor dang dngos po nor/ / kyal ka chung gsan phyir brkus dang / / brnyas sogs bsri med 'o ngas spyod dang / /'dun log bsam pa'i sel ba'o/ /brku phyir gros dang ldang tsam dang / /sngags kyis yid bskul 'bul 'jug sogs/ /sbyor ba'i sel ba thob blo med/ /mthar thug gi ni sel ba'o/ /ltung ba de dang de skyed pa 'i/ /yan lag 'ga' zhig ma tshang ba'i/ /cha ni sel ba'i ngo bo ste/ / skabs de'i ltung ba ji lta bar/ / skyed pa sel phyir sel bar grags/ / gzhi bsam spyor ba mthar thug gi/ yan lag gi ni se la ba bzhi/ / cing 'gyur na smad ches na smad/ /gzhan dang ltung med 'gyur tshul bzhi/ /pham lhag na smad sbom po ste/ /ming du chags pa mtshan nyid pa/ /yon tan sgra ni btags pa'o/ /sbom po dngos la sbyor sbom dang / / mthar thug sbom po gnyis su nges/ /ltu nga byed dang ni sor bshags kyi/ /na smad nyes byas nyes byas kyi/ /na smad nyes byas phra mo yin/ /pham lhag gnyis kyi ches na smad/ /nyes byas gzhan ni nyes byas phra/ /gzhan 'gyur sde tshan bcas pa dang / / gnas skabs gzhan du 'gyur tshul gsum/ / ltung med 'gyur la'ang dngos gzhi dang / / der gtogs kyi dang rnam gzhag gi/ ltung med ltung ba gtan med tshobazhi'o/ /'di rnams gong 'og kun la sbyor/ /srog gcod pham pa'i gleng gzhi ni/ /spong byed yul du dge slong rnams/ /mi sdug bsgoms pas yid phyung ste/ / rang gzhan srog bcad la brten nas/ / dge slong mang por bcas pa mdzad/ / gzhi ni mi'am mir chags pa/ / bsam pa 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing / / kun slong gsod 'dod rgyun chags kyis/ /sbyor ba rang ngam bskos pa yis/ /mtshon dug sgyu thabs ma/thu sogs kyis/ /rang sngar shi tshe pham/ pa 'byung / /bad ga dang mi min gsod pa dang / /nor nas bsad dang 'dun pa log/ gsod par gsol ba dang len dang / / mnyam du'am rang sngar shi ba rnams/ /sbom po rim bzhin gzhi bsam dang / /sbyor ba mthar thug na smad do/ /mer mer nur nur ltar ltar bo/ /mkhrang 'gyur bzhi ni mir chags dang / /rkang 'a/ga 'gyus dang byis dang gzhon/ /dar bab dar yol rgan po mi/ / rdzun smra'i pham pa'i gleng gzhi 48 5

ni/ /yangs pa can du nya pa 'i rigs/ /dge slong lnga brgya bsnyen bkur phyir/ /mi chos bla ma/'i rdzun smras pas/ / ltung ba pham pa'i bcas pa mdzad/ / pha rol tha snyad lnga ldan la/ /rang la 'dod kham/sa las 'das pa'i/ /yon tan med bzhin rang don du/ /'du shes bsgyur te ngo bo'am/ / 'bras bu ldan pa'i sgo nas ni/ / mtshan nyid drug ldan ngag gis smras/ /yang na gzhan smras dang blangs na/ /de yis go tshe pham par 'gyur/ /'dod sems rtse gcig thob smras dang / /yi ger bris dang smra 'jug dang / /yul dang tshig dang don nor dang / / mi gsal smras sogs sel ba'o/ / ngag dang rang yin rang dang 'brel/ / ma nor gsal dang mngon sum smra/ / mtshan nyid drug ldan ngag ces bya/ /'dod 'dun gnod sems gnyid rmugs dang / /rgod 'gyod the tshom nyon mongs can/ /mi chos de spangs bla ma'o/ /mi rtag sdu ga bsngal bdag med dang / /mi mthun mngon par mi dga' ba/ /nyes dmigs spong dang 'gog pa dang / /chags bral 'chi ba'i 'du shes bcu/ / mi sdug rnam par bsngos dang brnags/ / rnam par dam/ra dang bam dang la'athor/ / rnam par zos dang 'bus gzhigs dang / / rus gong sor rtog 'du shes bcu/ /dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum ste/ /khu ba 'byin dang bud med reg/ 'khrig tshig 'khrig jig 'i bsnyen bkur bsngags/ /smyan byed khang ba khang chen rtsig/ gzhi med bag tsam bskur 'debs dang / /dbyen dang rjes phyogs khyim sun 'byin/ /bka' blo mi bde'i lhag ma'o/ / bzhams bsgo gsong rnagazhi'i zlog pa lngar/ /ltos dang mi ltos bye brag las/ /dang bo dgu ni dngos gyur dang / /phyi ma bzhi bo bsgo gyur ltung / /'di la khyab dang ngo bo dang / / sel ba cir 'gyur rnam pa bzhi/ / dngos khyab pha ma'i lnga lnga bcu/ /shugs khyab rjes phyogs bsnyil sdud gnyis/ /dbyen dang mtshams med lhag ma gsum / /khyad par brgyad de ngo bo lda na/ /las dang bo dang dge slong mar/ /'byung mi 'byung dang dge 'dun phye/ /zlog pa lnga dag dgos mi dgos/ /mthar thug 'byed pa po dang brgyad/ /spang ltung thun mong yan lag ni/ /dus dang bdag po shan phyir bcos/ /spang ba dang bo gsum po dang / /'brel ba'i thun mong lnga ru 'dus/ /dus 'brel ltung ba bco lnga ni/ /'chang gnyis 'jog gnyis 'phyis rnam gnyis/ /bral gnyis nyal lnga dam ga 486

nang gnas/ /gnas ngan len 'chab shugs bstan ni/ / sngas gnyis 'chab pham reg ltung bzhi'o/ /bdag 'brel ltung ba bco brgyad de/ /'chang gnyis 'jog gnyis 'jug gnyis dang / /'phyis gnyis bcu tshan bar ba'o/ /shan dang 'brel ba'i thun mong ni/ /shan ltung spang ltung gis 'jigs nas/ /byin rlabs phyir bcos la brtson ched/ / zha ga shan ltung shan gnyis su bcas/ / bsdu sa don khyab dang dbye bsdu dang / / ngo bo shan 'dres sham rdeg tshul/ /mtha' bcad mu bzhi brtsi dang bdun/ /zhag shan 'chang gnyis 'jog gnyis dang / / dge slong ma yi zla phyed gos/ / byin rlabs ma byas ltung lngar khyab/ /ltung
