shan dman pa'i gang zag gi/ spang ltu/nga sum cu kun la khyab/ / shan la dbye na gos shan dang / /ltung babred sman dang ltung shan bzhi/ / bsdu na zhag shan ltung shan gnyis/ /rdeg byed rjes zhugs brdeg bya la/ /gos pas rang 'bras ltung ba'i rgyu/ /shan yin rdeg phyed yo byad shugs/ / brdeg byar gos pas shan stobs kyis/ /ltung ba skyed pa'i rgyu rigs de/ / zhag shan mtshan nyid dbye ba la/ / brdeg bya byin rlabs yo/da med las/ / khyad par can ni yin min gnyis/ / shan dang rjes zhugs rgyun 'brel shugs/ /rnam grangs bye brag zhag shan dang / /rdzas shan dus shan rnam grangs so/ /rdeg byed spang ltung gis brdeg bya/ /spang 'os rgyun 'brel nus pa ni/ /spang shan yin te spyir btang la/ / spang shan brdeg bye rdeg byed gnyis/ / rdeg byed nyes dmigs brdeg bya la/ /gos par byas phyir shan zhes bya/ /rang rang zhag grangs ma tshan ma tha'i dus/ /shan rdeg skya rengs shar ba na/ /shan ltung skyed par byed pa yin/ /zhag shan rdeg tshul gos lhung dang / sman gyi shan rdeg tshul dang gsum / / gos la zla 'jog zhag bcu'i gnyis/ / gos lhung gnyis kyi shan rdeg tshul/ / rdeg byed byin rlabs med pa dgos/ /brdeg bya byin rlabs yod med las/ /khyad par can ni yin min gnyis/ / khyad par can la brdeg bya de/ /'phyi dang dus ma/nyam gnyis yod kyang / /cig shos la ni brdeg bya ni/ /rdeg byed de las 'phyi ba dang / /bcas rigs mthun pa gcig kyang dgos/ /sman shan rdeg tshul khyad par can/ /kho na rdzas rigs gcig pa dgos/ /ltung shan phyis rnyed yo byad la/ /de ma thag tu ltung shan rdeg/ rang dbang kha skong re ba med/ / khru gang 1 87

yan ni zhag bcu dang / /de 'dra'i kha skong re ba can/ /zla 'jog gi ni gos kyi rigs / /shan la mu bzhi brtsi tshul ni/ /rigs log shan 'byung shan mi 'byung / /rigs mi log la shan mi 'byung / /ri gas mi log la shan 'byung bzhi/ /phyir bcos dang 'brel thun mong ba/ / spang ltung phyir bcos byed pa la/ / yo byad spang ba'i yul dang rten/ / dngos po gnas dang yun tshad lnga/ /dang bo gsum 'brel thun mong ni/ /'chang bral 'jog pa'i spang ba gsum/ / sra brkyang bting bar mi 'byung ngo / / 'chang ba 'bral ba 'jog pa dang / / 'khrur 'jug pa dang len pa dang / / slong dang sto da ga yogs smad g.yogs bcas/ /rin thang so sor bskur ba'o/ /srin bal 'ba' zhig cha gnyis dang / / drug dang mtho gang lam dang ni/ /'khru ba dang ni gser dngul len/ /mngon tshan can dang nyo tshong ngo / /lhung bzed gnyis dang tha ga gnyis/ /byin 'phrog ston zla tha chung dang / /dgon pa ba dang ras chen dang / / bsdo sa pa dang ni gsog 'jog go/ brdzun skyon dge slong phra ma dang / /skyo sngogs byed dang ston pa dang / /'don dang gnas ngan len dang chos/ /bshes ngor byed dang khyad du bsod/ / sa bon 'phya ba bsgo ba dang / / khri dang gding dang skrod pa dang / /phyis gnon 'byung ba 'debs pa dang / /rim pa gnyis su rtsig pa'o/ / ma bskos nyi ma nub pa dang / / zas dang chos gos gnyis dag dang / /don mthun gru dang dben pa gnyis/ /dge slong ma yis sbyor bcug pa'o/ /yang yang za dang 'dug gnas gcig/ phye dang bca' dang stob pa dang / /'a dus dang dus min gsog 'jog dang / / kha nas mid dang bsod pa nyid/ /srog chags bcas dang nyal sar 'dug/ 'greng dang gcer pu dmag dang ni/ / zhag gnyis bshams dkrugs 'gro ba dang / / brdeg dang gzas dang gnas ngan len/ / bde dang me dang 'dun pa dang / /bsnyen par ma rdzogs chos dang smra/ /dge tshul kha dog bsgyur ba dang / /rin po che dang tsha ba'i dus/ /dud 'gro 'gyod pa sor mo dang / /rtse dang lhan cig dngangs byed dang / /sped dang gdengs med gzhi med dang / / skyes pa med par lam 'gro ba'o / /rku dang nyi shu ma lon dang / /rko dang ma/gron dang bslab pa dang / /'thab dang mi smra 'gro ba dang / / ma gus chang 'thung dus min pa'o/ / zas bcas skya rengs da gdod dang / /488

khab ral dang ni khri rkang dang / /bdal dang gding dang g.yan pa dang / /ras chen bde gshegs chos gos so/ / grong dang khyim gzhan nyid dang ni/ / bslab pa rnams dang dgon pa ni/ / sangs rgyas phan par gsungs pa yis/ /so sor bshags par bya bar gsungs/ / sham thabs la ni rnam bdun dang / /stod g.yogs la ni rnam pa gsum/ /shin tu bsdams la sogs pa lnga/ / ma/go g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga/ / mchongs la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /lus la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /'dug par bya ba dgu dag dang / /byin len bya ba brgyad rnam/sa so/ /zas la leb/sa par bya ba drug/ tsug tsug la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /'bru nas tha dad byed pa lnga/ /lag pa lda ga la sogs pa lnga/ /'phya ba la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ / lhung bzed la yang rnam pa bcu/ /'greng bar byed la sogs pa lnga/ / mgo g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga/ / do der can la sogs pa lnga/ / glang chen la sogs gzhon pa lnga/ /lan na 'khar ba la sogs/ drug/ na ba rnam pa bzhi rnams so/ / de ltar bslab bya'i mi mthun phyogs/ / thams cad legs par shes byas nas/ / bag yod ngo tsha shes bzhin gyis/ /bsrungs na sgrib me kun bral 'gyur/ /rtsa 'grel tshul dang lung gi go rim ltar/ / rnam/ 'byed rjes su zhu ba spyir bstan 'chad/ / mdo tshan re bzhi'am re lnga rnam 'byed dang mdo rtsa'i tshig zin ltar gzhung ma nga bor drug cu rtsa lnga zhe(ri 'byung ngo / /'dul byed zhu ba nas btus rim pa bzhin/ /bzhi dang gcig dang lhag ma gzhan rnams so/ /dgos pa rung ma/thun rtogs dang tshig tshogs bskyung / /gnyis ga'i dgos pa gsum mo sgra bshad ni/ / gzhung tshan 'ga' zhig ltung ba thams cad dang / /'ga' zhig phal cher la ni spyir bstan cing / / gzhung drug 'ar la byung phyir spyir bstan btags/ /ltung ba kun gyi thun mong yan lag la / / bslab pa'i yan lag sdom pa gso rung lda na/ /bslab pa'i tshigs dang bslab rgyun gcig pa dang / /dang bo'i las can ma yin bzhi ldan zhing / /bsam/ pa'i yan lag rang bzhin gnas pa dgos/ /ltung ba sde lnga ji bzhin skyed pa ni/ / rgyal bas bcas pa mdzad la lto/sa dgos phyir/ / dang bo'i las can dag la bcas ma mdzad/ /rang bzhin mi gnas bcas pa'i rten mi rung / /sdom pa ma blang ltung ba sde lnga yi/ /rgyu la sbyor na ltung min sdig tsam 'gyur/ / blangs kyang dge 4 89

bsnyen tsam/ dang phas pham pa/ /'chab bcas nyams dang sdom pa ma chags dang / /dge tshul pha ma dge slob ma dang bcas/ /ma rdzogs rab byung gsum rnams sde lnga yi/ /rgyu la spyad na nyes byas tsam zhig skyed/ / snga rabs pa dag pham pa 'chab me da dang / /mdo sde ba rnams pham pa 'chab bcas kyis/ / sdom pa gtong bar 'dod kyang mi 'thad de / / pham pa byung ba ltung ba'i rten byed dang / / de rnams rim/ par 'byung ba'ang srid phyir ro/ /des na thun mong pham pa 'chab bcas kyis/ /sdom pa mi gtong dgos pa sgrub nus nyam/sa/ /'chab med rnam dag tsam las nyams par byed/ /rang bzhin gnas dang chos dang zang zing gi/ longs spyod lhan cig byed dang ltung ba 'dag/ gnas skabs lha mi mthar thug byang chub 'thob/ / sdo ma pa gong ma skye bcas dgos pa drug/ nyu/nga ba nyis brgya nga gsum dge tshul la/ / blangs 'das phyogs ma thun ltung med gsum du 'gyur/ /mkhan slob dngos blangs las 'das nyams pa gsum/ /rtsa bzhi yan la ga drug bcas bcu gsum mo/ /de dag nang gse zhib tu phye ba na/ /srog gcod las phye mi gsod dud 'gro gsod/ /srog chags dang bcas 'debs spyod gnyis dang bzhi/ /mi chos bla ma'i rdzun dang bzhi med dang / / bag tsam dbyen dang rjes phyogs khyim sun 'byin/ /rdzun dang bshes ngo 'phya dang zas cung ston/ /lhag mas sku dzod 'debs bslab pa spong ba dang / /'bras chan 'gebs bcas bcu gsum rdzun las phye/ /gar sogs gsum ste glu gar rol mo dang / /rgyan 'dogs spos byug kha dog phreng sogs bzhi/ /khri stan gnyis po re rer chen po dang / /mthon por phye bas ba'i bcas sum cu drug/ de steng dge slob ma la chos bcu gnyis/ / bsnan pas nyer lnga'am zhe brgyad dag tu gyur/ / gnas med zhag 'das ljongs rgyu ma dgag zhing / /khang ba khang chen brtsegs pa'ang blangs 'das yin/ /bsdu na yul bsam byed las ngo bo dang / /mi mthun phyogs gyur sgo nas bsdu tshul lnga/ / zhum pa spang phyir bcu ru grangs nges mdzad/ / go rim pham 'dra bzhi po lci rim dang / /yan lag drug ni 'dod yo na spyod dang bstun/ / mkhan slob gang rung drung du dngos blangs las/ / 'das pa'i ltu nga ba yin phyir blangs 'das zer/ / bsnyen par rdzogs dang ma rdzogs bye brag las/ /dge tshul ltung ba nyes byas kho nar bzhag/ 'chang 490

gnyis 'bral dang sa rko rin chen reg/ mi reg spangs za byin len ma byas za/ /gsog 'jog za dang shing 'dzeg shing gcod dang / / rtswa sngon mi gtsang 'dor dang sa bon 'joms/ /zla 'jog dgon pa'i 'bral spang gsog 'jog byed/ / dge tshul nyal dang mi smra 'gro ba ste/ /ltung med gnang ba phyed dang bco brgyad yin/ /de ltar blangs 'das nyu nga med ma gtogs pa/ / lhag ma nyis brgya dang ni gzhi bsdus kyi/ / ltung ba rnams ni phyogs mthun bsdam bya ste/ / de dag rtags kyi gzhi dang slong dang snod/ /longs spyod 'phyar g.yeng 'dod dang gnod pa dang / /gnas dang mi gus mi sbyong gzhi bcur 'dus/ / 'chab med pham pa'i nyes pa 'dag phyir du/ / bslab pa sbyin tshul sa ga zhan gnas pa yi/ /dman pa'i spyod lnga gso la bzhi'i las kyis sbyin/ /ngo bo bar ma'i dge ba yin par 'dod/ /de 'dra'i bslab spyin dge slong ltung ba yi/ /rten du rnam dag dang 'dra dngos gzhi skyed/ / dmigs bsal 'dun pa phyir bsgyur mi smra 'gro/ / dgra bcom bden smra'i ltung ba rnams mi 'byung / /bslab byin phan tshun byin len mi chags shing / / gcig gi lag nya gsog 'jog gcig la'ang 'gyur/ /de yis rnam dag la ni byin len 'chags/ /lag nya sogs kyang de 'a/ 'byung mi 'byung / /rnam dag pham bas ma gos pa la bshad/ / tshul de bslab byin /dge tshul sogs la'ang sbyo ra/ / phal che'i thun mo/nga lus kyi yan lag la/ / snga ma 'ga' zhig pham lhag dang po gnyis/ / rku dang srog gcod bzhi bcas bdun ma gtogs/ / gzhan la lus ni tha mal gnas da gos gsung / /'on kyang 'di la/ bsam pa'i yan lag gtso/ /dge slong rang nyid sman dang sngags sogs kyis/ /lus gzhan bsgyur ram mi snang dge slong gi/ /'du shes yod na sde lnga'i dngos gzhi bskyed/ / med na na smad sbom/ po sogs su 'gyur/ / dmigs bsal bal khur sa bon 'joms sogs la/ /lus kyi bon lag gzhan du ma bsgyur dgos/ /smyo dang sems 'khrugs sdug bsngal tshor bas gzir/ /gzugs gzhan bsgyur te dge slong 'du shes brjed/ /gnyid dang snyom sa zhugs ra ro brgyal ba ste/ /bsam pa rang bzhin mi gnas brgyad yin la/ / dang bo bzhi ni gtso bo gzhan bzhi min/ / bsam pa rang bzhin gnas pas sbyor byas te/ / rang bzhin mi gnas gtso bor mthar thug grub/ /19 1

sbyor ltung tsam las dngos gzhi'i ltung mi 'byung / /gtso bo min par sbyor dngos ltung ba gnyis/ / 'byung srid khang ba'i lhag ma la sogs bzhin/ /thun mong yan lag bslab tshigs gcig pa dgos/ /phyi ma len dus 'dun pa log dgos phyir/ /dge tshul rten la sbyor byas bsnyen rdzogs tshe/ /mthar thug grub kyang sbyor dngos na smad skyed/ /go ldog dge tshul bab la dngos gzhir 'gyur/ /bslab rgyun gcig pa'ang dgos te sbyor dngos kyi/ / bar du bslab pa phul la na smad do/ /rdzas dngos bkag pas de bas bzang ba dang / /'dra ba rnams kyang bkag pa nye bar mtshon/ /ltung ba phal che'i mtshan gyi yan lag ni/ /pha ma gnyis kur ltung ba mnyam por bcas/ /thun mong sdom gyis bsdus pa thun mong dang / /bzlog pa thun mong min pa'i ltung ba'i don/ /gnyis ga'i rten la ltung ba che chung mnyam/ / yul gyi yan lag gnyis gar yod pa'i rigs/ / mtshan nyid ci 'dra'i thun mong ltung ba ni/ / pham bzhi smyan dang gzhi med bag tsam dang / / 'chang 'jog slong dang slong rigs spangs pa slong / /so sor bskur dang gser dngul mngon tshan can/ /nyo tshong ltung bzed 'tshol dang tha ga gnyis/ /rdzun 'don bla ma bden smra sa bon 'joms/ /srog chags bcas 'debs rim lhag 'dug gnas phye/ /dus min kha mid srog chags bcas spyo da dang / /gcer bu dam/ga gsum me reg nub lhag nyal/ /kha dog longs pa khrus byed dud 'gro gsod/ / rtse dang sbed dang gzhi med rku dang rko/ /mgron gnyer ring 'dug chang dang dus min 'gro/ /phyi dro grong rgyu skya rengs khab ral dang / /gding bag yan dgab bde gshegs chos gos bcas/ /lnga bcu rtsa lnga sbyor ba shes bzhin du/ /mtshan gzhan gyur kyang dngos gzhi so na gnas/ /ltung ba gzhan la mtshan gzhan ma gyur dgos/ /gnyis gar mnyam zhing yul gyi yan lag ni/ /gang rung gcig nyid rgyud la yod pa'i rigs/ / rjes mthun ming tsam thun mong ltung ba la/ /mtshan mthun yan lag dgos pa bzhi bcu ste/ /bsgo gyur bzhi dang byin 'phrog bsdos bsgyur dang / /skyon dang phra ma skyo sngogs gnas ngan len/ /bshes ngor khyad gsod 'phya bsgo khri dang gding / /phyis gnon 'byung ba spangs stobs 'dus za dang / /rdeg dang zas dang gnas ngan len 'chab bde/ / 'dun bsgyur chos dang smra dang dge tshul 492

sdud/ /'gyod bskyed sor ma dngangs byed nyer 'jog spong / /nyan rna mi smra 'gro dang ma gus dang / /snga dro grong rgyu da gdong khri dang gdal/ /so so bshags pa bzhi las gsum pa rnams/ / sbyor byas mtshan gyur mthar thug na smad skyes/ / mtshan mi mthun pa yan lag da gos pa ni/ /'khrur 'jug go sa len ro/ la chos ston dang / /de dang lam 'gro bud med nyal dang lnga/ cho ga 'jig pa 'bral dang spangs pa za/ /gsog 'jog byed dang gsog 'jog za ba bzhi/ /de dag mtshan gyur phal cher ltung med 'gyur/ /des na ming tsam/ thun mong zhe dgu 'di/ /sbyor byas rten la mthar thug grub pa dgos/ /de yi thun mong min pa'i ltung ba ni/ /khu reg 'khrig bsngags khang ba khang chen dang / /srin ba'/ 'ba' zhig cha gnyis lo drug stan/ /ma/tho gang bal khung 'khru dang lhung bzed 'chang / /brtad pa las byung dgon pa'i 'bras spang dang / / ras chen skrod dang ma bskos la sogs bcu/ /yang yang za dang bsod pa slong ba dang / /nyal shom khyim na 'dug 'greng gdeng med spyod/ /nyi shu ma lon bsnyen rdzogs ras chen lhag/ song bshags lhag ma gsum bcas bco brgyad 'di/ /sbyor dngos pha yi rten la grub pa dgos/ / ma yi thun mong min pa'i ltung ba yang / /reg pham 'u sa bkan 'chab pham bzlog pham/ bzhi/ /thun mong mi na pa'i lhag ma bcu gsum dang / / spang ltung bcu bzhi (raba' zhig brgya rtsa brgyad/ /sor bshags bcu bcas brgya dang bzhi bcu dgu/ /sbyor dngos ma yi rten la 4grub dgos te/ /thun mong min pa de dag ma tshan gyur tshe/ /na smad dang ni ltung med ci rigs 'gyur/ /pha yi thun mong min pa'i nyes byas gnyis/ /ma bsgo stan 'dug rtswa sngon mi gtsang 'dor/ /ma la sham thabs skad pa snang byas bgo/ 'khrig pa'i bsam pas grong du 'gro ba gnyis/ /des na ma tshan gyur pa na ltung ba rnams/ /mnyam dang chung dang med pa ci rigs 'gyur/ /chung ba che bar 'gyur ba mi srid de/ /mtshan gyur lan cig lan gnyis gyur la sbyor/ /lan gsum gyur che ltung med sdom pa gtong / / mtshan gyur dbang gis mtshan nyid ci 'dra ba'i/ / sbyor dngos ltung ba yod med che chung du/ / mi 'gyur gnyis ka ltung ba'i zhing mtshungs phyir/ /ltung ba che ba chung bar 'gyur srid de/ /dge slong ma yis skyes pa gzhan dag la/ /reg bzhin mtshan gyur sbyor ba grub pa na/ /493

nyes byas yin gyi sbom por mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin chung ba che bar mi 'gyur te/ /dge slong skyes pa'i lus la reg bzhin du/ /mtshan gyur sbyor grub nyes byas tsam du 'gyur/ /de gnyis sbyor ltung byed bzhin dbang du byas/ / grub zin sbyor ltung che ba chung 'gyur te/ /reg pham sbyor ba can gyi dge slong ma/ / mtshan gyur lhag mar gtogs pa'i nyes byas 'gyur/ /dngos gzhi'i ltung ba'ang mnyam srid cher mi 'gyur/ /'byin pa'i ltung byed can gyi dge slong ma/ /mtshan gyur sor gnas 'byin lhag can mi 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i 'byin pa'i ltung byed de dge slong pha'i rgyud kyi ltung byed yin yang pha'i ltung byed ma yin te/ pha'i ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa la dgu bcur grangs nges pa'i phyir ro/ /lhung med mtshan gyur yod par mi 'gyur te/ /pha yis ltung bzed bcangs nas zhag dgu'i ma thar/ / mtshan gyur spang ltung mi 'byung 'das zhag dgu/ /ma/tshan gyur zhag de'i cha la gtogs pas so/ /thun mong min rnams 'ga' zhig med 'gyur te/ / dge slong bud med chos ston ltung byed dang / /'khor mang 'jog pa'i ltung byed byung ba'i ma/ / mtshan gyur ltung byed de dag gtan med 'gyur/ /mtshan gyur stobs kyis bcab nyes dag pas na/ / lhag ma bcab pa'i spo ba'ang spyod mi dgos/ / mgu ba spyad mthar mtshan gyur don med phyir/ /rang rang ma/ grub gzhi nas spyad dgos so/ /des na mtshan gyur lus dang des nyon mongs/ /de las gnyen po tshul khrims gnas 'gyur phyir/ /mtshan gyur sto bas kyis ltung ba gnas 'gyur ro/ /thun mongs yul gyi yan lag 'das pa dang / /ma 'ong lus dang rigs rgyud gtogs pa dang / /kha dog dbyibs dang yon tan cha yi lus/ /ltung ba'i byed por mi 'jog da ltar dang / /'gro ba gang dang shes rgyud gang gtogs dang / /'phen pa gcig pa'i lus rnams byed po yin / /dge slong chags pas skyes pa'i lus reg na/ / dngos gzhi sbom po sbyor ba nyes byas dang / /de ltar bud med la reg dngos gzhi la/ /lhag ma bskyed cing sbyor ba sbom por 'gyur/ /dge slong ma yis bud med la reg na/ /dngos gzhi ltung byed sbyor ba nyes byas dang / / de yis skyes par chags pas reg gyur na/ /dngos gzhi pham pa sbyor bas sbom por 'gyur/ /des na dge slong pha yis skyes pa dang / /sha reg bcas te lhan cig nyal ba na/ /mthar thug grub dus skyes pa mtshan gyur na/ /494

lus de sbyor ba'i dus su nyes byas dang / / dngos gzhi'i dus der lhag ma'i rten byed bzhin/ /'di ni rten gyi lus la'ang shes par bya/ /dud 'gro las skyes mi bsad pham pa dang / /mi las skyes pa'i dud 'gro'am/ mi ma yin/ /bsad na rim bzhin ltung byed sbom por 'gyur/ /mi nyid rdzu 'phrul sgo nas lus bsgyur tshe/ /'du shes gang gis bsad kyang pham par 'gyur/ /'di ni gang yin rung ste gsod snyam pa'i/ /kun slong spyi zhugs yod pa'i dbang du byas/ /sbyor ba'i khyad par mi dang mi min dang / /dud 'gro sems can min par 'du shes na/ /dang bor sbom po gzhan rnams nyes byas 'gyur/ /snga phyi'i lus gnyis 'phen pa gcig pa'i phyir/ /slob pa'i rten la sbyor bcoms dgra bcom tshe/ /mthar thug grub na pham pa ji bzhin skyed/ /'di la mdzod las mtshams med mi 'byung gsung / / rgya cher 'grel las pham pa mtshams med las/ / gnyis ga 'byung bar gsungs pa sbyor dngos kyi/ / bar du 'dun pa log dang ma log gam/ / yang na dgra bcom rten la nye sbyor ni/ / med dang yo/da pa'i khyad du khas blang ngo / /ltung ba tha dad skyed pa'i rgyu lnga ste/ /bslab rgyun tha dad pa ni lo drug stan/ /gnyis pa byed pa'i sbyor ba brtsams nas ni/ /khyim par babs rjes slar yang bsnyen rdzogs te/ /sbyor 'phro zin tshe sbyor ltung tha dad gnyis/ /dngo sa gzhi rnam pa'i ltung ba na smad bcas/ /tha dad 'byung phyir phyir bcos tha dad dgos/ / de ni mtshan gzhan chod la'ang shes par bya/ / kun slong rgyun ni tha dad sbyo ra byas nas/ /bar du 'dun log de rjes sbyor 'phro rdzogs/ /gong bzhin sbyor dngos rnam pa'i ltung bar 'gyur/ / bcas rigs tha dad ltung ba'i gzhi gcig la/ /ji snyed byas pa'i grangs mnyam ltung ba skyed/ /dper na rdzun gyis gzhan la skyon brjod na/ /rdzun dang skyon smra'i ltung byed gnyis 'byung bzhin/ / 'di ni ltung ba gcig nyid bcas pa'i rigs/ /du mar 'gal ba'i ldog chas btags par sems/ /kun slong rnam pa tha dad la brten pa/ /cha can dang ni char gtogs ltung ba rnams/ /ku/ na slong dbang gis ltung ba tha dad 'gyur/ / cha can rang gi cha dang sbyor ba dang / /dgag bya'i rigs dang gzhi yi yan lag gsum/ /ci rigs ma/thun zhing rang gi cha las lci/ / de bzhin cha yang rang gi cha can dang / / ci rigs mthun zhing cha can de 'a sa 495

yang / / pham pa bzhi dang bka' blo mi bde dang / / gsog 'jog za ba'i ltung byed cha can dang / /pham pas bskur 'debs dbyen gyi lhag ma med/ /gnyi sa ka yin la gzhan rnams char gyur ltung / / rang gi char gyur ltung dang kun slong gi/ rnam pa tha mi dad dang tha dad las/ /skyes pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi char gyur dang / / cha der gtogs kyi char gyur gnyis su yod/ /pham lhag sogs kyi rang rang sbyor ltung dang / /der gtogs nyes byas rnams ni dang bo dang / /char gtogs sde tshan gzhan rnams gnyis pa yin/ /mi tshangs spyod kyi char gtogs 'byin lhag dang / / reg dang 'khrig smra bsnyen bkur bsngags sogs yin/ / rku pham char gtogs byin 'phrog bsdos bsgyur sogs/ /srog gcod char gtogs sa bon 'joms pa dang / /srog chags 'debs spyod dam/ga lta la sogs so/ / dzum smra'i char gtogs skur 'debs lhag ma dang / / dbye'o dang dgra bcom/ bden smra'i ltung byed sogs/ / dbyen gyi char gtogs 'dus za bsnyil sdud sogs/ /de ltar ltung ba rang rang dgag bya'i rigs/ /gang dang ma/thun dang mi mthun legs dpyad nas/ /cha dang cha can sbyor tshul shes par bya/ /de yi char gtogs dang ne sder gtogs gnyis/ /mi 'dra 'byin lhag pham pa'i char gtogs kyang / /sder gtogs min pa'i khyang/ par 'byed pa gces/ /'bras bu tha dad la brten dper brjod na/ /rin thang ma tshang lan mang brkus pa'i rdzas/ /bsdoms pas rin thang tshang yang pham mi 'gyur/ /sbyor ba nyes byas dngos gzhi sgom po'o/ /so sor 'byung phyir bshags pa tha dad dngos/ /gzhan gyis phyed tsam byas pa'i khang stan sogs/ /'phro rdzogs dngos gzhi mi bskyed na smad 'gyur/ /sbyor ba'i ltung bar 'du shes yan lag dang / /dngos gzhi la ni dngos po gtso che ste/ /mi tshangs spyod dang 'byin lhag rdzun smra rnams/ / ma gtogs gzhan gyi dngos gzhi skyed pa la/ /gang bsam dngos po de ni yan lag yin/ /yan la ga ces pa rgyu yi don yin phyir/ /ltung ba dngos gzhi gang dang gang skyed la/ /yan lag ma tshang na smad sogs su 'gyur/ /ltung ba'i thun mong min pa'i yan lag ni/ /gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug yan lag bzhi/ /gzhi ni 'du shes dmigs dang kun slong skye/ /sbyo ra ba 'jug pa'i gzhi phyir de skad brjod/ /gzhi yi sgo nas sems can yin min las/ /496

sem/sa can spyi bskyed pham lhag dang bo gnyis/ /mi spyis bskyed pa rku gsod pham pa'o/ /bye brag khyim pa bud med rdzogs ma rdzogs/ / tha snya da 'di pa'i rab byung spyi bskyed drug/dge slong pha ma dge tshul mu stegs can/ / khyim pa pho mo bskyed bcas rnam pa drug/khyem/tshosun 'byin dang slong dang slong rigs dang / /rin thang so sor bskur dang mngon tshan can/ / nyo tshong lhung bzed 'tshol dang tha ga gnyis/ / ras chen brtad byung sbyor bcug yang yang za/ /'dug gnas phye da nga bsod pa zan gcod dang / /mgron gnyer ma smras grong 'gro grong du rgyu/ /pho brang 'gro dang sor bshags bzhi dang 1bcas/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun khyim/ pa spyis bskyed do/ / bud med spyis bskyed reg dang 'khrig tshig dang / /bsnyen bkur smyan dang dben par 'dug pa dang / /bud med lhan cig nyal dang drug yin no/ / bsnyen rdzogs spyis bskyed gzhi med bag tsam dang / / lhag mas bskur ba 'debs pa'i ltu nga byed gsum/ /ma rdzogs spyis bskyed 'a don dang gnas ngan len/ /mi chos bla ma bden smra nub lhag nyal/ /nyi shu ma lon bsnyen rdzogs byed dang lnga/ / tha snyad spyis bskyed smyan gyi 'phrin bya dang / /khang gnyis btsal yul pham rdzun gzhi med dang / /bag tsam khyim sun 'byin dang rdzun du smra/ / bshes ngor byed dang zas ngor sdig lta 'dzin/ /lhag mas bskur 'debs go yul bcu gnyis so/ /rab byung spyis bskyed sbed dang ma smras 'gro/ / dge slong phas bskyed mtshan mthun bzhi bcu'i steng / / skrod dang zas cung rdeg gzas ma lon rdzogs/ /gral rim nags ma brtags bcas bzhi bcu drug/dge slong mas bskyed 'khrur 'jug len dang rmel/ /'dug pa ma gtogs ma bskos la sogs dgu/ /sor bshags dang bo gnyis bcas bcu bzhi'o/ /dge tshul gyis bskyed bsnyil sdud gcig nyid dang / /'dug gnas gcer bur zas sbyin mu stegs bskyed/ /khyim/ pa phros bskyed nyal /shom 'dug dang 'greng / /dmag gsum rkun ma dang 'gro drug yin zhing / /mos bskyed chos ston nya la shom 'dug dang 'greng / /la ma/ du 'gro dang bzhi 'o dud 'gros bskyed/ /'debs spyod dud 'gro gsod bca sa rnam gsum mo/ /khyim pas bskyed la phyi ba'i rab byung dang / /ma chags rtags can 'chab bcas nya mas pa la /na smad 'gyur te phyed ni khyim par bshad/ / bud med bskyed la reg pa ma gtogs pa/497

reg pa zhes pas nang gi reg pa mi tshangs spyod dang phyi'i reg pa reg pa'i lhag ma gnyis bstan no/ /gzhan la rdzu 'phrul ma thob yul du dgos/ /rdzu 'phrul can la na smad nyid du 'gyur/ /reg dang ga ga tshil gyi dngos gzhi la/ /reg bya reg byed gnyis ka ma nyams dgos/ /dge slong pha mas bskyed la bsnyen rdzogs shing / / sdom pa skyes la ma/ nyam/sa cha lugs ldan/ /rdzogs pa spyis bskyed skabs su nyams pa'ang yul/ /tha snyad spyis bskyed yul la tha snyad lnga/ /nges par tshang dgos ma tshang na smad 'gyur/ /'di pa'i rab byung spyi bskyed ltung ba'i yul/ /rab byung tshul khrims thob la ma nyams dang / /dge tshul gyis bskyed pa yang de nyid kyi/ /sdom/ pa thob la ma nyams rang rang gi/ cha lugs ldan pa ltung ba'i yan lag yin/ /de bzhin rab byung yo byad rdzas sogs kyi/ /yan lag gang dgos tshang dang ma tshang las/ /thi/nga ba dngos dang na smad 'gyur tshul sogs/ /zhib cha'i khyad par che yang mangs kyis dogs/ /sems can min pa 'byung bas bskyed pa ni/ /sa rko chung rtse me reg la sogs so/ /ltung ba zas gos snod spyad nor gyur lnga/ /gzhi med bag tsam gnas ngan len brjod 'chab/ /lhag mas bskur 'debs ltung ba las gyur lnga/ /gsog 'jog sbyor bcug yang yang za sogs bcu/ /gcer pur zas sbyin zas gcod mgron gnyer dang / /chang 'thung snga dro grong rgyu sor bshags bzhi/ /de dag zas la brten pa nyi shu gcig/ gos kyis bskyed pa so drug spang ltung gi/ 'chang ba nas bzung rmel 'jug bar bcu bdun/ / tha ga gnyis nas bsdos bsgyur bar bdun bcas/ /bshes ngor khri dang chos gos byed dang sbyin/ /kha dog ma bsgyur sbed dang gdeng med spyod/ /bcu tshan tha ma'i gdal la sogs lnga'o/ /snod spyad la brten ltung bzed 'char dang 'tshol/ /khab ral 'chos te gsum mam byin 'phrog dang / /khri dang rtsa 'byung sbed dang khri rkang 'chos/ /lnga bo bsnan pas brgyad do nor las gyur/ / gser dngul len dang mngon tshan nyo tshong dang / / longs pa gzhir gtogs dang bcas rnam pa bzhi'o/ / bsam pa'i yan lag gnyis las 'du shes la/ /nges dang yid gnyis za ba'i 'du shes gnyis/ /sbyor ba la ni 'du shes gtso che ste/ /mi la dzud 'gror 'du shes bsad na ni/ /sbyor ba nyes byas dngos gzhi pham pa dang / /dud 'gro la ni mi ru 'du shes na/ /sbyor ba 498

sbom po dngos gzhi ltung byed 'gyur/ / kun slong rdzogs dang rigs 'byed ched bya gsum/ /rang don yan lag dgos pa gsum ldan dang / /gzhan rnams kun slong dang bo gnyis ldan yin/ /rdzun smra'i pham pa 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur bsngags/ 'bral gnyis byin 'phrog brtad byung ma gtogs si / / spang ltung lhag ma nyer drug bden smra 'phya/ / sbyor bcug yang yang za dang 'dug gnas phye/ / bsod pa slong dang ma reg mgron gnyer dang / / khab ral gdal sogs lnga dang sor bshags bzhi/ / zhe brgyad kun slong rang don kho nar dgos/ /gzhan nam thun rngo/nga don la sel bar 'gyur/ /mthar thug don go dgos pa so gsum ste/ /pham rdzun 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur gzhi med dang / /bag tsam rdzun smra sogs bcu 'phya dang bsgo/ /phyis gnon ma bsgos nyi nub zas ngor ston/ / spangs stobs zan gcod 'dun bsgyur spangs rjes phyogs/ / bsnyil sdud 'gyod bskyed dngangs byed lhag mas skur/ / bslab spong nyan rna ma gus da gdong tsho shes/ / 'di dag yul du tha snyad lnga ldan dgos/ / brjod tshong don ma go na na smad 'gyur/ / sbyor ba rang lus kho na'i byed pa can/ /mi tshangs/ spyod dang lhag ma dang bo gnyis/ /'bral dang ma/tho gang bal khur dgon pa'i 'bral/ /khri gding 'byung dang gos byed don mthun gru / /dben gnyis sbyor bcug yang yang 'dug gnas dang / /spangs dang 'dus dang dus min gsog 'jog za/ /kha ming nya9pa shom 'dug 'greng dmag nang gnas/ / rdeg dang gzas dang nub lhag kha ma bsgyur/ / khrus byed sor mo lhan cig gdeng med spyod/ /bud med rkun ma dang 'gro mgron gnyer dang / /nyan rna mi smra 'gro dang chang 'thung dang / /grong 'gro grong rgyu rgyal bo'i pho brang 'jug/ sor bshags gnyis pa dang bcas bzhi bcu bzhi/ / mthar thug don go de las phyis gnon dang / / spangs stobs spa ngas pa rjes phyogs dngangs byed dang / /nyan rna ma gus ma gtogs nyer bdun steng / /bsgo gyur bzhi dang 'khrur 'jug len dang slong / /slo nga rigs rin thang so sor bal rmel dang / /mngon tshan nyo tshong lhung bzed ras chen 'tsho la/ /sdig lta 'dzin dang ma lon bsnyen rdzogs te/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi ngag nyid byed can dang / /lus ngag gang yang rung ba'i byed pa can/ /bskur dang brtan byung bsngo sa bsgyur phyis gnon dang / /499

gos ster bshams dkrug srangs pa rjes phyogs dang / /bsnyil sdud ma guso dang bcas rnam pa dgu/ /gnyis ka dgos pa do gsum lhag len dang / /bsod slong sor bshags dang bo bcas te gsum/ /bcol yang rdzogs ba rku dang srog gcod bzhi/ /smyan dang khang ba khang chen srin bal dang / /'ba' zhig cha gnyis lo drug gser dngul len/ /'thag gnyis byin 'phrog sa bon skrod pa dang / /rim lhag me reg rin chen reg dang rtse/ / dngangs sbed sa rko khab ral la sogs bdun/ /so gnyis khri gding gnyis kyi gding ba dang / /sor bshags tha ma gsum gyi zas len rnams/ /bcol yang 'grub bo ltung ba 'di rag las/ /rku gsod lnga bo don go tsam gyis skyed/ /gzhan gyi yul la tha snyad lnga ldan dgos/ /sdom pa la sogs len pa'i rten la ni/ /smra mi shes kyang don go tsam gyis rung / /ltung ba'i mthol yul smra shes don go dgos/ /med tshe bcab pa'i nyes pa 'byung mi 'gyur/ /ngag gi byed pa can gyi ltung ba yi/ /dngo sa ga zhi skyed la mtshan nyid drug ldan dgos/ /rku gsod smyan byed ma gtogs bcol rdzo gas kyi/ /ltung ba skyed pa tha snyad lnga ldan la/ /mtshan nyid drug ldan ngag gis bskos pa dges/ /gzhan du sel bar 'gyur ro rgu gsod sman/ /brgyud nas bskos kyang dngos gzhi skyed par gsung / /de lta ra zhu ba spyir bstan gyi/ /dka' gnad pad tshal yongs phye nas/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi 'khyil ba 'dir/ /skal bzang rkang drug dgyes dgur rol/ /gso sbyong dbyar dang dgag dbye sra brkyang dang / /gos dang ko lpags sman dang las kyi gzhi/ /ltung ba phyir bcos dus dang dus min 'byung / / sa gzhan gnas pa spyod dang yongs sbyong dang / /las bye ba dang 'khor lo'i dbye ba dang / /rtsod pa phyir bcos gnas mal gzhi bcas las/ / bslab pa gso zhing mi mthun phyogs sbyong phyir/ / gso sbyong zhes bya dbye na zhi gnas dang / /mthun pa'i gso sbyong rnam pa lnga bcas yod/ /dngos su bying rgod rgyud nas nyon mongs rnams/ / spong phyir ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i spong khang gzhir/ / tshul khrims dag cing mang thos gdams ngag ldan/ /'dod chung chog shes lus sems dben pa des/ /zhi lhag bsgoms pas sngon bsags las sgrib sbyong / /ril chung byang bu chu tshor snod lta bu'i/ /gdos bu gsum btags ga nyid rmugs sel bar byed/ /bder gnas 500

bsam gtan 'phel phyir zhal ta pa/ /khyad par bcu gcig ldan pa las kyis bsko / /des kyang spong ba ba rnams mi g.yang phyir/ / phyag dar chag chag gdab 'di la mi 'dra ba gsum mtsho ṭīka las gsung / sogs las rnams bsgrub/ /gaṇḍi'i mdo las gsungs pa'i shing bcu drug/ mtsho ṭīka tu/ gaṇḍi'i rgyu ni tsan dan dang / rgya shug dang / sta ga pa dang /ltar kha dang / 'om bu dang / seng ldeng dang / 'od ma dang / tsan dan dmar po ste brgyad dang / de'i steng du rgya gar na yod pa'i shing bdun dang bco lnga ste gang 'dzom la byed do/ /zhes gsung / gang rung la/sa byas gaṇḍi che ba'i tshad/ / srid du sor mo/'i tshad kyis brgya rtsa brgyad/ /chung tshad brgyad cu rtsa ba zhi de'i bar 'bring / /zheng du sor drug dpangs su gnyis bya zhing / /zur brgyad ngos mnyam rtse gnyis sbam pa'i mgo/ gaṇa yog de nyid las bya sor bcu gnyis/ / zlum 'jam rtse gnyis ne'u le'i mgo bo bzhin/ / changs zungs dang bcas sor rno/ nyer bzhir 'gyur/ /bcu gnyis nyer bzhi sor mo'i tshad ldan pa/ /spong ba ba yi gaṇḍi zhes kyang bshad/ /'di'i dpangs zheng gi tshad gaṇḍi che ba dang 'dra bar bshad cing / spong ba ba'i gaṇḍi ni 'khar gsil du gsungs pa'ang yod la/ 'ga' zhig tu 'khar gsil de'i dod du bshad do/ /rab gnas brdung tshul lnga dang dus la sogs/ /tshad ldan byas pa'i phan yon dpag med 'byung / /3/tshams ched dbus nas dpag tshad phyed dang gsum/ / mtshams chung dpag tshad gnyis tshun gang 'os gcad/ / gding ba bzhi bcu shong ba dkyil 'khor ba/ /mtshams ma bcad par rtsig pa wa kha dang / /dgon pa la ni rgyang grangs tshun chad mtshams/ /mtshams gzhan byung dang las dang dge slong bral/ /re med mtshams zhig mtshams chen 'jig rgyu lnga/ /gnas gsum nye 'khor 'dom gang dge 'dun gyis/ / bzhed la blo mthun phyag dang gnas mal dang / / mchod gtor bsham zhing bsdu phyir gaṇḍi brdung / /kun kyang bshags bsdams byin gyis brlabs te 'dus/ /ma 'dus pa la 'dun pa yongs dag blang / / gso sbyong dgag dbyer 'dun pa yongs dag gnyis/ /las gzhan la ni 'dun pa kho na 'bul/ /mdo bskul 'don dang bsnyun gsol gtor ma bsngo/ /phyag 'tshal mdo gdon bshags pa yongs dag phul/ /gsol ba'i las byas so thar gleng gzhi dang / /pham lhag ma nges gang rung thos bsgrag gam/ /501

ril 'don rnam/ pa lnga yi/ gso sbyong gis/ / tshul khrims gso zhing nyes ltung sbyong bar byed/ /yongs dag byin brlabs ma/ byas nyes pa khegs/ /dmigs bsal gnas dus spyod lam rten gī dang / / mdor bsdus sngags dang dgag dbye'i gso sbyo nga ngo / / rgyal dbo sa ga chu sto da khrums smad dang / /smin drug rnams kyi mang ngo bcu bzhi ba/ /lhag ma bco lnga ba ste gnod dang 'dum// / bkra shes gso sbyong gsum po dus ma nges/ /dbyar dus 'gro 'dug bya byed ma nga spangs nas /gnas gcig gnas par khas blangs dbyar gnas te/ /dgos pa gnas khang ral grum 'chos pa dang / /'phya dang lus srog gnod dang don mang spong / /thos bsam 'phel dang dgag dbye sra brkyang 'byung / / mtshams nang der gnas rab byung sde lnga kun/ /bde ba'i rkyen tshang 'gal rkyen med pa ru/ /steng g.yogs sgo glegs bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang / /byi dor brgyan cing gnas mal stobs pa bsko/ /khrims brjod gnas brtan gsol ba'i la sa byas te/ /tshul shing 'brim pa'i skabs kyi bya ba bsgrub/ / rgan rim/ gnas mal stobs shing snyan gsan 'bebs/ / ji tsam snga bzhin bsod nams che bas na/ / gro zhun khrums kyi mar ngo'i tshes gcig gi /skya rengs shar ma thag nas zla gsu ma/ bar/ / sngags tshigs gsum gyis snga phyi khas len bya/ / ma grub yid dam ca ma gyis 'chags pa'ang bshad/ / dge tshul lnga phrugs mi (ldan dge slong rnams/ / kho nas khas blangs 'chags kyang nyes byas so/ / dam tshig bsrung zhing dbyar ral rgyu sogs spang / /mtshams 'das byin rlabs bya zhing gnang ba thob /nyin zhag bzhi bcu bar gyi byin rlabs rung / /'di la gcig car tshe gur byin rlabs gnyis/ /tshe gur byin rlabs bya tshul ni/ /zhag bdun gyi byin rlabs 'a na lnga byas te/ de nas zhag lnga'i byin rlabs byed pa yin par mtsho ṭīka tu gsu nga / ba'i bcu lhag min mtha' zhag drug la'ang min/ /'on kyang mtha' zhag drug la rung ba'ang bshad/ /srog dang tshangs spyod la gnod 'tsho rkyen sogs/ /mi 'byor dbyang ral nyes pa med pas na/ /glo bur dgag dbye byed pa cis mi rung / /dbyar nang ltung ba gleng sogs dgag pa las/ /gleng so gas skabs dbye bas na dgag dbye ste/ / yul ni phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun mtha' dag rnadang / /rten ni khas blangs ma blangs ral sogs kun/ /dus ni ston zla 'bring bo'am tha 502

chung nyar/ /sbyor ba phal cher gso sbyong skabs bzhin bya/ /gsol gnyis las kyis byed pa bskos pa'i mdun/ /ltung ba'i dgag dbye sngags tshigs brjod pas bya/ /bskos pa des kyang med na gzhan la rung / / rdzas kyi dgag dbye khab sogs rdzas kyis bya/ /dmigs bsal gzhi dang gang zag gnyis bzhag dang / / dus ni gso sbyong gnyis sam gsum nas dang / / tshogs dang byin rlabs gzhan dang lhan cig dang / / 'thab krol can gyi snga phyir bya ba dang / /mi nus sngags tshigs gnyis sam lan gcig dang / /dgag dbye 'bul dang byin rlabs byed sogs yo da/ / dgos pa chos rnam/sa rnam dag bya tshoba'o/ /gnas gcig bsdu dang sbyin bdag tshogs rdzogs dang / /'chang bral 'jog dang gos slong yang yang za/ /'dus za ma smras 'gro dang gos mang 'chang / /rnam sbyar bla gos med par ljongs rgyu sogs/ /ltung med rnyed pa thun mong bder gnas phyir/ /gang zag khyad par bdun ldan gnas gcig tu/ / khas blangs ma/ ral gnas der sra brkyang gding / / dbyar byung gos rnyed rung ba tshad dang ldan/ / dge 'dun gyis dbang chos gos gsum phrug ste/ /tshogs pas zhag ma lon par mos pa bya/ /nang du blo mthun gsum phrug ji snyed pa/ /de snyed gdings ba bo rnams bsko zhing gtad/ /des kyang bkru drub kha bsgyur sems gsum bskyed/ / sra brkyang 'dir 'gyur byin rlabs phyungs shig ces/ /kun la bsgrag cing 'du ba'i skabs bsgrub bo/ /dngos gzhi gding bos sra brkyang thogs nas ni/ /sngags tshigs gsum bya mjug tu re re'i mdun/ /bting ngo zhes brjod dge slong rnams kyis kyang / /legs dang shin tu bting ngo zhes sogs brjod/ /smin drug zla ba'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig nas/ /dbo zla'i nya'i bar zla ba ril bo lnga/ /gzhan gyis ma spyad gsar bas sra ba dang / /gzeb kyi sgrog mar brkyang bas sra brkyang zer/ /'dra chos bzhi yis gtan pa zhes kyang btags/ / bsang bsrad rdul sprug ma gus rang 'jug bral/ /spangs pa'i tshul gyis gding po'am sped pos bskyang / /mtshams gzhan khyer dang srung med skya rengs shar/ /dus 'das dus min shes nas gso sbyong byas/ /dngos po zhing dang rten zhing min par gyur/ /dkyil 'khor khongs gtogs chad pa spyi yi dang / /mtshams la re ba med pa'i ma ma brgyad/ /mtshams la yid gnyis za ba'i ma ma brgyad/ /503

mtshams la re ba yod pa'i ma ma brgyad/ / rnyed par yid gnyis za ba'i ma ma drug/rten zhing min gyur sgos kyi rang 'jug bral/ /dus sam snga bar nya shi gang rung la/ /cho gas dbyung ba bcos ma'i dbyung ba'o/ /dad rdzas mi slob bdag po slob pa byin/ /tshul ldan thos brtson rjes gnang le lo can/ /bu lon tshul 'chal ñtsa gas bsregs spyod pa'i tshul/ /tshul 'chos kha bsag gzhogs slong thob kyis 'jal/ /rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba'i log 'tsho lnga/ /yongs spangs rnam dag 'a tsho bas bsgrubs pa'i gos/ /kha tshar phun tshang ma bcad gso ma dang / /phyar ja bal dpag bsam shing las byung / /kha dog ma bsgyur khra bo sogs mi rung / /rgya skyegs le brgan rma shing rtsi dang btsod/ /mtha'i mtshal pa sindhu ra dang gur gum ste/ /mi rung tshon chen brgyad de rung ba ni/ /sngon po btsag dang ngur smrig rtsi gsum mo/ /phying ba la ba be'u phrug spu can dang / /klam dang seng ba lnga la lhan thabs rung / /bal dang ras dang sha na nyi 'og gos/ /zar ma go tam pa dang du gu la / /rung ba'i tshon gyis bsgyur ba chos gos rgyu/ /'tsho lhag mkho gsum phran tshegs byas pa las/ /byin rlabs chags rung chos gos chen po gsum/ /srid du khru lnga zheng du khru gsum ste/ /chung tshad phyed phyed phri zhing de'i bar 'bri nga / /rnam sbyar rnam phran sgo nas skor dgu yod/ /mthang gos zheng do srid du lnga'am bzhi/ /tshal bu mtheb sor gang nas sor bzhi'i bar/ /bya zhing ma/tha' skor lcags ri'ang de dang 'dra/ /sham thabs nyin dang sham thabs gzan ni mtshan/ /mthang gos nang gyon tshad kyang mthang gos bzhin/ /rdul gzan rdul gzan gzan yang nyin dang mtshan/ /stod du bgo zhing tshad ni bla gos bzhin/ /ma dras stod g.yogs srid zheng bcu gnyis gsum/ /smad g.yogs srid la khru bdun zheng tshad do/ /'bring tshad ma gsungs 'di gnyis khyim pa'i gos/ /gdong phyis khru gang rnag gzan rnag nad can/ /sha la bcar te bgo zhing tshad gang 'os/ /g.yan pa dgab pa g.yan nad can gyi gos/ /sha la sbyar ba srid zheng drug dang gsum/ /skra bzed zheng la phyed do srid khru gsum/ /gding ba zheng la khru do sor mo drug/ srid du khru gsum mi chog phyed do bskyed/ /dbyar gyi ras chen srid la khru dgu dang /zheng la khru gsum sor mo bco brgyad do/ /de rnams rung ba'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad dngos 504

yin phran tshegs ni/ /zhwa dang ska rags gtur bu lham sgrog sogs/ /'tsho ba'i gos lhag lhag pa'i yo byad dang/ /zhwa thebs lham thebs la sogs phran tshegs yin/ /mkho ba'i gos ni ring 'gag bem po dang / /gos yug la sogs khrar longs da ngos yin la/ /ma longs dar ras kha phyed sogs phran tshegs/ /de dag tshul bzhin byin rlabs 'tsho ba'i gos/ /rang dang gzha na rnams gnyis ku'i bsam pas 'chang / /sngags dang rten zhing min dang gos zhing min/ /gzhan la byin pa byin rlabs 'jig rgyu bzhi'o/ /khru la rdul khru lus khru lag khru gsum/ /so so'i gzhal bya'i khyad par shes par bya/ /spyir gtang sa tshigs kyis phye yul dbus su/ / mchil lham sogs dang ko lpags longs spyod bkag/dmigs bsal gnang ba'i skabs yod mtha' 'khob tu/ / mchil lham ko lpags la sogs gnang bar bshad/ /rten bcas dbang bor phan phyir sman zhes bya/ /dri ro reg bya'i bdag nyid kham gyi zas/ /'dir bstan sman yin dus dang thun tshod rung / /zhag bdun sman dang ji srid 'tsho bcang bzhi/ / dang bos bkres pa gtso bor sel bar byed/ /zan dron 'bras chan nya dang snum 'khur sha/ rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma me tog 'bras/ /de rnams bza' bca' dus su rung ba yin/ /gnyis pas skom pa gtso bor sel ba ste/ /dbye na sman bzhi'i rgyu las byung ba bzhi/ /rim bzhin tsam thang sla ba tshags kyis btsags/ /bcos pa'i tshwa dang bu ram khu ba dang / /a ru ra yi khu ba sla ba bzhin/ /zhag bdun sman gyis gtso bor rlung nad sel/ /zhun mar 'bru mar zhag dang sbrang tsi dang / /bu ram dbu ba la sogs zhag bdun pa'o/ /'tsho bcang sman ni gtso bor 'dus nad sel/ /rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma me tog dang / /'bras bu las byung sman du grags pa dang / /spyi ba 'gyur byed lan tshwa btung ba'i sman/ /bdug sman bcas te gtso bo min pa lnga/ / rung ba tshad ldan byin len ma zhig pa/ / gsog 'jog char gtogs bcas pa 'gog pa'i phyir/ /rang rang dus par byin rlabs snga dro byed/ /byin rlabs can gsum bsres nas longs mi spyod/ /dus rung dang 'dres dus rung kho nar spyad/ /byin len 'jig rgyu bcu dang 'phen pa zad/ / sngags kyis phyung dang ngo bo 'gyur bas 'jig/nad med byin rlabs med pa dus kun tu/ / spyad rungari byin can mi bza' byin mi 505

brlab/ /dmigs bsal lam zhugs dge bskos lag gi bla/ / zan chad pas kyang byin gyi brlab tu rung / /mu ge nad dang dgos pa yod gyur na/ /lag nya mtshams btsos rjen btsos bcoms ldang sogs / / tshad min bcas rkyang dgag pa med par gnang / /mtshams btsos zhag lon la sogs 'gog pa'i phyir/ / chud za btsog pa'i gnas min mang po la/ / mkho ba'i gnas sogs min pa'i mtsham sa nang du/ / rdo btegs mtha' byung rung khang la ga gi blas/ / sems bsdus mtha' byung dge slong mang bos gcod/ /las kyi mtha' las byung ba dge 'dun gyis/ / 'phral gyi ma tha' byung dge slong ji snyed pas/ /rim ba zhin 'gram rdo 'jog dang las gsar byed/ /grub zin dge slong gnas dang sleb 'phral du/ /so so'i sngags brjod byin gyis brlab par bya/ /de rnams ma grub shes pa chung ngu dang / /'jug pa mi zhan pa gnyis byin brlab bya/ /byed las der gnas kun gyi bya ba byed/ / mtsham/sa 'jig rgyu dang dge slong mtshan 'gyur dang / /dngos po nyams pas rung khang byin rlabs 'jig/ zas la 'jug tshe lham phud bla gos gyon/ /snga chab byin len phud mchod changs su byin/ / zas sman rang nyid nad pa'i 'du shes kyis/ / rgyags phyir ma lags snyem/sa pa'i phyir ma lags/ / 'tshag phyir ma yin lus gnas 'ba' zhig phyir/ / 'byung ba 'dra ba 'gyur ba rgol ba dang / / rten 'byung rgyu mthun btsal dang rag las dang / / nad bcas so sor 'gro ba'i 'du shes bcus/ /bag yod tshul mthun spyad nas lhag ma bsngo/ /phyi chab yon bshad zag pa dben par 'dod/ /dge 'dun dang 'brel las la sbyor ba ni/ /'du ba'i gnas su chag chag phyag dar dang / /gnas mal mchod bshad gaṇḍi brdung sogs la/ /las kun sngon 'gro 'du ba'i skabs sgrub zer/ / grangs tshang kha skong mi mthun gnyis bral ba/ / yul dbus ma dbyung sde gnyis bzhi bcu dang / / ma bsnyen rdzogs la pha bcu ma bcu gnyis/ / ma tha' 'khob ma dbyung pha bcu ma bcu dang / /yul dbus pha dbyung ba la pha nyi shu / /dbus su snga rol sdom gnyis 'khor ma nga dang / /'khor 'jog gnang ba sbyin la ma bcu gnyis/ /pha lnga ma drug mtha' 'khob ma bsnyen rdzogs/ /dbus su pha bsnyen rdzogs la pha tshogs bcu/ /ma/ yi dgag dbye pha lnga ma bzhi dang / /spo dgu spyod la pha ma bzhi bzhi brgyad/ /ma 506

drug mtha' 'khob sdom gnyis 'khor gnang sbyin/ / pha yi dgag dbye la ni pha tshogs lnga/ /las gzhan la ni nyung mtha' dge 'dun bzhi/ / bzhi bcu nyi shu dgu brgyad lnga bzhi'i grangs/ / ma tshang mi 'chags gzhan la nyes byas so/ / 'greng dang yu la min 'dun sogs phul ba min/ /ma rdzogs nyams dang sdig lta can ma yin/ / mtshams med sa gzhan tha dad gnas pa min/ / 'khrul bcas mtshams dang dkon mchog gzhan ma yin/ /mtshan mthun tha snyad gsum ldan tha mal gnas/ /mtsham/sa mang yid gnyis za dang zhe 'gras min/ /smon pa'i gnang ba ma thob kha skong 'os/ /lus sam 'dun pas ma 'dus mi mthun skyed/ / mtshams khongs der gtogs spyod lam ma nyams pa/ / rang bzhin gnas dang ngag bsdams kha skong 'os/ / 'dul ba shes dang zhe 'khon med pa yis/ /gral der tshig gis phyir zlog med pa dgos/ /las mkhan khyad par bdun ldan 95sa mkhas dgos/ /dmigs bsal spo mgu spyod ldan rnams kyis kyang / /tshangs spyod sdom tshotshangs spyod nyer gnas kyi las nyes byas 'chags par gsungs/ min las gzhan nyes mi 'chags/ / bsgrub bya sems can min par bya ba ni/ / shi rdzas byin rlabs mtshams gcod sra brkyang dbyung / /rim bzhin gsol ba gsol gnyis gsol bzhis bsgrub/ /mu stegs gnas dang khyim gyi sdom pa sbyin/ / de gzhig lhung bzed sgrub srong khyim pa la/ /bsgrub bya bsnyen par rdzogs la sbyin dang bko/ / chad dang rnam dag las kyi bsgrub pa bzhi/ / ma rdzogs pa la'ang sbyin sogs ci rigs yod/ /sbyin la gsol 'debs bsko bar spro ba 'dri/ /chad pa'i las la gleng dran sngon song dgos/ /mtshams gnyis gcod pa lta bu dngos po gtso/ /nan tur las bcu lta bu dge 'dun dang / /bsnyen rdzogs lta bu gang zag 'du shes gtso/ /kun slong byams dang snying rje nges 'byung gis/ / bsta na 'gror phan 'dod snying nas byed pa dgos/ /las ni tshang la ma nor ma 'khrul dgos/ /pha ma'i cho ga chad las mgu dbyung sogs/ / rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa phan tshun nor yang 'chags/ / yan lag nyams dang gong 'og cung zad 'khrugs/ / brjod don go na tsho 'chags pa'i dmigs bsal gsung / / gang la gra ngas tshang dgos pa de kun gyis/ /gsol ba tshang zhing gzhan gnyis mjug sdud bcas/ /tshig thos don go nyams su myong ba 507

yin/ /las gang rang gi brjod pa phyi ma med/ / de yi gsum gnyis rdzogs tshe la sa de 'chags/ /thun mong mkho ba'i las ni brgya rtsa gcig/ gsol ba 'ba' zhig nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / /gsol gnyis zhe bdun gso la bzhi'i las sum cu/ /gsang ston bsko dang nang du bar chad dri/ /gso sbyong ltung ba yid gnyis rtsod pa dang / /ma nges byin rlabs dgag dbye'i yang bzhi dang / / dbyar dang tshul shing shi rdzas nor byin rlabs/ / sra brkyang gos sbyin gnas ngan len brjod dang / /bshes ngor 'phya dang zur 'phya bsgo ba dang / /mi smra rna gzon bslab byin de gzhig dang / /lhung bzed kha sbub de srong gsol ba'i las/ /gnas la blo mthun mtshams gcod mi 'bral sbyin/ /smyos pa'i gnang sbyin dgag dbye byed pa bsko/ /gnas mal stobs pa dur khang byin rlabs dang / /sra brkyang blo mthun de gdir zhal ta bsko/ /lag bla gnas khang zas thug bag chos 'brim/ /phran tshegs 'brim dang snod spyad sgrub dang dgos/ / ras chen sbed 'gyed mngag gzhug mdzes chos bsko/ / gzugs la rtsod sbed tshul shing khang ba dang / / khang chen ltung gleng rnam sbyar mi 'bral gnang / /stan gyi gnang sbyin lhung bzed 'brel med 'brim/ /sdig lta go byed ston dang nags nyul bsko/ /phyag mi bya dang 'khor dang 'khor ming 'jog/'khar ba dra ba'i gnang dang rnyed gcig bya/ /sdom gnyis sbyin dang bu dang lhan cig nyal/ / nye du'i khyim dang dbyar mtshams phyir 'gro ba'i/ / gnang ba sbyin pa'i las rnams gsol gnyis so/ /bsnyen rdzogs mu stegs gnas sbyin mtshams gnyis dgrol/ /phan tshun mthun dang mthun pa'i gso sbyong sbyin/ / gnas dbyung nan tur las dang bzod gsol dang / /spo mgu'i las drug rang bzhin sra brkyang dbyung / / dran dang ma myos 'du la sbyin ngo bo 'tshol/ / dbyen dang de rjes phyogs dang khyim sun 'byin/ /bka' blo mi bde sdig lta mi gtong ba/ /gnas dbyung rjes phyogs mi dang dkon mchog gtong / /'thab krol byed dang bde zhing gnas pa dang / /gnas 'jug bsgo gyur las bcu dge tshul bsnyil/ / nyams la bslab sbyin gsol bzhi'i las yin no/ / bsdu na gsol ba 'ba' zhig la sogs gsum/ / bsgrub bya'i sgo nas sems can yin mi na gnyis/ / ma yi ston dang dgag dbye byed pa bo/ /ras chen sped po gzugs la gsal 508

ba'i gsal/ /drug po pha yi rten dang phyag mi bya/ /bzlog pham 'thab krol las zlog bsko ba mdzad/ /dkon mchog gtong dang bde gnas gnas 'jug sbyin/ / snga rol sdom gnyis 'khor dang 'khor mang 'jog/ bu chung nyal dang nye du lhan cig 'brel/ /bcu gnyis ma dang gzhan rnams thun mong ngo / /dbyen spang rlabs chen bstan la gzhug pa dang / /'phel dang bag yangs bya ba'i gsol bzhi dang / / sde snod sdud pa bsko ba'i gsol ba/nyis dang / /mdo ra bsdus las rnams 'dir bstan brgya rtsa gcig/ gang rung min cing dri dang lan sbyin dang / / gso sbyong dgag dbye chos gos byin rlabs sogs/ /las dngos min yang las su btags pas na/ /gang zag dang 'brel las kyi ming can no/ /dge 'dun grangs tshang las brjod las byed pa/ / gsum tshogs las chog 'di dang las ma gcig/ ltung ba phyir bcos thabs kyi nan tur ni/ /dge 'dun mtshan nyid gsum ldan dbyar nang dang / / brel g.yeng min dus sdom pa gso rung ldan/ /lus ni tha mal shes pa dang bzhin gnas/ /dbyung dang chos min phyogs dang tshogs longs min/ /gleng dran sngon song nad pa ma yin dang / /dge 'dun 'byed nus min dang gzhi lnga la/ /nyes spyod 'phro bcad mi 'jug phyir du bya/ /khyad par spyod pa lnga spangs chad las kyis / /'thab krol ma 'dul gnas nas 'byin zhes bsdigs/ /lhag ma'i ltung ba rgyun gcod phyir du smad/ /khyim rusun 'byin pa phyung ba'i gnas nas bskud/ / phyir 'gyed khyim par brnyas byed mdza' gcugs btang / / byed por skur 'debs ma bzlog lhag ma'i rgyu/ /mngon sum brgyad kyis gtan 'bebs nyer ma zhi/ /ma mthong mi 'chos sdig lta mi gtong dang / /'thab krol la 'bab de rgyu nye bar sgrub/ /'dres shing gnas rnams zlog pa lngas ma bzlog/ gnas nas dbyung ngo gleng skabs mi 'byed na/ /lhan cig gso sbyong bzhag dang dgag dbye bzhag/ dge tshul bsnyil dang lhung bzed kha sbub bo/ /dgra bcos thob dang bzod gsol kun las grol/ /lhan cig gso dgag byas pas bzhag gnyis dang / /nan tur phyi mas lnga ma dag las grol/ /phyir bcos dngos la bcabs nyes mi 'byung phyir/ /ltung ba byung tshe 'phral du mthol bar bya/ /sde sno da gsum mkhas ngo tsha khrel yod ldan/ /khyad par can gyi lhag ma'ang gcig gi 509

mdun/ /ltung ba'i ming rigs sgo nas bsha gas pas 'dag/ de min zhag grangs du bcabs spo ba nod/ /gus pa bdag byed mnyam pa'i lhag bsam dang / /bla ma'i gnas dang chad las gtogs pa dang / /ston pa'i khyad par dang nye spyod lnga spang / /nang bar chos ston gdugs tshod dus kun dang / /dgongs dus dman spyod lnga yis spo ba spyad/ /de rjes mgu ba pha yis zhag drug dang / /ma yis zla phyed spya da de dbyung ba ni/ /gsol dang brjod pa'i bar du bsdigs shing smad/ / mjug tu gzengs bstod rang bzhin gnas su dbyung / / pham/tshopa 'chab bcas byung na gnas dbyung bya/ / 'on kyang gcig pur sdig pa 'dag phyir 'bad/ 'chab med bslab pa mnos te 'tsho ba'i bar / /khyad spyod lnga spang dman spyod lnga la bslab/ /pham pa'i sbom po lci yang drug dang bzhi/ /lhag ma'i lce ba dge slong lnga la bshags/ /ltung byed sor bshags bshags bya'i nyes byas gsum/ / dge slong khyad par brgyad ldan gcig la bshags/ / spang ltung zhag gi chad las sngon du btang / /khyad par can gyis bshags pas chog par gsung / /dus dang dus min bsdus pa 'byung ba'i gzhis/ / gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug yan lag tsho gis/ /lhag ma bcabs pa'i nyes pa 'byung tshul bshad/ /sa gzhan gnas pa spyod pa'i gzhi yis ni/ / sa/ gzhan gnas pa'i dbye bsdu mtshan nyid dang / / bslab bya sgra bshad grol ba'i dus bcas bshad/ /spo mgu spyod drug spo mgu ldan pa drug/ / bsdigs smad bskrad dang phyir 'gyed gnas dbyung bdun/ /bsnyil dang ngo bo nyid 'tshol bslab byin te/ /sa gzhan gnas pa nyi shu rtsa drug ste/ /zhib mor phye na bzhi bcu zhe bzhir 'gyur/ /spo mgu 'khor las sbo mgu spyod las grol / / mgu byin spo ldan dbyung byas mgu ldan las/ /ltung dran bzod byas ngo bo nyid 'tshol dang / /grol dus gzhan rnams nan tur skabs gzhin no/ /yongs sbyo nga gzhi yis nyes spyod dran byed cing / /phyir bcos sogs la dgod nas rgyud sbyong phyir/ /tshul khrims lta ba cho ga 'tsho ba rnams/ /nyams pa'i ltung ba gleng dran byed tshul bshad/ /las kyi dbyen ni mtshams nang mi mthun par/ / dge 'dun phyogs gnyis phye ste gso sbyong sogs/ /las brgya co gcig gang rung byas pa ste/ /yul dus dbang gis 'byung nye gzab dgos so/ /dge 'dun dbyin ni ston par 'gran 510

sems kyis/ / dge 'dun ston dang bstan pa gzhan du phye/ /chos 'khor bskor ba'i bar du gcod pa ste/ /sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs 'dzam gling kho nar 'byung / /rtsod pa'i nang gi rgyu ni chags sogs gsum// /phyi rgyu de nyid log sgrub spong ba dang / /ltung bcas las la mthun pa mi sbyin bzhi/ /gzhan gyi mi mthun smra ba'i tshig rjes su/ /sems gzhol 'khon 'dzin shes pa ngo bo'o/ /dbye ba 'gyed phyir rtsod dang mi gdams phyir/ /ltung phyir rtsod dang las phyir rtsod pa bzhi/ /zhib tu phye na mi gdams phyir rtsod la/ /rgyu bcas gcig dang rgyu med rnam pa bzhi/ /gzhi med gzhi gzhan rjes su sgrub pa dang / / phyir bcos mi ltos smyon pas byas pa'o/ / ltung phyir rtsod la ngo bo mi shes gcig/ phyir 'phros med dang phyir 'phros nyi tsha ba/ /dge 'dun mtha' dag dang 'brel rtsod pa ste/ /ngo bo shes pa gsum ste bcu gcig 'gyur/ /'chi bzhin pa 'am bslab pa phul ba ni/ /ku na gyi zhi byed 'gyur te so so'i ni/ /dang bo'i zhi byed rgol dang gzu bo dang / /dge 'dun bzhi bo gsal ba gsal ba'i gsal/ /dge 'dum gzhan dang sde snod 'dzin pa dang / /gnas brtan mthu dang ldan pa'i mngon sum ste/ /mngon sum rnabargyad dang gang mang zhi byed gnyis/ /rgyu bcas mngon sum rgyu med dag pa byin/ /'di yi gsum ni dran pa'i 'dul ba byin/ /phyi ma ma myos 'dul ba byin pas ni/ /phyir 'phros med pa ltung ba khas len dang / /phyir 'phros nyi tshe'i rtsod pa mngon sum gyis/ /dge 'dun kun 'brel rtswa 'gram lta bus dang / / mi shes ngo bo nyid 'tshol sbyin pas zhi/ / las phyir rtsod la mthun pa sbyin pa ni/ /dngos dang gzhan rnams rgyud nas zhi byed yin/ /ltung phyir rtsod la phyir 'phros med sogs gsum/ /mi gdams phyir la gzhi med la sogs bzhi'i/ /dbye ba gsungs pa mtshungs phyir phan tshun sbyar/ /de bzhin phyir 'phros med la khas len dang / /phyir 'phros nyi tsher mngon sum zhi byed du/ /gsungs pa phan tshun sbyar rung rgyu mtshan mtshungs/ /gnas dbyung phyir bcos rtsod pa mtha' ru bskyal/ /kun gyi rten gyur gnas mal gzhi la ni/ /phyag 'os mchog gsum ston dang bslab pa rgan/ /nyams dang sa gzhan gnas dang mtshan mi mthun/ /nyal dang snyoms 'jug mun khrod sbags sogs min/ /gcer bu gos gcig sbags pa sogs kyis min/ /phyag ni yan lag lnga gtugs 511

sgyid 'khyud gnyis/ /bsod na mas gsog ched mang bo 'du ba dang / /thos bsam sgom pa 'phel phyir dben gnas su/ /gtsug lag khang brtsig zad par ting nge 'dzin/ /skye bar sla phyir sna lnga'i tshon gyis byug/ phugs su dri gtsang khang dang sgo khang du/ /bden bzhi mtshon phyir mi rtag srin po'i ltor/ /steng du lnga cha gnyis la lta dang mi/ /'og tu lnga cha gsum la ngan song gsum/ / chags sdang gnyis po gti mug las byung brdar/ /dbus su phag gis phug non sprul bzung ba / /lto ba'i mtha' skor yan lag bcu gnyis po/ / rgan mo long ba'i gzugs brnyan la sogs bri/ / de ni sdug kun 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras mtshon/ /'khor lo'i steng du sangs rgyas phyag mdzub kyis/ /'gog bden mtshon byed dkyil 'khor dkar bo ston/ /de 'og brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis bri lam bden mtshon/ /mchod rten gtsang khang can dang ka ba can/ / rnam gnyis bzhengs pas 'gro mang bsod nams gsog/ rgyal bstan 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dgos pa yod/ / 'a dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs su/ / tshangs spyod dal 'byor rten thob ste/ /'dul gzhung rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas/ / sku gsum gling du phyin gyur cig/ ces 'dul ba'i sdom tshig gnad bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sngar gzhi smad kyi skor rags rim zhig tshigarngan bcad du bsdebs par brten mang thos legs bshad don du gnyer ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gis cha tshang zhig cis kyang dgos zhes nan tan che ba'i ngor/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos paṇa chen bde legs nyi ma'i yig cha gzhir bzung gzhan nas kyang legs cha mang bos kha bskangs te/ rab 'byams smra ba arba sirnyi dam ming gzhan dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis sug bris bgyis pa kun la phan thogs rgya chen por gyur cig/lko swa ste/ tshul 'di khul kha jo nang pe se'i shog/ dpyod ldan dge slong ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis/ /chos spyin rgya cher spel ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /mthun rkyen sbyar te par du legs par bsgrubs/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i thus/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor rten brgyud de/ /dpal ldan bla mas dgyes bzhin rjes bzung nas/ /smin grol lam bzang myur du mthar phyin shog/ /512

༄khya/ /dge slong gi bslab bya gnam rtse ldeng ma'i brda don 'ga' zhig bzhugs so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de yang gnam rtseng ldeng ni stod lung yangs pa can yin par bshad cing / 'di la gnam tseng ldeng dang / gnam rtsibs steng sogs yi ge mi mthun pa 'ga' byung / de ni ar byang chub ye shes kyi gdan sa yin/ snyan pa'i ba dan zhes sogs kyi sho lo ka gnyis so thar gyi mdo'i mchod brjod dang bshad par dam bca' yin te/ 'jig rten gsum ni khams gsu ma dang /dkon mchog mdzod brnyes pa ni/ lung rtogs kyi chos dkon mchog gi mdzod 'phagab/ pa'i dge 'dun 'khor du brnyes nas smin par mdzad pa'i don dang / gtsug gi nor bu ni 'dir spyi bo dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i bslab gzhi dkon mchog snod ni/thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi 'dul ba lung sde bzhi ni dkon mchog yin la/ de'i snod ni so sor thar ba'i mdo yin pas de bshad par bya/ zhes pa'i don du paṇa chen dge 'du na grub kyis so thar mdo'i 'grel par gsungs so/ /de ltar yang slob dpon dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i so thar gyi mdo'i rgya cher 'grel las/ kun las btus sam bam po lnga bcu bar yang grags so/ /dkon mchog ces bya ba ni bshad pa dang / bsgrub pa'i chos dkon mchog ste/ mdzod ces bya ba ni chos dkon mchog de'i mdzod 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ brnyes pa zhes bya ba ni slob ma nyid du brnyes pa ste/ ston pa'i lam gyi rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ / zhes dang /gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba ni spyi bo ste/ nor bu gdags pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / so sor thar ba ste/ 'di ni bslab gzhi dkon mchog snod ces bya bas bstan te/ bslab gzhi dkon mchog ni/ rnam par 'byed pa dang / gzhi dang / phran tshegs dang / gzhung bla ma dag go/ snod ces bya ba ni de dag gi snod 513

de so sor thar ba'i mdo 'di nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig ni/ slob dpon shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'ur byas pa sum brgya ba'i mchod brjod yin la/ de'i don rang 'grel 'od ldan ltar na/ tshigs rkang dang bo'i nges par 'byung ba ni/ nges legs lhag med myang 'das dang / de'i thob byed kyi rgyur gyur pa'i tshul khrims yin pas na nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims zhes bya'o/ /'dis tshul khrims de nges legs kyi rgyu yin par bstan/ nges legs la'ang lhag med dang lhag bcas kyi myang 'das gnyis yod pa las/ sdug bsngal spong zhes pas nges 'byung gi tshul khrims des phung bo lnga'i bdag nyid kyi sdug bsngal spong byed de lhag med myang 'das thob byed kyi rgyur bstan/ tshigs rkang gnyis pas 'jig lta'i rtsa ba'am sa bon 'joms byed de lhag bcas myang 'das kyi rgyur bstan te/ de gnyis kyis rim rnga/ra 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang / rgyu kun 'byung spong ba'i byed las ga nyis bstan to/ /tshigs rkang gsum pas mngon mtho'i rgyu yin par bstan te/ dpal 'byor sa zhes pas gnas skabs lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rnams 'byung ba'i rten dang / gzhi dang / rgyu dang / gnas yin pas na dpal 'byor sa zhes bya'o/ /me tog mda' can ni 'dod pa'i lha dasa' rab dbang phyug ste/ de'i chung ma me tog gi gtsug phud can gyi spyi bo na me tog gi mda' dregs par byed pa dang / rmongs par byed pa dang / kun tu rmongs par byed pa dang / brgyal bar byed pa dang / sems med par byed pa ste me tog gi mda' lnga yod par bshad do/ / des na tshu la khrims ni lha'i bu'i bdud las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa'i rgyur bstan cing / 'dis mngon par mtho ba yang bsta na to/ /zhes 'od lda na du gsung /sum brgya ba'i rnam bshad slob dpon 'dul ba lhas mdzad pa las/ bshad tshul de dang gzhan yang 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas la ni mgos gtugs nas nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims bshad par bya'o/ /'o na sangs rgyas de yon tan gyi khyad par ji lta bu dang ldan zhe na/ phung bo lnga'i bdag nyid kyi sdug bsngal spong zhing phung bo'i bdud las rgyal ba dang / 'jig lta bag chags bcas 'joms shing nyon rngo/ngas pa'i bdud las 514

rgyal ba dang / dpal gyi 'byor ba bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / ye shes kyi tshogs sam/ yang na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal dang 'byor ba'i sa ste 'byung ba'i gnas dang / me tog mda' can te lha'i bu'i bdud 'joms pa'i yon tan dang ldan no/ /de ltar na yon tan de dag tshul khrims la sbyar tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la sbyar te bshad tshul gnyis yod do/ /nges par 'byung ba ni skabs 'dir gdon mi za bar thob par bya ba zhes pa'i don du rgya cher 'grel las gsungs te/nges pa ni gdon mi za ba dang / 'byung ba thob par bya ba la tshig grogs kyis go dgos pa'i phyir ro/ / bkras lhun par ma 'dir mkhan po'i mtshan nyid bcu gsum grangs bzhin du chos bcu'o/ /zhes pa ma dag ste/ 'og tu ma khan po'i skabs su bshade pa'i chos bcu gsum dang ldan pa'o/ / zhes 'byung ba dang / bslab bya chen mor yang /gnas kyi bla ma'i mtshan nyid skabs/ sngar gnas su ma grub pa/ zhes pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan don mthun par grangs bcu gsum gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sprul ba rab tu phyung ba ni/ klu gzhon nu zhig bye tshan gyis sdug bsngal nas bram zer sprul nas rgyal byed tshal du song ste/ dge slong zhig la bdag rab tu dbyung du gsol/ zhes smras pas/ dge slong de kho bo gsar bu yin zer nas / dang gi mkhan po'i drung du khrid nas 'di rab tu dbyung du gsol/ zhus pas/ mkhan po na re/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs byas nas yal bar bor mi rung bas rab tu mi 'byin gsungs/ rab tu phyungs shig dang kho bos bslab bya rnams bstan par bya'o zhes dge slong de bslab bya ston par khas blangs pas/ sprul ba de rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs byas so/ /spangs pa la stob pa'i ltung ba'i mtha' ni/ spangs pa la stob pa'i ltung byed kyi gleng gzhir/ khyim bdag zhig rgas shing nor zad de rgyal byed tshal du song nas rab byung zhus pa sogs de dang 'dra'o/ /dkyus gcig la dge tshul bar du sgrub na mi dgos kyang / dge bsnyen tsam du gnas na dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa dang dus go gnyis ka brjod da gos par las chog chen mo sogs su'ang gsungs so/ /gshe ba dang spyo ba'i khyad par ni/ mtsho ṭīka las/ gshe ba ni khyim pa'i phyogs kyi skyon gyis smod pa ste/ spyo ba ni rab tu byang ba'i ba 515

skyon gyis smod pa'o/ /'tsho ba dang lta ba nyams pa'i sgo nas gshe ba dang / tshul khrims dang cho ga nyams pa'i sgo nas spyo ba'o/ / zhes gsung / gnas dar bya ba gzhan 'doms pa'i tshe ji ltar bya ba'i skabs/ dbyar phyi ma'i khas len dang / blangs na sa zla ba phyi ma gnyis zhes pa zla ba snga ma gnyis zhes pa yin te/ bslab bya chen mo dang /'dul ṭīka chen mo sogs su'ang zla ba snga ma gnyis zhes 'byung ngo / /lce bzhar ni bzhi lte/ra gan dang / zangs dang / lcags dang / 'khar ba las byas pa'o/ /ma 'byor na so shing gi rnatshal ba sogs rung / so shi nga la yon tan lnga yod de/ rang mkhris bad kun rnams 'dren par byed pa dang / kha'i dri mi zhim pa sel ba dang / yi ga 'byed cing mig la phan pa'o/ /chol zangs dang / bzed zhal dang / mchil ma'i snod rnams ming gi rnam grangs su mngon brjod du bshad cing / rkang lag bkru ba'i snod la'ang 'jug go/ 'phags pa zhes pa la/ 'bras srungs par mar 'degs pa zhes 'byung ba ma dag go/ mdo rtsar/ spangs pa la phyag mi bya'o/ /spags pas mi bya'o/ /zhes dang /sbags pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ tha na so shing yan chad za pas dang / tha na de'i sa byi dor byed pa yan chad mi gtsang bas so/ /'di la gcer bu nyid dang gos gcig pa nyid ni sbags pa dang 'dra'o/ / zhes gsung / bya ba'i dmigs bsal brgyad gsungs pa 'a di la/ bslab bya chen mor/ grangs nges bzung med par bcu gcig tsam byung bar/bshad pa dang gci ba dor ba dang / so bkru ba dang / zhes pa ltar 'dir bshang gci dang so shing dor ba dang zhes pa grangs so sor byas na 'grig go/ spyod yul gyi gnas ma yin pa lnga ste/ rol mo mkhan dang / 'jud mthun pa dang / chang ma dang /gdol ba'i gnas dang / rgyal bo'i pho brang ngo / /legs spya ra sgyi khrus zhes pa'i sgyi ni yig nor/ legs sbyar gyi khrus zhes pa ste/ rlung 'dren pa'i rtsa ba dang sdong bu dang lo ma dang me rtog dang 'bras bu bskol te khrus bya ba ni legs sbyar gyi khrus su mdo rtsar bshad do/ /rkang khrus kyi gzhi ni/ gang bab tu rkang ba bkrus pas sa gzhi ma rung bar gyur nas gtsug lag khang gi steng gi shar lho'i mtshams su rkang khrus kyi gzhi rus sbal lta bu bya bar gsung ngo / /lhung bzed kyi lhan pa sra ba lnga ste/ lhan ring dang / tham phran 516

dang / lhan pa dang / chu srin gyi so lta bu dang / phye ma ste/ 'di ni gnyis te/lcags kyi phye ma dang / rdo'i phye ma'o/ /rin chen phreng ba las/ tham phran ni bu gu dgag pa'i lcags gzer mgo leb dang / lhan pa ni zlum po'am gru bzhi'am zur gsum dang / de nyid kyi mtha' thams cad sog le lta bu dang ldan pa ni chu srin gyi so lta bur gsung ngo / /bu ston rin po che'i las brgya rtsa gcig gi rnam bshad las/ gtam 'dres pa ni/ tshur shog 'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gtam 'dres pas dga' bar gyur ba'o/ /phebs par smra ba ni/ yid gcugs par smra bas bshes par gyur pa'o/ /smon 'drin ni/ ngo shes shing ming rus la sogs pa 'dzin pas snying du sdug par gyur pa'o/ /'grogs bshes ni/ lam gcig tu 'gro ba la sogs pa'i bya bas bshes pa cung zad skyes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ / mtsho ṭīka las/ lha 'bangs ni/dge 'dun gyi g.yog byed pa'i mi skya yin/ zhes gsung / kun dga' ra ba ni/gtsug lag khang dang / bza' shing gi ra ba'i ming la'ang 'jug go/ pham pa dang bo 'i skabasasu/ bsten bya dbus phye ba'i mtshams 'byor bar mngon pa zhes pa ni/ ro lta bu'i mo mtshan dbus nas phyed gshegs su song ba slar sbyar ba'i 'byor mtshams mngon pa'i don ngang / lag pa la sogs pa sprad du mi rung ba ni/ bu mo ha cang gzhon nu lta bu lag pas lag par dang / rkang bas rkang bar 'doms kyis 'doms su sprad du mi rung ba zhes pa'o/ /gzhan gyi mthus bcol ba ni/ gzhan gyis dbang med du byas te lus sprad pa'o/ /las su mi rung ba dang / bltab pa ni/ pho mtshan las su mi rung ba 'dzud pa dang / de nyid bltab byas nas rma sgor 'dzud pa'o/ / bsten bya sten byed gang rung lus las tha dad du byas pa ni/ pho mo'i mtshan ma gang rung lus las chad pa'i dum bu dang / gnyis ka tha dad du byas pa ni/ de gnyis ka lus las chad pa ste/ de 'dra mi srid pa'i skyon med de/ dge slong smyos pas rang gi mtshan ma bcad pa dang / rgyal bo'i chad pa phog ste bcad pa dang / mdze nad kyis rul chad du gyur pa dge slong gis 'dzud srid par mtsho ṭīka sogs su gsung / gzhan gyi bsten bya sten byed gnyis ka lus las tha dad du ma byas pa sprad pa ni/ dge slong gis gzhan pho 517

mo gnyis sprad pa'o/ /bsdod pa ni brid pa ste/ 'dir bslab bya'i nyes byas bcu gnyis gsungs pa grangs gcig chad pas tha ma gnyis la bslab bya chen mor/ des mtshon nas bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad la sbyor ba lhod par byas pa dang / gcig pu bla gab med par mtshan mo'ang gros 'bebs pa sogs te nyes byas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /ma byin len gyi skabs/ nan 'gugs ni/ ma thus 'phrog pa'am dbang gis mnan cing len pa/ dngan 'then ni/ gzhan gyi rdzas khyer ba phyir brgyangs nas mi ster ba'o/ /phyir brnur ba ni phyir nur ba'am 'then pa ste/ dag yig za ma tog las/mdun du brnur ba zhes par mchan du mdun du 'then pa'i ming zhes 'byung ngo / /gtams pa ni bcol ba dang / brtog pa ni sbas pa'i ming ste/ za ma tog tu/ sbas pa'i brnog sogs bas phul rna'o/ /zhes dang / li shi gur khang du/ brtogs pa ni bsdams pa'am sbas pa zhes 'byung ngo / /dor byed pa ni g.yo byed pa ste/ mtsho ṭīka las/ dor byed ces par mchan du g.yo byed ces bshad do/ /tshoms ni tshogs pa'i khang pa'o/ /til gyi phub ma ni til gyi shun pa/ 'dams po ni/ bslab bya chen mo ra/ldem po zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ ldem po ni drang bo ma yin pa'i don yin pas na/ yon po 'am 'khyog po'i sems kyis gzhan gyi 'a tsho thabs gtol ba ste gshig pa'o/ /lag pod ni lag tu yong ba'am lag gis nus pa'i don te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ lhung bzed sreg pa sogs lag pod kyi las kyis las bya zhing bsod nams kyi blos kyang bya'i gla rngan gyis ni ma yin te/ lag bzo'i tha snyad spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lus bsnyal ba ni/ gzhan gyis rang la ster dgos pa'i rdzas tshang bar ma byin pa'i tshe de'i mdun du khro bas lus bsgyel zhing bsnyal ba'i don no/ / gnad la bsgre ba ni/yon po dang sgyu thabs kyis gnod pa byed pa'i ming ste/ rje'i mdo rtsa'i zin bris las/gnad la bsgre ba ni/ yon po dang gya gyu'i rnam pas gnod par byed pa ste/ de su la yang mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng bar yang de bzhin gsungs so/ /byug ris ni gral gyi ming du bshad la/ de yang bkad sa ste g.yos khang ngam 'dug sar chus byags te re'u chang 'dri bar bshad do/ /lag gi bla ni las dpon te las la bskos pa'i ༄518 ba

mi'o/ /smyan byed pa'i lhag ma'i skabs/ chu tshigs kyis byin pa ni/ bram zes dam tshig gi chu khyor ba'i nang nas byin zhing 'thung du bcug nas/ bram ze'i ril ba spyi blugs kyi chu'i rgyun gyis skyes pa dang bud med de gnyis la skor zhing bram zes cho ga byas nas byin pa la mtsho ṭīka las gsung / spyir yang 'phags yul ba'i yul chos ni/bza' btung ma yin pa'i sbyin pa rgya che ba gang la'ang 'bul ba'i brdar chu gtsang sgreng ba yin par bshad do/ /kha dum pa ni kha 'cham pa'am mthun pa/ rde'u gsum gtor ba ni/ khyo shug gnyis ma mthun te yul lugs kyi mna' bor ba'i brdar rde'u gsum blangs te phyogs gsum du gtor ba ste/ rde'u de rnams slar mi 'phrad pa bzhin phyin chad phan tshun mthun zhing 'phrad pa med do zhes mna' bskyal ba la byed ces gsung /'thab krol ni 'thab mo/ mtsho ṭīka las/cho zlog pa lnga ni/ bzhams bsgo dang /gsol ba dang / las brjod pa gsum mo/ /zhes gsung / zla 'jog gi spang bar snam phran glegs bu med pa'i bla gos chung tshad/ phyed dang lnga dang phyed dang gsum las chung ba dang / zhes dgos rgyu la phyed dang lnga dang zhes pa chad/ 'khrur 'jug gi spang ba'i skabs/ gzhi'i yan lag ma tshang ba dge slong ma nye du ma yin pa la ma yin par 'du shes pa'am/ zhes pa ni dge slong ma nye du yin pa la zhes pa ste/ dgag tshig yig nor ro/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang ni/ tshad dang ldan pa'i khru phyed dang do'o/ /kho lag ni zheng ngam sbom/ dog pa ni 'dir skud pa'o/ /srin bal gyi stan byed pa'i spang ba'i skabs/ glings pa ni phying ba'i rnam pa dang / nang tshangs can ni g.yogs byas te nang du bal lta bu brdzangs pa la bya'o/ /bal sngon po ni sngon por kha bsgyur ba dang /kham pa ni rang bzhin gyi kham pa dang / 'dam kha ni 'dam rdzab kyi sa nag gis kha bsgyur ba la 'dul ṭīka chen mor gsung / dkar bo dang mkhob bal gyi khyad par ni/glo dang rgyab dang gnya' ba nas skyes pa ni dkar bo dang / mgo dang rkang ba dang lto nas skyes pa ni mkhob bal du mdo rtsa nyid du gsungs te/ 'khob pa ni ngan pa zhes pa'i brda rnying yin pas bal ngan pa la 'khob bal zhes bya'o/ /des na kha cig mkhob bal ni yul skad la khu zhes pa ra dang khyi sogs kyi spu ting na skyes pa bal shin tu 'jam pa 519

zhig yod pa la 'dod pa mi 'thad do/ /bal 'khur ba'i spang ba'i skabs/ ngom spos pa ni/ khur sngon ma de ma brje ba ste/ khur sngon ma de rgyang grags bar du khyer nas/yang lug bal lta bu gzhan zhig brnyes pa na snga ma bor te phyi ma de khyer na ngo spos pa yin no/ / phrag dang gis khur 'khur ba zhes pa la/ bslab bya chen mor phrag brang zhes 'byung la/ de ni shing ring bo'i sne la 'khur bo btags nas khur ba la bya'am dpyad/gser dngul la reg pa'i spang bar/ 'thob par lcogs pa na gnas pa ni/ lag pa sleb pa'i thag nye na gnas pa'o/ /gser dngul beeḍūrya shel mu tig ste rin po che lnga dang /zha nye/ zangs/ ro nye ste zha nye dkar bo/ khro chu/ lcags te rin po cher smos pa lnga zhes 'dul ṭīka chen mor 'byung ngo / /sog ma'i phreng ba ni gro nas sogs kyi rtswa rkang las phreng don lta bu bcos pa'o/ /ma'i rnam 'byed las/ mngon mtshan zhes bya ba ni dbyig gam gser ro/ /zhes mngon mtshan ni dbyig dang gser dngul la bshad cing / mtsho ṭīka las/ gser dngul la dong tse dang pa na'i gzugs kyi khyad par byas pa ni mngon mtshan can zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsung ngo / /kun dga' ba'am zhes pa ni/ bdag po'i sgra chad pas/ kun dga' ra ba ba zhes pa yin te/ spyir kun dga' ra ba ni gtsug lag khang la 'jug kyang / 'dir ni skyed mos tshal la khyim gyi kun dga' ra ba dang /bza' shing gi ra ba'i ming la dpal gyi kun dga' ra ba zhes mngon brjod rnams su bshad pa ltar/ ldum ra'i shing thog sogs srung ba'i mi la kun dga' ra ba ba zhes brjod par mtsho ṭīka las gsung / 'dul ṭīka tu/ kun dga' ra ba ba lha 'bangs sam dge bsnyen zhes 'byung ngo / /gta' ni gtam ste gzhan las nor blangs pa'i tshab tu bzhag pa'i rdzas kyi ming ngo / /gsog 'jog gi spang bar/ sham thar ma bye ba ni 'dres shing spags pa so sor ma bsal ba'i don no/ /nyi ma 'das so cog dge slong ma la brjod na zhes pa yig nor te/ dge slong la ma brjod na zhes pa'o/ /skyo sngogs ni rtsod pa slar slong ba/ rtsod pa bzhi ni/ 'gyed phyir rtsod pa/ mi gdams phyir rtsod pa/ltung ba'i phyir rtsod pa/ bya ba las kyi phyir rtsod pa bzhi'o/ /khyad du gsod pa'i ltung byed skabs/ 'dul ba'i bslab pa'i gzhi ston pa'i mngon pa'i tshig dang mdo sde'i 520

tshig khyad du gsod na ltung byed dang / 'dul ba'i bslab pa'i gzhi ston pa ma yin pa'i mngon pa dang mdo sde'i tshig khyad du gsod na nyes byas su mtsho ṭīka gi mchan du gsung ngo / /sa bon dang skye ba 'jig pa'i ltung byed skabs ni/ tshi gu ni shing thog gi nang rus/phri ni phyi'i shun pa'i nang gi bar shun srab mo ste/ bar gyi shun pa de snying bo las bye na nyes byas so/ /khyi'u kha ma thon pa zhes pa'i dgag tshig yig nor te/ mdo rtsa dang /mtsho ṭīka sogs mang bor khyi'u kha thon pa zhes 'byung ba dag pa yin/ de ni sa 'og tu sa bon btab pa myu gu skye bar rtsom ste cung zad kha 'bus pa'o/ /sa 'bus pa ni/ lung rnam 'byed las/ pha ba sgo sgo zhes gsungs shing / sa'i steng du 'bur te thon pa ril po wa ba 'dra ba nang thal ba lta bus gang ba sman dpe rnams su 'dre sha mang dang / ma bsregs thal ba yang zer ba de'o/ /sha mo ni zha mo zer ba'i tshod ma rgya zhwa'i rnam par skyes pa dang / sha bal ni/ lung rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba las/ sha bal zhes bya ba ni sa dreg ste sa zhag la sogs pa'i steng sngo ba dang sha bal chags pa dag go/ zhes gsungs pas/ dbyar dus sa'i steng du sngon po bal lta bur chags pa de'o/ /rlab ni/ snod la sogs pa rlan che sar yun ring bzhag pa na de la spu lta bu zhig chags pa de yin gsung /zhal ta ba ni do dam pa zhes pa ste/ do dam byed pa la zhal ta byed pa zhes skabs mang bor 'gyur ro/ / bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i skabs kyi gang zag bcu gnyis po ni/gnas khang dang / zas dang / thug pa dang / bag chos 'brim pa dang / phran tshogs 'brim pa dang / snod spyad sgrub pa dang / gos sred pa dang / gos 'gyed pa dang / ras chen sbed pa dang / ras chen 'gyed pa dang / mngag gzhug pa dang /mdzes chos par bskos pa rnams so/ / bag chos ni khur ba'i ming ste/ lung las/khur ba zhes bya ba ni bag chos rnams so/ /zhes gsung ngo / /che bzhi ni dpang bo'o/ /phan phun du 'gyur ba ni zhig ral du 'gyur ba'o/ /brtul ba ni bsdus pa'o/ /gril ni snam bu sogs za ba'i 'bu chung du yul skad la sri'am mug pa zhes pa de'o/ /bcer ba ni phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'am spungs pa'o/ /bslab bya chen mor/ phyis gnon zhes pa gnod pas zil gyis mnan pa'i don yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'di'i skabs kyi 521

lung gi bar sdom las/ ngan dang bsod dang bgrang dro dang / /zhes sogs kyis dge slong la tho 'tsham pa'i bya ba bcu gsungs pa'i don bslab bya chen mo las shes par bya'o/ /gos sbyin pa'i ltung byed skabs kyi/ dge 'dun la gos 'bul ba'i khongs su gtogs pa zhes pa ni/ dge slong ma'i dge 'dun la zhes pa yin/ /yang yang za ba'i ltung byed skabs/ bza' ba lnga dang bca' ba lnga ni/ me tog phreng rgyud las/ sna tshogs 'bras can zan dang sha/ phye dang 'khur ba bza' ba lnga/ /rtsa ba sdong bu me tog 'bras/ /lo ma yang ni bca' ba lnga/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /re la de ni re lde zhes pa yin te/ smyug ma la sogs pa las lhas pa'i rtswa stan gru bzhi'o/ /rnam 'byed 'grel ba las/ phyag bdar re lde tsam byas pa ni khru bzhi tsam phyags pa'o/ /zhes gsung ngo / /gnas pa gzhan la rag ma las pas na gnas brtan dang / tshe khyad par can dang ldan pas na tshe dang lda na pa zhes bya'o/ /ma ga dha'i bre'u chung gang ni drug phul do ste bod bre'i drug cha gnyis so/ / nar ma ni rgyun ma/ bkad sa ni g.yos khang dang 'dug sa la 'jug spyi spungs ni dge 'dun spyi'i rdzas spungs pa/ mnos pa ni blangs pa/ mid pa gnyis pa la dregs pa'i zas ma yin pa ni/ yid zin pa yar brdzog pa slar mid pa ma yin pa'i don no/ /lan tshwa ni yongs grags kyi tshwa dang / 'gyur byed kyi chu ni ba tshwa'i chu lta bu yin gyi tshwa gsar du btab pa min no/ /than 'khor ni nye 'khor/ ru skya ni gru skyod byed kyi shing ngam gru'i gshog pa/ gdos pa ni gru bskul ba'i dbyu gu'i ming ngo / /'dul lha'i rnam 'byed kyi ṭīkkar/ ru skya 'dzin pa ni blung g.yor thogs pa'o/ /zhes kyang 'byung / byin len ma byas par za ba'i ltung byed skabs/ rags pa ni skabs 'dir mtshams gzhan la bya'o/ /mtshams gzhan ni lnga ste/ me dang / chu dang / bu ga nam mkha' dang / bdag po dang / rags pa mtshams gzhan no/ /rags pa'i dpangs tshad ni sor bzhi yan chad do/ / zas kyi zer ma mi srung ba ni/ zas kyi gzegs ma ste cha shas chu snod du lhung ba mi srung ba yin snyam/ bsnyil ba sdud pa'i ltung byed skabs/ zlog pa lnga ni/ bzhams bsgo/ gsol ba/ brjod pa dang bo dang /gnyis pa dang / gsum pa rnams so/ /longs pa bzhir gtogs kyi ltung byed skabs ni/522

dam rgya 'chang ba ni/ 'di'i thad kyi bslab bya chen mor/ rgyan du gyur pa'i rgya bcangs pa/ zhes 'byung bas the tse'i ming ngo / / 'phral ris gsum zhes pa la/'phral ba ni dpral ba'i ming yin te/ shākya ma/chog pas/ 'phral ba zhes pa dpral ba'i ming / /zhes bshad do/ /des na 'dul ṭīka chen mor dpral ris zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ dpral bar sa dkar gyi ri mo gsum/ byas pa'i don no/ /bram ze'i srad bu thogs pa ni/ mchod sbyin gyi dag byed sud bu'i ser la phreng ba thogs pa dang /sngags skud 'chang ba ni tshon sna lnga ba'i sngags skud dpung ba g.yon par gdags pa'o/ /gar bzlas pa ni gar brjed gso sa byas pa/ brla dang lag pa nya ltar bskor te 'gro ba zhes pa la/ 'dul ṭīka chen mo las/ brla ya gcig sa la btsugs te lus bskor ba dang / lag pa phyar te lus bskor ba dang / nya ltar phyi gan du brgal zhing bskor ba ste de ltar mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdzab la phyil mo zhug pa ni/ 'grel chung las/chab rom dang sa 'gred mo la sogs pa la phyil mo nyug par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/'dam rdzab sogs la rtse ba'i ched lus 'greng thabs su phyil ba'i don no/ /sdangs par byed pa'i ltung byed skabs/ lwa ba nag po ni/ snam bu spu can nag po/ phyar ba ni phyar/ bsel ni skyabs sam skyel ma'i ming / gsum pa grogs kyi cho ga la log par sgrub pa la zhes pa'i 'phro/ bzhi'i dang bo bslab pa la nye bar 'jog pa spong ba'i ltung byed la/ zhes pa zhig chad 'dug go/ gya tshom ni ma brtags pa/ khab ral ni khab snod kyi ming ngo / /sor bshags dang bo'i skabs/ dbyar khang ni dge slong ma'i rgyun par sdod sa/ lho/ sor bshags gnyis pa zhes pa'i 'phro la/ ma bzlog par za ba'i sor bshags/ zhes pa zhig dgos par mngon/ 'du shes ni bsko bsham byed pa lam bsgo ba la zhes pa 'di/ bsko bsham byed pa ma bzlog pa la/ zhes pa yin par sems/khye'u sus ni/ mtsho ṭīka las/ khye'u sus ni nar mar za tshod las lhag par za ba'o/ /zhes/ gsungs te/ nang bar gyi zas kyi snga rol lam 'og rol tu dang / nyin byed kyi zas kyi snga rol tu kha zas za ba lta bu'o/ /'bru'i phur ma ni 'bru'i thum po ste/ phye ma'i thum po la phye ma'i phur ma zhes pa bzhin no/ /kha tshar phun tshar gyi mtha' nar ba dang /523

zhes pa ni/ kha tshar dang phun tshar can gyi gos dge slong la mi rung bas na/ kha tshar dang phun tshar gyi mtha' ltar nar ba dang / zhes pa yin par sems/ so thar gyi mdor/ glang bo che'i sna ltar ma yin pa dang / zhes gsung / sham thabs ring thung ran pa'i tshad ni/ 'dul ba bsdus pa las/ long bu las brtsams nas sor bzhis bor bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lag pa 'gram pa la brten pa dang / stan rgyab tu bkur ba gnyis ni ma'i rnam 'byed las gsungs shing / lhung bzed lan gsum bkrus te chu mi sbyin pa dang / lam gyi bzhi mdor lhung bzed 'khru ba gnyis ni/ dang bo lung phran tshegs dang / phyi ma pha'i rnam 'byed nas gsungs pas na de bzhi mdo rtsa'i skabs 'dir zhar byung du bsdus so/ /bzhi bo de so thar gyi mdor med pas dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum du mi bgrang ngo / /zas la ha cang bsngags pa brjod pa dang skyon gdags pa gnyis ka lung las bkag go/ lung rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba las/do ker can ni skra gyen du gtsug tor ltar bcings pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ mgo cod gan can dang / phreng ba can ni/ mgo la rin po che'am dar sogs kyi cod pan dang /rin po che'i phreng ba'am me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa dang / mgo dkris pa ni/ mgo thod kyis dkris pa'am ras sogs kyis dkris pa'o/ /bzhon pa'i steng na 'dug pa ni/lung rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba las/ shing rta la sogs pa bzhon pa'i steng na 'dug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ bslab bya chen po las/ glang bo che dang rta las gzhan pa'i bzhon pa'i steng na 'dug pa dang / zhes dang / 'du la ṭīka chen po las/ shing rta la tshosogs pa mis bteg pa min pa'i bzhon pa'i steng na 'dug pa dang / zhes gsungs so/ /lung rnam 'byed kyi 'grel ba las/ mtshon cha ni mdung dang 'phar mdung la sogs pa'o/ /dgra cha ni mda' gzhu'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ dgra cha thogs pa zhes pa la/ so thar gyi mdo bar ma 'ga' zhig las/ lag na dgra sta thogs pa dang / zhes 'byung ngo / /go cha gyon pa ni/ khrab gyo na pa'o/ / de rnams rab byung gi gzhi'i rnam 'byed las byung ba'i ltung ba sde lnga rnams yin zhing / gzhi lhag rnam nas 'byung ba'i dge slong la nyes byas su 'gyur tshal rnams las sems bsrang tshal gyi bslab bya ni/ rje'i 524 ra༅ rathu ra༅

ba ku' 'a bum na bzhugs pa 'i gzhi nas 'a byung ba 'i bslab bya'i zi na bris dngarto/ 'a dul 'a dzin rin po ches mdzad pa'i ba slab bya chen mo sogs las shes pa ra bya'o / /ci 'di ni rje bla ma'i gsung zin bris bslab bya gnam rtse ldeng ma la thos bsam byed dzi dag tshol cung zad pon phyir/ gyi na ba dbyangs can dga' ba 'i blo gros kyis bris sa pa'o/ / rdzis ste/ spyo 'di khal kha jo nang pe se'i shog/ dpyo da ldan dge slong ngag dbang bstan 'dzin gyis/ / chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i lag bsam gyis/ / ma than rkyen ci ci ha 4 ༄ sbyar te —par du legs par bsgru bas/ / legs byas 'dis mtshon dus tsho ga sum dge ba'i mthus/ / tshe rabs kun tu dal 'byor rten brgyud de/ / dpal ldan bla mas dgyes ci bzhi na rjes bzung na sa/ /smin grol lam skrezang myu ra du mthar phyi na shog /ci 525
